traits.name: Two Heads
traits.description: The ettin has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks and on saving throws against being blinded, charmed, deafened, frightened, stunned, and knocked unconscious.

traits.name: Wakeful
traits.description: When one of the ettin's heads is asleep, its other head is awake.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The ettin makes two attacks: one with its battleaxe and one with its morningstar.

actions.name: Battleaxe
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 14 (2d8 + 5) slashing damage.

actions.name: Morningstar
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 14 (2d8 + 5) piercing damage.

actions.name: Fire Breath {@recharge 5}
actions.description: The ettin's right head exhales fire in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw, taking 45 (10d8) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

actions.name: Cold Breath {@recharge 5}
actions.description: The ettin's left head exhales an icy blast in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 14 Constitution saving throw, taking 45 (10d8) cold damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

actions.name: Gaze
actions.description: The ettin turns its magical gaze toward one creature that it can see within 120 feet of it. That target must make a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw. Unless the target is incapacitated, it can avert its eyes to avoid the gaze and to automatically succeed on the save. If the target does so, it can't see the ettin until the start of the ettin's next turn. If the target looks at the ettin in the meantime, it must immediately make the save. If the target fails the save, it suffers one of the following effects of the ettin's choice or at random:

actions.name: Beguiling Gaze
actions.description: The target is stunned until the start of the ettin's next turn or until the ettin is no longer within line of sight.

actions.name: Hypnotic Gaze
actions.description: The target is charmed by the ettin until the start of the ettin's next turn. The ettin chooses how the charmed target uses its actions, reactions, and movement.

actions.name: Insanity Gaze
actions.description: The target suffers the effect of the confusion spell without making a saving throw. The effect lasts until the start of the ettin's next turn. The ettin doesn't need to concentrate on the spell.

traits.name: Dive Attack
traits.description: If the aarakocra is flying and dives at least 30 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a melee weapon attack, the attack deals an extra 3 (1d6) damage to the target.

actions.name: Talon
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 4 (1d4 + 2) slashing damage.

actions.name: Javelin
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft., one target. 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.

actions.name: Summon Air Elemental
actions.description: Five aarakocra within 30 feet of each other can magically summon an air elemental. Each of the five must use its action and movement on three consecutive turns to perform an aerial dance and must maintain concentration while doing so (as if concentrating on a spell). When all five have finished their third turn of the dance, the elemental appears in an unoccupied space within 60 feet of them. It is friendly toward them and obeys their spoken commands. It remains for 1 hour, until it or all its summoners die, or until any of its summoners dismisses it as a bonus action. A summoner can't perform the dance again until it finishes a short rest. When the elemental returns to the Elemental Plane of Air, any aarakocra within 5 feet of it can return with it.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The aarakocra makes two Wind Staff attacks, and it can use Spellcasting to cast Gust of Wind.

actions.name: Wind Staff
actions.description: m,r +5, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft. 7 (1d8 + 3) Bludgeoning damage plus 11 (2d10) Lightning damage.

spellcasting.header: The aarakocra casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 13):

spellcasting.name: Feather Fall (1/Day)
spellcasting.header: The aarakocra casts Feather Fall in response to that spell's trigger, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

traits.description: If the aarakocra is flying and dives at least 30 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a melee weapon attack, the attack deals an extra 3 (1d6) damage to the target.

traits.name: Simulacra
traits.description: When a simulacrum drops to 0 hit points or is subjected to a successful dispel magic spell (DC 17), it reverts to ice and snow and is destroyed.

actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 4 (1d4 + 2) slashing damage.

When the elemental returns to the Elemental Plane of Air, any aarakocra within 5 feet of it can return with it.

actions.name: Talons
actions.description: m +4, reach 5 ft. 4 (1d4 + 2) Slashing damage, or 9 (3d4 + 2) Slashing damage if the aarakocra moved 30+ feet straight toward the target immediately before the hit.

actions.name: Wind Javelin
actions.description: m,r +4, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft. 5 (1d6 + 2) Piercing damage plus 2 (1d4) Thunder damage. The javelin magically returns to the aarakocra's hand immediately after a ranged attack.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.description: The aartuk can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The aartuk makes two Branch attacks, two Radiant Pellet attacks, or one of each.

actions.name: Branch
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Radiant Pellet
actions.description: Ranged Spell Attack +4 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. 10 (4d4) radiant damage.

bonus_actions.name: Tongue {@recharge}
bonus_actions.description: The aartuk tries to use its gooey tongue to snare one Large or smaller creature it can see within 30 feet of itself. The target must make a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the target is grappled by the tongue (escape DC 14) and pulled up to 25 feet toward the aartuk. The tongue can grapple one creature at a time.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The cultist makes two Tentacle Lash attacks. It can replace any attack with a use of Mind Rot.

actions.name: Tentacle Lash
actions.description: m +7, reach 10 ft. 7 (1d6 + 4) Slashing damage plus 14 (4d6) Psychic damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 14) from one of two tentacles, and it has the Restrained condition until the grapple ends.

actions.name: Mind Rot
actions.description: wis DC 15, one creature the cultist can see within 90 feet. 27 (6d8) Psychic damage, and the target has the Poisoned condition until the start of the cultist's next turn. Half damage only.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.header: The cultist casts one of the following spells, using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 15):

spellcasting.name: Counterspell (2/Day)
spellcasting.header: The cultist casts Counterspell in response to that spell's trigger, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

traits.name: Regeneration (Slaad Only)
traits.description: The spirit regains 5 Hit Points at the start of its turn if it has at least 1 Hit Point.

traits.name: Whispering Aura (Mind Flayer Only)
traits.description: At the start of each of the spirit's turns, the spirit emits psionic energy if it doesn't have the Incapacitated condition. wis DC equals your spell save DC, each creature (other than you) within 5 feet of the spirit. 2d6 Psychic damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The spirit makes a number of attacks equal to half this spell's level (round down).

actions.name: Claw (Slaad Only)
actions.description: m Bonus equals your spell attack modifier, reach 5 ft. 1d10 + 3 + summonSpellLevel Slashing damage, and the target can't regain Hit Points until the start of the spirit's next turn.

actions.name: Eye Ray (Beholderkin Only)
actions.description: r Bonus equals your spell attack modifier, range 150 ft. 1d8 + 3 + summonSpellLevel Psychic damage.

actions.name: Psychic Slam (Mind Flayer Only)
actions.description: m Bonus equals your spell attack modifier, reach 5 ft. 1d8 + 3 + summonSpellLevel Psychic damage.

traits.name: Aberrant Form
traits.description: The zealot exudes the chaos of the Far Realm. Any non-Aberration creature that starts its turn within 5 feet of the zealot must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or take 7 (2d6) psychic damage.

traits.name: Weirdly Pliable
traits.description: The zealot, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, is unnaturally flexible. The zealot can move through any space as narrow as 1 inch without squeezing.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The zealot makes one Psychic Rend attack and two Shortsword attacks.

actions.name: Psychic Rend
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Spell Attack +7 to hit, reach 15 ft. or range 120 ft., one target. 14 (3d6 + 4) psychic damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or have the stunned condition until the start of the zealot's next turn.

actions.name: Shortsword
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +7 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) psychic damage.

bonus_actions.name: Void Warp {@recharge 5}
bonus_actions.description: The zealot teleports, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, to an unoccupied space it can see within 120 feet of itself, leaving a churning void in the space it left. Immediately after it teleports, each creature within 30 feet of the void other than the zealot must make a DC 15 Strength saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 18 (4d8) force damage and is pulled to the unoccupied space closest to the void. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage only. The void then disappears.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting (Psionics)
spellcasting.header: The zealot casts one of the following spells, requiring no components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 15):

traits.name: Insatiable Greed
traits.description: The abhorrent overlord can sense the presence of gold within 1,000 feet of itself. It can determine which location has the greatest amount of gold and can sense the direction to that site. If the gold is being moved, it knows the direction of the movement. It can't locate gold if any thickness of clay or lead, even a thin sheet, blocks a direct path between it and the gold.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The abhorrent overlord has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The abhorrent overlord makes two attacks with its claws.

actions.name: Claws
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 14 (2d8 + 5) slashing damage plus 14 (4d6) necrotic damage. The abhorrent overlord regains hit points equal to half the amount of necrotic damage dealt if the target is a creature.

actions.name: Storm of Crows {@recharge}
actions.description: The abhorrent overlord conjures a swarm of spectral crows and harpies in a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on a point the overlord can see within 120 feet of it. The sphere remains for 1 minute or until the overlord loses concentration (as if concentrating on a spell), and its area is lightly obscured and 3. Any creature that moves into the area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw. A creature takes 16 (3d10) slashing damage plus 16 (3d10) psychic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
spellcasting.header: The abhorrent overlord's spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 15). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

traits.name: Devil's Sight
traits.description: Magical darkness doesn't impede Abigor's darkvision.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: Abigor has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Abigor makes four attacks using its Warhammer, Throwing Hammer, or a combination of the two.

actions.name: Warhammer
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +15 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 17 (2d8 + 8) bludgeoning damage plus 3 (1d6) thunder damage.

actions.name: Throwing Hammer
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack +15 to hit, range 30/60 ft., one target. 17 (2d8 + 8) bludgeoning damage plus 3 (1d6) thunder damage. Hammers thrown this way fall and stick into the ground after hitting their target and a new hammer appears in Abigor's hand.

actions.name: Thunderous Slam {@recharge 5}
actions.description: Abigor causes all its hammers left on the battlefield to bristle with thunderous energy, exploding outwards with a roar. All creatures within a 10-foot-radius sphere centered on each hammer must make a DC 22 Constitution saving throw. Targets take 26 (4d12) thunder damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. If a creature is within multiple spheres, it must make the save multiple times, taking damage from each source.

legendary_actions.name: Throw Hammer
legendary_actions.description: Abigor makes a Throwing Hammer attack.

legendary_actions.name: Call Thunder (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.description: Abigor targets a hammer that it can see within 60 feet to let out a thunderous roar. Creatures within a 10-foot-radius sphere centered on the hammer must make a DC 22 Constitution saving throw, taking 26 (4d12) thunder damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

traits.name: Arcane Ward
traits.description: The abjurer has a magical ward that has 30 hit points. Whenever the abjurer takes damage, the ward takes the damage instead. If the ward is reduced to 0 hit points, the abjurer takes any remaining damage. When the abjurer casts an abjuration spell of 1st level or higher, the ward regains a number of hit points equal to twice the level of the spell.

actions.name: Quarterstaff
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 2 (1d6 - 1) bludgeoning damage, or 3 (1d8 - 1) bludgeoning damage if used with two hands.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.header: The abjurer is a 13th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save DC 16, +8 to hit with spell attacks). The abjurer has the following wizard spells prepared:

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The abjurer makes three Arcane Burst attacks.

actions.name: Arcane Burst
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Spell Attack +8 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft., one target. 20 (3d10 + 4) force damage.

actions.name: Force Blast
actions.description: Each creature in a 20-foot cube originating from the abjurer must make a DC 16 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 36 (8d8) force damage and is pushed up to 10 feet away from the abjurer. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and isn't pushed.

reactions.name: Arcane Ward {@recharge 4}
reactions.description: When the abjurer or a creature it can see within 30 feet of it takes damage, the abjurer magically creates a protective barrier around itself or the other creature. The barrier reduces the damage to the protected creature by 26 (4d10 + 4), to a minimum of 0, and then vanishes.

traits.description: The aboleth can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Eldritch Restoration
traits.description: If destroyed, the aboleth gains a new body in 5d10 days, reviving with all its Hit Points in the Far Realm or another location chosen by the DM.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day, or 4/Day in Lair)
traits.description: If the aboleth fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

The target is cursed. Until the curse ends, the target's skin becomes slimy, the target can breathe air and water, and it can't regain Hit Points unless it is underwater. While the cursed creature is outside a body of water, the creature takes 6 (1d12) Acid damage at the end of every 10 minutes unless moisture is applied to its skin before those minutes have passed.

traits.name: Probing Telepathy
traits.description: If a creature the aboleth can see communicates telepathically with the aboleth, the aboleth learns the creature's greatest desires.

actions.description: The aboleth makes two Tentacle attacks and uses either Consume Memories or Dominate Mind if available.

actions.name: Consume Memories
actions.description: int DC 16, one creature within 30 feet that is Charmed or Grappled by the aboleth. 10 (3d6) Psychic damage. Half damage. The aboleth gains the target's memories if the target is a Humanoid and is reduced to 0 Hit Points by this action.

actions.name: Dominate Mind (2/Day)
actions.description: wis DC 16, one creature the aboleth can see within 30 feet. The target has the Charmed condition until the aboleth dies or is on a different plane of existence from the target. While Charmed, the target acts as an ally to the aboleth and is under its control while within 60 feet of it. In addition, the aboleth and the target can communicate telepathically with each other over any distance. The target repeats the save whenever it takes damage as well as after every 24 hours it spends at least 1 mile away from the aboleth, ending the effect on itself on a success.

legendary_actions.name: Lash
legendary_actions.description: The aboleth makes one Tentacle attack.

legendary_actions.name: Psychic Drain
legendary_actions.description: If the aboleth has at least one creature Charmed or Grappled, it uses Consume Memories and regains 5 (1d10) Hit Points.

traits.name: Abolethic Vessel
traits.description: The spawn must obey its aboleth master.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.description: The spawn can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Water Dependency
traits.description: The spawn takes 6 (1d12) acid damage every 10 minutes it goes without being immersed in water.

actions.name: Multiattack

actions.name: Spear

actions.name: Tentacle
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. The target is grappled (escape DC 14) and takes 9 (2d8) psychic damage at the start of each of its turns until the grapple ends. The spawn has four tentacles, each of which can grapple one creature.

actions.name: Psychic Lash
actions.description: Ranged Spell Attack +7 to hit, range 120 ft., one creature. 18 (4d8) psychic damage.

traits.name: Fear of Fire

actions.name: Multiattack

actions.name: Claw

actions.name: Ice Throw
actions.description: r +11, range 60/240 ft. 12 (2d4 + 7) Bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) Cold damage.

actions.name: Chilling Gaze
actions.description: con DC 18, one creature the yeti can see within 30 feet. 21 (6d6) Cold damage, and the target has the Paralyzed condition until the start of the yeti's next turn unless the target has Immunity to Cold damage. The target is immune to this yeti's Chilling Gaze for 1 hour.

actions.name: Cold Breath {@recharge}
actions.description: con DC 18, each creature in a 30-foot Cone [Area of Effect]. 45 (10d8) Cold damage. Half damage.

traits.name: Bad Flier
traits.description: The abyssal chicken falls at the end of a turn if it's airborne and the only thing holding it aloft is its flying speed.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The abyssal chicken makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its claws.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.

actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 5 (1d6 + 2) slashing damage.

actions.name: Bite

traits.name: Special Equipment
traits.description: Acererak carries the Staff of the Forgotten One. He wears a Talisman of the Sphere and has a Sphere of Annihilation under his control.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.description: If Acererak fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Rejuvenation
traits.description: Acererak's body turns to dust when he drops to 0 hit points, and his equipment is left behind. Acererak gains a new body after 1d10 days, regaining all his hit points and becoming active again. The new body appears within 5 feet of Acererak's phylactery, the location of which is hidden.

traits.name: Turn Resistance
traits.description: Acererak has advantage on saving throws against any effect that turns undead.

actions.name: Paralyzing Touch
actions.description: Melee Spell Attack +15 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. 10 (3d6) cold damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 20 Constitution saving throw or be paralyzed for 1 minute. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

actions.name: Staff (+3 Quarterstaff)
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 7 (1d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus 10 (3d6) necrotic damage, or 8 (1d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus 10 (3d6) necrotic damage when used with two hands.

actions.name: Invoke Curse
actions.description: While holding the Staff of the Forgotten One, Acererak expends 1 charge from it and targets one creature he can see within 60 feet of him. The target must succeed on a DC 23 Constitution saving throw or be cursed. Until the curse is ended, the target can't regain hit points and has vulnerability to necrotic damage. Greater restoration, remove curse, or similar magic ends the curse on the target.

legendary_actions.name: At-Will Spell
legendary_actions.description: Acererak casts one of his at-will spells.

legendary_actions.name: Melee Attack
legendary_actions.description: Acererak uses Paralyzing Touch or makes one melee attack with his staff.

legendary_actions.name: Frightening Gaze (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.description: Acererak fixes his gaze on one creature he can see within 10 feet of him. The target must succeed on a DC 20 Wisdom saving throw against this magic or become frightened for 1 minute. The frightened target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a target's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the target its immune to Acererak's gaze for the next 24 hours.

legendary_actions.name: Talisman of the Sphere (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.description: Acererak uses his Talisman of the Sphere to move the Sphere of Annihilation under his control up to 90 feet.

legendary_actions.name: Disrupt Life (Costs 3 Actions)
legendary_actions.description: Each creature within 20 feet of Acererak must make a DC 20 Constitution saving throw against this magic, taking 42 (12d6) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

actions.name: Talons
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 8 (1d8 + 4) slashing damage.

bonus_actions.name: Spring Attack
bonus_actions.description: The achaierai takes the Disengage action.

reactions.name: Defensive Cloud

All creatures in the cloud take 7 (2d6) poison damage and must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 1 minute. While poisoned the target is confused as if from a confusion spell. At the end of its turns, the affected target can repeat the Constitution saving throw. If it succeeds the confusion ends. Achaierai are immune to the effects of this cloud.

actions.name: Club
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 2 (1d4) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Change Shape (2/Day)

Amble reverts to their true form if they die or fall unconscious. Amble can revert to their true form using a bonus action on their turn. Amble's game statistics are replaced by the statistics of the beast, but they retain their alignment, personality, and Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores. Amble also retains all their skill and saving throw proficiencies, in addition to gaining those of the creature. If the creature has the same proficiency as Amble and the bonus in its stat block is higher, use the creature's bonus instead of Amble's. When Amble transforms, they assume the beast's hit points and Hit Dice. When Amble reverts to their normal form, they return to the number of hit points they had before they transformed. However, if Amble reverts as a result of dropping to 0 hit points, any excess damage carries over their normal form. Amble can't cast spells, and their ability to speak or take any action that requires hands is limited to the capabilities of their beast form. Transforming doesn't break Amble's concentration on a spell they've already cast however, or prevent them from taking actions that are part of a spell.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: Arasta has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.description: Arasta can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

traits.name: Web Walker
traits.description: Arasta ignores movement restrictions caused by webbing.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Arasta makes three attacks: one with her bite and two with her claws.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +14 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. 20 (3d8 + 7) piercing damage, and the target must make a DC 21 Constitution saving throw, taking 32 (5d12) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. If the damage reduces the target to 0 hit points, the target is stable but poisoned for 1 hour, even after regaining hit points, and is paralyzed while poisoned in this way.

actions.name: Claws
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +14 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 17 (3d6 + 7) slashing damage.

actions.name: Web of Hair {@recharge 4}
actions.description: Arasta unleashes her hair in the form of webbing that fills a 30-foot cube next to her. The web is 3, its area is lightly obscured, and it lasts for 1 minute. Any creature that moves into the web or that starts its turn there must make a DC 21 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the creature is restrained while in the web. A creature can use an action to make a DC 21 Strength check. On a success, it can free itself or a creature within 5 feet of it that is restrained by the web. This webbing is immune to all damage except magical fire. A 5-foot cube of the web is destroyed if it takes at least 20 fire damage from a spell or other magical source on a single turn.

legendary_actions.name: Claws
legendary_actions.description: Arasta makes one attack with her claws.

legendary_actions.name: Swarm (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.description: Arasta causes two swarms of spiders to appear in unoccupied spaces within 5 feet of her.

legendary_actions.name: Toxic Web (Costs 3 Actions)
legendary_actions.description: Each creature restrained by Arasta's Web of Hair takes 18 (4d8) poison damage.

traits.name: Fiendish Restoration
traits.description: If the arcanaloth dies outside Gehenna, its body dissolves into ichor, and it gains a new body instantly and revives with all its Hit Points in Gehenna.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The arcanaloth has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Soul Tome
traits.description: The arcanaloth has a magic tome. While holding or carrying the tome, the arcanaloth can use its Banishing Claw action. The tome has AC 17; HP 35; and Immunity to Necrotic, Poison, and Psychic damage. The tome regains all its Hit Points at the end of every turn, but it turns to dust if reduced to 0 Hit Points or when the arcanaloth dies. If the tome is destroyed, the arcanaloth can create a new one when it finishes a Short Rest or Long Rest.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The arcanaloth makes three Fiendish Burst attacks. It can replace one attack with a Banishing Claw attack.

actions.name: Fiendish Burst
actions.description: m,r +9, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft. 31 (4d12 + 5) Necrotic damage.

actions.name: Banishing Claw (Requires Soul Tome)
actions.description: m +9, reach 5 ft. 10 (2d4 + 5) Slashing damage plus 19 (3d12) Psychic damage. If the target is a creature, it is subjected to the following effect. cha DC 17. The target is trapped in a demiplane inside the Soul Tome. While trapped there, the target has the Incapacitated condition. At the end of each of its turns, the target repeats the save, escaping the tome on a success. When the target escapes, it appears in the space it left or, if that space is occupied, the nearest unoccupied space. If the target fails three of these saves while in the demiplane, it becomes bound to the tome and can escape only if the tome is reduced to 0 Hit Points.

bonus_actions.name: Teleport
bonus_actions.description: The arcanaloth teleports up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.header: The arcanaloth casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 17):

spellcasting.name: Counterspell
spellcasting.header: The arcanaloth casts Counterspell in response to that spell's trigger, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (4/Day, or 5/Day in Lair)
traits.description: If the hag fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The hag has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Spiteful Escape
traits.description: When the hag drops to 0 Hit Points, it dies only if it is within 30 feet of its anathema (a thing the DM chooses as the hag's most hated thing). Otherwise, the hag drops to 1 Hit Point and teleports to a harmless demiplane, and it can't return to the plane it left for 2d6 days. When the hag teleports away, each creature within 60 feet of the space it left is cursed. Until the curse ends, a creature has Disadvantage on ability checks and saving throws, and the hag knows its location anywhere in the multiverse.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The hag makes two Spectral Claw attacks and uses Crackling Wave.

actions.name: Spectral Claw
actions.description: m,r +14, reach 10 ft. or range 60 ft. 17 (3d6 + 7) Force damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Prone condition.

actions.name: Crackling Wave
actions.description: dex DC 22, each creature in a 60-foot Cone [Area of Effect]. 32 (5d12) Lightning damage. Half damage. The target is cursed until the end of the hag's next turn. The target can't take Reactions until the curse ends.

bonus_actions.name: Witch Strike
bonus_actions.description: Each creature cursed by the hag and within 60 feet of it takes 14 (4d6) Lightning damage.

legendary_actions.name: Hag's Swipe
legendary_actions.description: The hag makes one Spectral Claw attack.

legendary_actions.name: Malicious Magic
legendary_actions.description: The hag uses Spellcasting to cast Dimension Door or Hypnotic Pattern. The hag can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.

spellcasting.name: Coven Magic
spellcasting.header: While within 30 feet of at least two hag allies, the hag can cast one of the following spells, requiring no Material components, using the spell's normal casting time, and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 19): Augury, Find Familiar, Identify, Locate Object, Scrying, or Unseen Servant. The hag must finish a Long Rest before using this trait to cast that spell again.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.header: The hag casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 22):

spellcasting.name: Tongue Twister
spellcasting.header: The hag casts Counterspell in response to that spell's trigger, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting. If the target fails its saving throw, it is cursed until the end of its next turn. Until the curse ends, the target can't cast spells with a Verbal component, and when it speaks, it says the opposite of what it means.

traits.name: Enigmatic Mind
traits.description: The archaic's mind can't be read, creatures can communicate telepathically with the archaic only if it allows, and magic can't determine whether the archaic is lying.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.description: If the archaic fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Unusual Nature
traits.description: The archaic doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The archaic makes two Force Strike attacks. It can also use Gravity Shift, if available.

actions.name: Force Strike
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Spell Attack +14 to hit, reach 15 ft. or range 120 ft., one target. 19 (2d10 + 8) force damage, and the target is pulled up to 10 feet toward the archaic or pushed 10 feet away from it, as the archaic chooses.

actions.name: Gravity Shift {@recharge 5}
actions.description: The archaic reverses gravity for one creature it can see within 100 feet of itself. The creature must succeed on a DC 22 Wisdom saving throw or fall 100 feet upward. If the falling creature encounters a solid object (such as a ceiling) in this fall, it strikes the object just as it would during a downward fall. If the creature reaches the top of the area without striking anything, it hovers there until the start of the archaic's next turn, at which time gravity returns to normal and the creature falls.

actions.name: Teleport
actions.description: The archaic teleports to an unoccupied space that it can see within 120 feet of itself.

reactions.name: Spell Mimicry (1/Day)
reactions.description: Immediately after a creature the archaic can see casts a spell of 5th level or lower, that creature must succeed on a DC 22 Charisma saving throw, or the archaic immediately casts the same spell at the same level (+14 to hit with spell attacks, spell save DC 22), requiring no material components and choosing the spell's targets.

legendary_actions.name: Strike
legendary_actions.description: The archaic makes one Force Strike attack.

legendary_actions.name: Teleport
legendary_actions.description: The archaic uses Teleport.

legendary_actions.name: Unravel Magic (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.description: The archaic targets one creature it can see within 120 feet of itself. The target must succeed on a DC 22 Constitution saving throw or take 35 (10d6) force damage, and each spell of 5th level or lower on the target ends.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.header: The archaic casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 22):

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The archdruid makes three Staff or Wildfire attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Spellcasting.

actions.name: Staff
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 5 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage plus 21 (6d6) poison damage.

actions.name: Wildfire
actions.description: Ranged Spell Attack +9 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. 26 (6d6 + 5) fire damage, and the target is blinded until the start of the druid's next turn.

bonus_actions.name: Change Shape (2/Day)
bonus_actions.description: The archdruid magically transforms into a Beast or an Elemental with a challenge rating of 6 or less and can remain in that form for up to 9 hours. The archdruid can choose whether its equipment falls to the ground, melds with its new form, or is worn by the new form. The archdruid reverts to its true form if it dies or falls unconscious. The archdruid can revert to its true form using a bonus action. While in a new form, the archdruid's stat block is replaced by the stat block of that form, except the archdruid keeps its current hit points, its hit point maximum, this bonus action, its languages and ability to speak, and its Spellcasting action. The new form's attacks count as magical for the purpose of overcoming resistances and immunity to nonmagical attacks.

traits.description: The archelon can breathe air and water.

actions.description: The archelon makes two Bite attacks.

actions.description: m +6, reach 5 ft. 14 (3d6 + 4) Piercing damage.

actions.description: The archer makes two Shortsword or Longbow attacks.

actions.name: Shortsword
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Longbow
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack +6 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. 8 (1d8 + 4) piercing damage.

bonus_actions.name: Archer's Eye (3/Day)
bonus_actions.description: Immediately after making an attack roll or a damage roll with a ranged weapon, the archer can roll a d10 and add the number rolled to the total.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The archmage makes four Arcane Burst attacks.

actions.name: Arcane Burst
actions.description: m,r +9, reach 5 ft. or range 150 ft. 27 (4d10 + 5) Force damage.

spellcasting.header: The mage casts Misty Step, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

spellcasting.name: Protective Magic (3/Day)
spellcasting.header: The archmage casts Counterspell or Shield in response to the spell's trigger, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

traits.name: Magic Resistance

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The archon makes one Hooves attack and one Radiant Lance attack.

actions.name: Hooves
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 20 (4d6 + 6) bludgeoning damage plus 10 (3d6) radiant damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it must succeed on a DC 19 Strength saving throw or have the prone condition.

actions.name: Radiant Lance
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 12 (1d12 + 6) piercing damage plus 28 (8d6) radiant damage, and the target is marked until the start of the archon's next turn. While it is marked, the target has disadvantage on attack rolls against creatures other than the archon.

reactions.name: Archon's Pursuit
reactions.description: When a creature marked by the archon's Radiant Lance ends its turn within 120 feet of the archon, the archon teleports to an unoccupied space it can see within 5 feet of the creature.

reactions.name: Haunting Radiance
reactions.description: Immediately after a creature within 120 feet of the archon forces it to make a saving throw, the archon responds with a burst of light. The creature must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or have the blinded condition until the end of the creature's next turn.

reactions.name: Parry
reactions.description: The archon adds 5 to its AC against one melee attack that would hit it, provided it can see the attacker.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.header: The archon casts one of the following spells, using Charisma as the spellcasting ability:

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The archon has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Mount
traits.description: If the archon isn't mounted, it can use a bonus action to magically teleport onto the creature serving as its mount, provided the archon and its mount are on the same plane of existence. When it teleports, the archon appears astride the mount, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying. While mounted and not incapacitated, the archon can't be surprised, and both it and its mount have advantage on Dexterity saving throws. If the archon is reduced to 0 hit points while riding its mount, the mount is reduced to 0 hit points as well.

traits.name: Radiant Rebirth (Recharges after a Long Rest)
traits.description: If the archon is reduced to 0 hit points, it regains 30 hit points and springs back to its feet with a burst of radiance. Each creature of the archon's choice within 30 feet of it must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw, or the creature takes 13 (3d8) radiant damage and is blinded until the start of the archon's turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The archon makes two attacks with its radiant spear.

actions.name: Radiant Spear
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 12 (2d6 + 5) piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) radiant damage.

legendary_actions.name: Attack
legendary_actions.description: The archon makes a radiant spear attack or casts guiding bolt.

legendary_actions.name: Coordinated Assault (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.description: The archon makes a radiant spear attack, and then its mount can use its reaction to make a melee weapon attack.

legendary_actions.name: Return to Nyx (Costs 3 Actions)
legendary_actions.description: The archon causes a corpse it can see within 30 feet of it to burst into a shower of radiant stars leaving no trace of it behind. Everything it is wearing or carrying remains. Each creature within 10 feet of the corpse when it bursts must succeed on a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw or take 22 (4d10) radiant damage.

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
spellcasting.header: The archon's spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 17, +9 to hit with spell attacks). The archon can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

traits.name: Angelic Weapons
traits.description: The archon's weapon attacks are magical. When the archon hits with any weapon, the weapon deals an extra 3d8 radiant damage (included in the attack).

traits.name: Axiomatic Mind
traits.description: The archon can't be compelled to act in a manner contrary to its nature or its understanding of justice.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The archon has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: One Being
traits.description: Though it appears as a humanoid creature riding a mount, an archon is a single being. The "rider" can't be dismounted, and no other means can separate the two portions of the archon's being short of its death.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The archon makes two attacks: one with its sword and one with its claws.

actions.name: Sword
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 8 (1d8 + 4) slashing damage plus 13 (3d8) radiant damage.

actions.name: Claws
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage plus 13 (3d8) radiant damage.

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
spellcasting.header: The archon's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 17). The archon can innately cast the following spells, requiring only verbal components:

traits.name: Eye of the Law
traits.description: As a bonus action, the archon can target a creature it can see within 120 feet of it and determine which laws that creature has broken in the last 24 hours.

traits.name: Mount
traits.description: If the archon isn't mounted, it can use a bonus action to magically teleport onto the creature serving as its mount, provided the archon and its mount are on the same plane of existence. When it teleports, the archon appears astride the mount along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying. While mounted and not incapacitated, the archon can't be surprised, and both it and its mount gain advantage on Dexterity saving throws. If the archon is reduced to 0 hit points while riding its mount, the mount is reduced to 0 hit points as well.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The archon makes two Hammer of Justice attacks.

actions.name: Hammer of Justice
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 12 (2d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage plus 18 (4d8) force damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 18 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

actions.name: Pacifying Presence
actions.description: Each creature of the archon's choice that the archon can see within 120 feet of it must succeed on a DC 18 Wisdom saving throw, or else the target drops any weapons it is holding, ends its concentration on any spells or other effects, and becomes charmed by the archon for 1 minute. The charmed creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to the archon's Pacifying Presence for the next 24 hours.

legendary_actions.name: Rejoin Mount
legendary_actions.description: If the archon isn't mounted, it magically teleports to its steed and mounts it as long as the archon and its steed are on the same plane of existence.

legendary_actions.name: Smite (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.description: The archon makes a Hammer of Justice attack, and then its mount can use its reaction to make a melee weapon attack.

legendary_actions.name: Detention (Costs 3 Actions)
legendary_actions.description: The archon targets a creature it can see within 60 feet of it. The target must succeed on a DC 18 Charisma saving throw or be magically teleported to a harmless demiplane until the end of the archon's next turn, whereupon the target reappears in the space it left or the nearest unoccupied space if that space is occupied.

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
spellcasting.header: The archon's innate spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 18, +10 to hit with spell attacks). The archon can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The archpriest makes three Radiant Burst attacks.

actions.name: Radiant Burst
actions.description: m,r +9, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft. 27 (4d10 + 5) Radiant damage.

actions.name: Holy Word {@recharge 4}
actions.description: wis DC 17, each enemy in a 20-foot Emanation [Area of Effect] originating from the archpriest. 21 (6d6) Radiant damage, and the target has the Stunned condition until the end of the archpriest's next turn. Half damage only.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.header: The archpriest casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 17):

spellcasting.name: Divine Aid (3/Day)
spellcasting.header: The priest casts Bless, Dispel Magic, Healing Word, or Lesser Restoration, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

traits.name: Flyby
traits.description: The arclight phoenix doesn't provoke an opportunity attack when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

traits.name: Grounded Lightning
traits.description: The first time on a turn that the arclight phoenix touches the ground, it takes 11 (2d10) force damage.

traits.name: Illumination
traits.description: The arclight phoenix sheds bright light in a 15-foot radius and dim light for an additional 15 feet.

traits.name: Lightning Form
traits.description: The arclight phoenix can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing. A creature that touches the phoenix or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 9 (2d8) lightning damage. In addition, the arclight phoenix can enter a hostile creature's space and stop there. The first time it enters a creature's space on a turn, that creature takes 9 (2d8) lightning damage.

traits.name: Crackling Death
traits.description: When the arclight phoenix dies, it explodes. Each creature within 30 feet of it must make a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw, taking 36 (8d8) lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The explosion destroys the phoenix but leaves behind a Tiny, warm egg with a mizzium shell. The egg contains the embryo of a new arclight phoenix. It hatches when it is in the area of a spell that deals lightning damage, or if a creature touches the egg and expends spell slots whose combined levels equal 13 or more. When it hatches, the egg releases a new arclight phoenix that appears in the egg's space.

actions.name: Arclight Touch
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 27 (6d8) lightning damage, and lightning jumps from the target to one creature of the phoenix's choice that it can see within 30 feet of the target. That second creature must succeed on a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw or take 27 (6d8) lightning damage.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.header: Arcturia is an 18th-level spellcaster. Her spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save DC 20, +12 to hit with spell attacks). Arcturia can cast alter self at will and has the following wizard spells prepared:

traits.name: Infernal Tracker
traits.description: Aribeth knows the distance to and direction of any creature that has broken a pact with Mephistopheles, even if the creature and Aribeth are on different planes of existence.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: Aribeth has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Nightmare
traits.description: Aribeth is accompanied by a nightmare. The nightmare allows Aribeth to use it as a mount.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.description: Aribeth regains 20 hit points at the start of her turn. If Aribeth takes radiant damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of Aribeth's next turn. Aribeth's body is destroyed only if she starts her turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate.

traits.name: Shadows
traits.description: Three shadows hide within the saddle of Aribeth's nightmare. These shadows only come out if there is a creature within 30 feet that is at 0 hit points. When that happens, a shadow emerges and attacks the creature in order to make it fail a death saving throw. It continues to do so until the creature is dead.

traits.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
traits.description: While in sunlight, Aribeth has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Aribeth makes three Void or Unholy Strike attacks.

actions.name: Void
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 7 (1d8 + 3) slashing damage or 8 (1d10 + 3) slashing damage if used with two hands, plus 7 (2d6) necrotic damage. A creature reduced to 0 hit points from damage dealt by the sword Void dies and can't be revived by any means short of a wish spell.

actions.name: Unholy Strike
actions.description: Ranged Spell Attack +7 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. 12 (2d8 + 3) necrotic damage.

reactions.name: Parry
reactions.description: Aribeth adds 4 to her AC against one melee attack that would hit her. To do so, Aribeth must see the attacker and be wielding a melee weapon.

traits.name: Hand of Vecna
traits.description: The Hand of Vecna has 8 charges and regains 1d4 + 4 expended charges daily at dawn. Arkhan can cast the following spells from the hand by expending the specified number of charges (spell save DC 18): finger of death (5 charges), sleep (1 charge), slow (2 charges), and teleport (3 charges).

traits.name: Special Equipment
traits.description: Arkhan wields Fane-Eater and wears a suit of Obsidian Flint Dragon Plate. The armor gives Arkhan advantage on ability checks and saving throws made to avoid or end the grappled condition on him.

actions.name: Multiattack

actions.name: Fane-Eater (Battleaxe)

If the target is a creature and Arkhan rolls a 20 on the attack roll, the creature takes an extra 9 (2d8) necrotic damage, and Arkhan regains an amount of hit points equal to the necrotic damage dealt.

actions.name: Javelin
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack +10 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft., one target. 8 (1d6 + 5) piercing damage, plus 4 piercing damage and 9 (2d8) cold damage if the javelin was used to make a melee attack.
