legendary_actions.name: Attack
legendary_actions.description: The greatwyrm makes one Claw or Tail attack.

legendary_actions.name: Wing Attack (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.description: The greatwyrm beats its wings. Each creature within 30 feet of it must succeed on a DC 26 Dexterity saving throw or take 17 (2d6 + 10) bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone. The greatwyrm can then fly up to half its flying speed.

legendary_actions.name: Arcane Spear (Costs 3 Actions)
legendary_actions.description: The greatwyrm creates four spears of magical force. Each spear hits a creature of the greatwyrm's choice it can see within 120 feet of it, dealing 12 (1d8 + 8) force damage to its target, then disappears.

name: Blue Guard Drake
languages: understands Draconic but can't speak it

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The drake attacks twice, once with its bite and once with its tail.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Tail
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 6 (1d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The slaad has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.description: The slaad regains 10 Hit Points at the start of each of its turns if it has at least 1 Hit Point.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The slaad makes three Mutating Claw attacks.

actions.name: Mutating Claw
actions.description: m +8, reach 10 ft. 12 (2d6 + 5) Slashing damage plus 3 (1d6) Poison damage. If the target is a Humanoid not cursed by a slaad, it is subjected to the following effect. con DC 15. The target is cursed. The cursed target can't regain Hit Points, and its Hit Point maximum decreases by 10 (3d6) after every 24 hours and doesn't return to normal after finishing a Long Rest. If the curse reduces the target's Hit Point maximum to 0, the curse ends, and instead of dying, the target instantly transforms into a Red Slaad or, if it can cast spells of level 3 or higher, a Green Slaad. Only a Wish spell can reverse this transformation.

traits.name: Bloodied Fury
traits.description: While Bloodied, the boar has Advantage on attack rolls.

actions.name: Gore
actions.description: m +3, reach 5 ft. 4 (1d6 + 1) Piercing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature and the boar moved 20+ feet straight toward it immediately before the hit, the target takes an extra 3 (1d6) Piercing damage and has the Prone condition.

name: Bodak
languages: the languages it knew in life

traits.name: Death Gaze
traits.description: When a creature that can see the bodak's eyes starts its turn within 30 feet of the bodak, the bodak can force it to make a DC 13 Constitution saving throw if the bodak isn't incapacitated and can see the creature. If the saving throw fails by 5 or more, the creature is reduced to 0 hit points unless it is immune to the frightened condition. Otherwise, a creature takes 16 (3d10) psychic damage on a failed save. Unless surprised, a creature can avert its eyes to avoid the saving throw at the start of its turn. If the creature does so, it has disadvantage on attack rolls against the bodak until the start of its next turn. If the creature looks at the bodak in the meantime, that creature must immediately make the saving throw.

traits.name: Sunlight Hypersensitivity
traits.description: The bodak takes 5 radiant damage when it starts its turn in sunlight. While in sunlight, it has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks.

traits.name: Unusual Nature
traits.description: The bodak doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

actions.name: Fist
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 4 (1d4 + 2) bludgeoning damage plus 9 (2d8) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Withering Gaze
actions.description: One creature that the bodak can see within 60 feet of it must make a DC 13 Constitution saving throw, taking 22 (4d10) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

bonus_actions.name: Aura of Annihilation
bonus_actions.description: The bodak activates or deactivates this deathly aura. While active, the aura deals 5 necrotic damage to any creature that ends its turn within 30 feet of the bodak. Undead and Fiends ignore this effect.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.description: If Bodhi fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.description: Bodhi regains 20 hit points at the start of her turn if she has at least 1 hit point and isn't in sunlight. If she takes radiant damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of her next turn.

traits.name: Rejuvenation
traits.description: If Bodhi is destroyed, her body immediately appears in her resting place. She is paralyzed until she regains at least 1 hit point. After spending 24 hours in her resting place with 0 hit points, she regains 1 hit point. While paralyzed in this manner, if a creature within 60 feet says her name 9 times, Bodhi is permanently destroyed.

traits.name: Sneak Attack (1/Turn)
traits.description: Bodhi deals an extra 28 (8d6) damage when she hits a target with a weapon attack and has advantage on the attack roll, or when the target is within 5 feet of an ally of Bodhi that isn't incapacitated and Bodhi doesn't have disadvantage on the attack roll.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.description: Bodhi can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

traits.name: Summoned By Name (1/Day)
traits.description: If a creature says Bodhi Irenicus's full name 9 times in a row, Bodhi hears her name and becomes aware of the creature. Bodhi knows the exact location and name of the creature that spoke her name. She can then choose, as a free action, to teleport to a location adjacent to the creature. She must choose to do this within 1 minute of hearing her name. This power works even if the creature is on a different plane of existence. 1 minute after teleporting, Bodhi teleports back to where she was located when she heard her name spoken. This occurs even if Bodhi is unwilling and even if she is in an antimagic effect.

traits.name: Vampire Weaknesses
traits.description: Bodhi Irenicus has the following flaws: Elvish Song. Bodhi can't abide a song performed in the elvish language. A creature that can speak the elvish language can use an action to sing an elven song. If Bodhi is within 60 feet of the singer and can hear the song, she has disadvantage on attacks and saving throws. Stake to the Heart. If a piercing weapon made of wood is driven into Bodhi's heart while she is incapacitated in her resting place, Bodhi is paralyzed until the stake is removed. Sunlight Hypersensitivity. Bodhi takes 20 radiant damage when she starts her turn in sunlight. While in sunlight, she has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks.

actions.name: Multiattack (Vampire Form Only)
actions.description: Bodhi makes three Unarmed Strike attacks, one of which can be a Bite attack instead.

actions.name: Unarmed Strike (Vampire Form Only)
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. 9 (1d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage. Instead of dealing damage, Bodhi can grapple a Medium-sized or smaller target (escape DC 18).

actions.name: Bite (Panther or Vampire Form Only)
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. 8 (1d6 + 5) piercing damage plus 14 (4d6) necrotic damage. The target's hit point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the necrotic damage taken, and Bodhi regains hit points equal to that amount. The reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest. The target dies if this effect reduces its hit point maximum to 0. A Humanoid slain in this way and then buried in the ground rises the following night as a vampire spawn under Bodhi's control.

actions.name: Change Shape
actions.description: If Bodhi isn't in sunlight, she can polymorph into a Medium panther or back into her true form. While in panther form, Bodhi Irenicus can't speak, her walking speed is 40 feet, and she has a climb speed of 30 feet. Her statistics, other than her size and speed, are unchanged. Anything she is wearing transforms with her, but nothing she is carrying does. She reverts to her true form if she dies.

actions.name: Charm
actions.description: Bodhi targets one Humanoid she can see within 30 feet of her. If the target can see Bodhi, the target must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw or be charmed by Bodhi. The charmed target regards Bodhi as a trusted friend to be heeded and protected. Although the target isn't under Bodhi's control, it takes Bodhi's requests or actions in the most favorable way it can. Each time Bodhi or her allies do anything harmful to the target, it can repeat the saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success. Otherwise, the effect lasts 24 hours or until Bodhi is destroyed, is on a different plane of existence than the target, or takes a bonus action to end the effect.

legendary_actions.name: Move
legendary_actions.description: Bodhi moves up to her speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

legendary_actions.name: Unarmed Strike
legendary_actions.description: Bodhi makes one Unarmed Strike.

legendary_actions.name: Bite (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.description: Bodhi makes one Bite attack.

traits.name: Podling Link
traits.description: The plant can see through and communicate telepathically with any of its podlings within 10 miles of it.

traits.name: Rejuvenation
traits.description: When the plant dies, it returns to life in the place where it died 1d12 months later, unless the ground where it took root is sown with salt or soaked with poison.

traits.name: Unusual Nature
traits.description: The plant doesn't require sleep.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The plant makes three Vine Lash attacks.

actions.name: Vine Lash
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +7 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage. If the target is a creature, it is grappled (escape DC 15). Until the grapple ends, the target is restrained. The plant has four vines, each of which can grapple one target.

actions.name: Entrapping Pod
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one Medium or smaller creature grappled by the plant. 22 (4d8 + 4) acid damage, and the target is pulled into the plant's space and enveloped by the pod, and the grapple ends. While enveloped, the target is restrained, and it has total cover against attacks and effects originating outside the pod. The enveloped target must also immediately succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or be stunned by the plant's sapping enzymes until it is removed from the pod or the plant dies. The enveloped target doesn't require air and gains 1 level of exhaustion for each hour it spends in the pod. If the target dies while enveloped, it immediately emerges from the pod as a living podling, wearing or carrying all of the original creature's equipment. As an action, a creature within 5 feet of the bodytaker plant that is outside the pod can open the pod and pull the target free with a successful DC 15 Strength check. If the plant dies, the target is no longer restrained and can escape from the pod by spending 10 feet of movement, exiting prone. The plant has one pod, which can envelop one creature at a time.

actions.name: Pummel
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +1 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 2 (1d6 - 1) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Oil Puddle
actions.description: The boggle creates a puddle of nonflammable oil. The puddle is 1 inch deep and covers the ground in the boggle's space. The puddle is 3 for all creatures except boggles and lasts for 1 hour. The oil has one of the following additional effects of the boggle's choice: Slippery Oil. Any non-boggle creature that enters the puddle or starts its turn there must succeed on a DC 11 Dexterity saving throw or fall prone. Sticky Oil. Any non-boggle creature that enters the puddle or starts its turn there must succeed on a DC 11 Strength saving throw or be restrained. On its turn, a creature can use an action to try to extricate itself, ending the effect and moving into the nearest unoccupied space of its choice with a successful DC 11 Strength check.

bonus_actions.name: Boggle Oil
bonus_actions.description: The boggle excretes nonflammable oil from its pores, giving itself one of the following benefits of its choice until it uses this bonus action again: Slippery Oil. The boggle has advantage on Dexterity (Acrobatics) checks made to escape bonds and end grapples, and it can move through openings large enough for a Tiny creature without squeezing. Sticky Oil. The boggle has advantage on Strength (Athletics) checks made to grapple and any ability check made to maintain a hold on another creature, a surface, or an object. The boggle can also climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

bonus_actions.name: Dimensional Rift
bonus_actions.description: The boggle creates an invisible and immobile rift within an opening or frame it can see within 5 feet of it, provided that the space is no bigger than 10 feet on any side. The dimensional rift bridges the distance between that space and a point within 30 feet of it that the boggle can see or specify by distance and direction (such as "30 feet straight up"). While next to the rift, the boggle can see through it and is considered to be next to the destination as well, and anything the boggle puts through the rift (including a portion of its body) emerges at the destination. Only the boggle can use the rift, and it lasts until the end of the boggle's next turn.

traits.name: Diabolical Restoration
traits.description: If the devil dies outside the Nine Hells, its body disappears in sulfurous smoke, and it gains a new body instantly, reviving with all its Hit Points somewhere in the Nine Hells.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The devil has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The devil makes two Claw attacks and one Infernal Sting attack.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: m +8, reach 10 ft. 13 (2d8 + 4) Slashing damage.

actions.name: Infernal Sting
actions.description: m +8, reach 10 ft. 15 (2d10 + 4) Piercing damage plus 18 (4d8) Poison damage, and the target has the Poisoned condition until the start of the devil's next turn. While Poisoned, the target can't regain Hit Points.

traits.name: Commander of Bones
traits.description: As a bonus action, the knight can target one skeleton or zombie it can see within 30 feet of it. The target must make a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the target must obey the knight's commands until the knight dies or until the knight releases it as a bonus action. The knight can command up to twelve undead at a time this way.

traits.name: Master of the Pallid Banner
traits.description: While within 60 feet of the knight, any undead ally of the knight has advantage on saving throws against any effect that turns undead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The knight attacks twice with one of its weapons.

actions.name: Greatsword
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage.

actions.name: Longbow
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack +4 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. 5 (1d8 + 1) piercing damage.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.header: The knight is an 8th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 14, +6 to hit with spell attacks). It has the following paladin spells prepared:

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The naga makes two Bite attacks. It can replace any attack with a use of Serpentine Gaze.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: m +5, reach 10 ft. 10 (2d6 + 3) Piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) Necrotic damage.

actions.name: Serpentine Gaze
actions.description: wis DC 13, one creature the naga can see within 60 feet. 13 (3d6 + 3) Psychic damage, and the target has the Charmed condition until the start of the naga's next turn.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.header: The naga casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 13):

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +5 to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. 10 (2d6 + 3) piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) poison damage.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.header: The naga is a 5th-level spellcaster (spell save DC 12, +4 to hit with spell attacks) that needs only verbal components to cast its spells. Its spellcasting ability is Wisdom, and it has the following cleric spells prepared:

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +5 to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. 10 (2d6 + 3) piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) poison damage.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.header: The naga is a 5th-level spellcaster (spell save DC 12, +4 to hit with spell attacks) that needs only verbal components to cast its spells. Its spellcasting ability is Intelligence, and it has the following wizard spells prepared:

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The bone roc makes one Beak attack and two Talons attacks.

actions.name: Beak
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 14 (2d8 + 5) piercing damage.

actions.name: Talons
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 12 (2d6 + 5) slashing damage plus 10 (3d6) necrotic damage.

traits.name: Adhesive
traits.description: The bone whelk can cause Medium or smaller objects to adhere to it. A Medium or smaller creature that touches the bone whelk is grappled by it (escape DC 10).

traits.name: Death Scream
traits.description: When the bone whelk dies, it emits a blood-curdling shriek than can be heard out to a range of 120 feet. This shriek causes nonmagical, organic material within 10 feet of the bone whelk to rot. Each creature within 10 feet of the bone whelk when it dies takes 9 (2d8) necrotic damage.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.description: The bone whelk can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. 4 (1d8) piercing damage.

name: Boneclaw
languages: Common plus one language spoken by its master

traits.name: Rejuvenation
traits.description: While its master lives, a destroyed boneclaw gains a new body in 1d10 hours, with all its hit points. The new body appears within 1 mile of the boneclaw's master.

traits.name: Unusual Nature
traits.description: The boneclaw doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The boneclaw makes two Piercing Claw attacks.

actions.name: Piercing Claw
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +8 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. 20 (3d10 + 4) piercing damage plus 11 (2d10) necrotic damage. If the target is a creature, the boneclaw can pull the target up to 10 feet toward itself, and the target is grappled (escape DC 14). The boneclaw has two claws. While a claw grapples a target, the claw can attack only that target.

actions.name: Shadow Jump {@recharge 5}
actions.description: If the boneclaw is in dim light or darkness, each creature of the boneclaw's choice within 15 feet of it must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or take 34 (5d12 + 2) necrotic damage. The boneclaw then teleports up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space it can see. It can bring one creature it's grappling, teleporting that creature to an unoccupied space it can see within 5 feet of its destination. The destination spaces of this teleportation must be in dim light or darkness.

bonus_actions.name: Shadow Stealth
bonus_actions.description: While in dim light or darkness, the boneclaw takes the Hide action.

reactions.name: Deadly Reach
reactions.description: In response to a creature entering a space within 15 feet of it, the boneclaw makes one Piercing Claw attack against that creature.

name: Boneless
languages: understands the languages it knew in life but can't speak

traits.name: Compression
traits.description: The boneless can move through any opening at least 1 inch wide without squeezing. It can also squeeze to fit into a space that a Tiny creature could fit in.

traits.name: Unusual Nature
traits.description: The boneless doesn't require sleep.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The boneless makes two Slam attacks. If both attacks hit a Large or smaller creature, the creature is grappled (escape DC 13), and the boneless can use Crushing Embrace.

actions.name: Slam
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 5 (1d4 + 3) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Crushing Embrace
actions.description: The boneless wraps its body around a Large or smaller creature grappled by it. While the boneless is attached, the target is blinded and is unable to breathe. The target must succeed on a DC 13 Strength saving throw at the start of each of the boneless' turns or take 5 (1d4 + 3) bludgeoning damage. If something moves the target, the boneless moves with it. The boneless can detach itself by spending 5 feet of its movement. A creature, including the target, can use its action to try to detach the boneless and force it to move into the nearest unoccupied space, doing so with a successful DC 13 Strength check. When the boneless dies, it detaches from any creature it is attached to.

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.description: The Boontu monkey has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the boontu monkey's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +1 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 1 (1d4 - 1) piercing damage.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.header: The goblin can cast a randomly determined class=wizard once per day. Intelligence is its spellcasting ability (spell save DC 10, +2 to hit with spell attacks).

name: Booyahg Slave of the Great Old One

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.description: If Borborygmos fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Poor Depth Perception
traits.description: Borborygmos has disadvantage on any attack roll against a target more than 30 feet away.

traits.name: Siege Monster
traits.description: Borborygmos deals double damage to objects and structures.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Borborygmos can use his Frightful Presence. He also makes two attacks: one with his maul and one with his stomp.

actions.name: Maul
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +13 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 28 (6d6 + 7) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 21 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

actions.name: Stomp
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +13 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 18 (2d10 + 7) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Rock
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack +13 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. 29 (4d10 + 7) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Frightful Presence
actions.description: Each creature of Borborygmos's choice that is within 60 feet of him and can see or hear him must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened of him for 1 minute. The frightened creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to Borborygmos's Frightful Presence for the next 24 hours.

legendary_actions.name: Attack
legendary_actions.description: Borborygmos makes a weapon attack.

legendary_actions.name: Bellow (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.description: Borborygmos yells menacingly at one creature he can see within 60 feet of him. That creature must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened of him for 1 minute. If the creature is already frightened, it becomes stunned instead. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to Borborygmos's Bellow for the next 24 hours.

legendary_actions.name: Wide Berth (Costs 3 Actions)
legendary_actions.description: Borborygmos moves up to half his speed and can move through the space of any creature smaller than Huge. The first time Borborygmos enters a creature's space during this move, the creature must make a DC 21 Dexterity saving throw. If the saving throw succeeds, the creature is pushed 5 feet away from Borborygmos. If the saving throw fails, that creature is knocked prone, and Borborygmos can make a stomp attack against it.

traits.name: Tunneler
traits.description: The worm can burrow through solid rock at half its burrow speed and leaves a 10-foot-diameter tunnel in its wake.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.description: The worm regains 10 hit points at the start of each of its turns if it has at least 1 hit point.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The worm makes two attacks: one with its grinding jaws and one with its stinger.

actions.name: Grinding Jaws
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 22 (3d8 + 9) slashing damage.

actions.name: Tail Stinger
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +14 to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. 19 (3d6 + 9) piercing damage, and the target must make a DC 19 Constitution saving throw, taking 42 (12d6) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

traits.name: Bolts of Undead Slaying
traits.description: Borivik has a half-dozen bolts of undead slaying. If he strikes an Undead creature with one of these magic bolts, it must make a DC 17 Constitution saving throw, taking an extra 33 (6d10) piercing damage on a failed save, or half as much extra damage on a successful one.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Borivik makes two Shortsword attacks or two Heavy Crossbow attacks.

actions.name: Shortsword
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 8 (1d6 + 5) piercing damage.

actions.name: Heavy Crossbow
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack +9 to hit, ranged 100/400 ft., one target. 10 (1d10 + 5) piercing damage.

bonus_actions.name: Crossbow Expert
bonus_actions.description: Borivik adds 1d10 to his next attack or damage roll with his Heavy Crossbow attack.

bonus_actions.name: Nimble Escape
bonus_actions.description: Borivik can take the Disengage or Hide action.

reactions.name: Enduring Response
reactions.description: When Borivik takes acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder damage, he gains immunity to that damage type until the start of his next turn. Also, the first time he hits with a Shortsword attack on his next turn, the target takes an extra 10 (3d6) of the triggering damage type.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.header: Borivik casts one of the following spells, using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 15):

traits.name: Hustle
traits.description: The smuggler can move through the space of any creature that is of a larger size, but it can't stop there.

actions.name: Shortsword
actions.description: m +4, reach 5 ft. 5 (1d6 + 2) Piercing damage plus 2 (1d4) Poison damage.

actions.name: Pistol
actions.description: r +4, range 30/90 ft. 7 (1d10 + 2) Piercing damage.

traits.name: Hustle
traits.description: The underboss can move through the space of any creature that is of a larger size, but it can't stop there.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The underboss makes three attacks, using Poisoned Blade or Arcane Firearm in any combination.

actions.name: Poisoned Blade
actions.description: m +7, reach 5 ft. 13 (2d8 + 4) Slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) Poison damage, and the target has the Poisoned condition until the start of the underboss's next turn. If the target is already Poisoned, it instead takes an extra 7 (2d6) Poison damage.

actions.name: Arcane Firearm
actions.description: r +7, range 30/90 ft. 26 (4d10 + 4) Force damage.

reactions.name: Uncanny Dodge
reactions.description: The underboss is hit by an attack roll. The underboss halves the damage (round down) it takes from that attack.

traits.name: Glacial Aura
traits.description: At the end of the borthak's turn, slippery ice covers surfaces within 10 feet of the borthak. This ice is difficult terrain. When a creature other than the borthak enters the ice's area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there, it must succeed on a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw or have the prone condition. The ice disappears at the start of the borthak's next turn.

traits.name: Webbed Feet
traits.description: The borthak can move across icy surfaces without needing to make an ability check. Additionally, difficult terrain composed of ice or snow doesn't cost it extra movement.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The borthak makes one Bite attack or uses Noxious Regurgitation if available, and it makes two Stomp attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 16 (2d8 + 7) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) acid damage.

actions.name: Stomp
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +12 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 11 (1d8 + 7) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Noxious Regurgitation {@recharge 5}
actions.description: The borthak spews acid at a creature it can see within 120 feet of itself. The target must make a DC 21 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 24 (7d6) acid damage and has the poisoned condition until the start of the borthak's next turn. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage only.

reactions.name: Reactive Tail
reactions.description: When a creature within 10 feet of the borthak hits the borthak with an attack roll, the borthak swings its tail in retaliation. The triggering creature and any creature within 5 feet of it must succeed on a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw or take 16 (2d8 + 7) bludgeoning damage.

legendary_actions.name: Move
legendary_actions.description: The borthak moves up to its speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

legendary_actions.name: Bite (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.description: The borthak makes one Bite attack.

name: Boss Augustus
languages: Thieves' cant (can't speak in wolf form)

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.description: Augustus regains 10 hit points at the start of his turn. If he takes damage from a silver weapon, this trait doesn't function at the start of his next turn. Augustus dies only if he starts his turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate.

traits.name: Special Equipment
traits.description: Augustus wields a +2 Longsword.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Augustus makes any combination of two Bite, Claw, or Magic Longsword attacks.

actions.name: Bite (Wolf or Hybrid Form Only)
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 26 (5d8 + 4) piercing damage. If the target is a Humanoid, it must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or be cursed with lycanthropy. While cursed in this way, the target retains its alignment, languages, and equipment but otherwise uses the werewolf stat block, excluding actions that require equipment the target doesn't have. During any night when there's a full moon in the sky, the target becomes an NPC under the DM's control and remains so until the night ends. A Remove Curse spell or similar magic ends this curse.

actions.name: Claw (Wolf or Hybrid Form Only)
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 21 (5d6 + 4) piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 16 Strength saving throw or have the prone condition.

actions.name: Magic Longsword (Humanoid or Hybrid Form Only)
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 28 (4d10 + 6) slashing damage.

bonus_actions.name: Change Shape
bonus_actions.description: Augustus polymorphs into a wolf-humanoid hybrid, a wolf, or his humanoid form. His statistics, other than his speed, are the same in each form. Any equipment he is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. He reverts to his humanoid form if he dies.

bonus_actions.name: Cunning Action
bonus_actions.description: Augustus takes the Dash, Disengage, or Hide action.

name: Boss Delour
languages: Thieves' cant (can't speak in rat form)

traits.name: Evasion
traits.description: If Delour is subjected to an effect that allows him to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, he instead takes no damage if he succeeds on the saving throw and only half damage if he fails, provided he doesn't have the incapacitated condition.

traits.name: Nimbleness
traits.description: Delour can move through the space of a Medium or larger creature.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.description: Delour regains 10 hit points at the start of his turn. If he takes damage from a silver weapon, this trait doesn't function at the start of his next turn. Delour dies only if he starts his turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Delour makes any combination of three Bite, Shortsword, or Hand Crossbow attacks.

actions.name: Bite (Rat or Hybrid Form Only)
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 26 (5d8 + 4) piercing damage. If the target is a Humanoid, it must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or be cursed with lycanthropy. While cursed in this way, the target retains its alignment, languages, and equipment but otherwise uses the wererat stat block, excluding actions that require equipment the target doesn't have. During any night when there's a full moon in the sky, the target becomes an NPC under the DM's control and remains so until the night ends. A Remove Curse spell or similar magic ends this curse.

actions.name: Shortsword (Humanoid or Hybrid Form Only)
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) poison damage.

actions.name: Hand Crossbow (Humanoid or Hybrid Form Only)
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack +8 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) poison damage.

bonus_actions.name: Change Shape
bonus_actions.description: Delour polymorphs into a rat-humanoid hybrid, a Medium giant rat, or his humanoid form. His statistics, other than his size and speed, are the same in each form. Any equipment he is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. He reverts to his humanoid form if he dies.

bonus_actions.name: Cunning Action
bonus_actions.description: Delour takes the Dash, Disengage, or Hide action.

traits.name: Death Throes
traits.description: When the draconian is reduced to 0 hit points, its scales and flesh immediately shrivel away, and then its bones explode. Each creature within 10 feet of it must succeed on a DC 10 Dexterity saving throw or take 9 (2d8) force damage.

traits.name: Glide
traits.description: When the draconian falls and isn't incapacitated, it subtracts up to 100 feet from the fall when calculating the fall's damage, and it can move up to 2 feet horizontally for every 1 foot it descends.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The draconian makes two Trident melee attacks or two Lightning Discharge attacks.

actions.name: Trident
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage, or 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack.

actions.name: Lightning Discharge
actions.description: Ranged Spell Attack +4 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. 10 (3d6) lightning damage.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.header: The draconian casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 12):

traits.name: Fungal Fortitude
traits.description: If damage reduces the trudge to 0 hit points, it must make a Constitution saving throw with a DC of 5 + the damage taken, unless the damage is radiant or from a critical hit. On a success, the trudge drops to 1 hit point instead.

actions.name: Tusk
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 16 (2d10 + 5) piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) poison damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

traits.name: Fey Ancestry
traits.description: Brahma has advantage on saving throws against being charmed, and magic can't put her to sleep.

traits.name: Taunt (2/Day)
traits.description: Brahma can use a bonus action to target one creature she can see within 30 feet of her. If the target can hear Brahma, it must succeed on a DC 13 Charisma saving throw or have disadvantage on ability checks, attack rolls, and saving throws until the start of Brahma's next turn.

actions.name: War Lute
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 5 (1d6 + 2) slashing damage.

actions.name: Song of Domination (3/Day)
actions.description: Brahma targets one creature that can see or hear her, which must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or be charmed by her for 1 minute. The target can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. It has disadvantage on these saves if being charmed by Brahma is something the target openly or secretly desires. For 1 hour after the charm effect ends, the target has disadvantage on Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma checks made as part of a contest with Brahma.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.header: Brahma is a 4th-level spellcaster. Her spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 13, +5 to hit with spell attacks). She has the following bard spells prepared:

name: Brain in a Jar
languages: the languages it knew in life

traits.name: Detect Sentience
traits.description: The brain can sense the presence and location of any creature within 300 feet of it that has an Intelligence of 3 or higher, regardless of interposing barriers, unless the creature is protected by a mind blank spell.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The brain has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magic effects.

traits.name: Unusual Nature
traits.description: The brain doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

actions.name: Chill Touch (Cantrip)
actions.description: Ranged Spell Attack +6 to hit, range 120 ft., one creature. 13 (3d8) necrotic damage, and the target can't regain hit points until the start of the brain's next turn. If the target is undead, it also has disadvantage on attack rolls against the brain until the end of the brain's next turn.

actions.name: Mind Blast {@recharge 5}
actions.description: The brain magically emits psychic energy in a 60-foot cone. Each creature in that area must succeed on a DC 14 Intelligence saving throw or take 17 (3d8 + 4) psychic damage and be stunned for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting (Psionics)
spellcasting.header: The brain's innate spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save DC 14, +6 to hit with spell attacks). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no components:

actions.name: Rend
actions.description: m +4, reach 5 ft. 7 (1d10 + 2) Slashing damage.

actions.name: Fire Breath {@recharge 5}
actions.description: dex DC 11, each creature in a 20-foot-long, 5-foot-wide Line [Area of Effect]. 14 (4d6) Fire damage. Half damage.

actions.name: Sleep Breath
actions.description: con DC 11, each creature in a 15-foot Cone [Area of Effect]. The target has the Incapacitated condition until the end of its next turn, at which point it repeats the save. 2 The target has the Unconscious condition for 1 minute. This effect ends for the target if it takes damage or a creature within 5 feet of it takes an action to wake it.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (4/Day)
traits.description: If the greatwyrm fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Metallic Awakening (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
traits.description: If the greatwyrm would be reduced to 0 hit points, its current hit point total instead resets to 450 hit points, it recharges its Breath Weapon, and it regains any expended uses of Legendary Resistance. Additionally, the greatwyrm can now use the options in the "Mythic Actions" section for 1 hour. Award a party an additional 120,000 XP (240,000 XP total) for defeating the greatwyrm after its Metallic Awakening activates.

traits.name: Unusual Nature
traits.description: The greatwyrm doesn't require food or drink.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The greatwyrm makes one Bite attack and two Claw attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +18 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. 21 (2d10 + 10) piercing damage plus 13 (2d12) force damage.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +18 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 19 (2d8 + 10) slashing damage. If the target is a Huge or smaller creature, it is grappled (escape DC 20) and is restrained until this grapple ends. The greatwyrm can have only one creature grappled in this way at a time.

actions.name: Tail
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +18 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. 21 (2d10 + 10) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 26 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

actions.name: Breath Weapon {@recharge 5}
actions.description: The greatwyrm uses one of the following breath weapons: Elemental Breath. The greatwyrm exhales elemental energy in a 300-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 25 Dexterity saving throw, taking 84 (13d12) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Sapping Breath. The greatwyrm exhales gas in a 300-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 25 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature falls unconscious for 1 minute. On a successful save, the creature has disadvantage on attack rolls and saving throws until the end of the greatwyrm's next turn. An unconscious creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

actions.name: Change Shape
actions.description: The greatwyrm magically transforms into any creature that is Medium or Small, while retaining its game statistics (other than its size). This transformation ends if the dragon is reduced to 0 hit points or uses its action to end it.

legendary_actions.name: Attack
legendary_actions.description: The greatwyrm makes one Claw or Tail attack.

legendary_actions.name: Wing Attack (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.description: The greatwyrm beats its wings. Each creature within 30 feet of it must succeed on a DC 26 Dexterity saving throw or take 17 (2d6 + 10) bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone. The greatwyrm can then fly up to half its flying speed.

traits.name: Intellect Fortress
traits.description: The braxat's AC includes its Intelligence modifier.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The braxat makes two Greatclub attacks.

actions.name: Greatclub
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +12 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 21 (3d8 + 8) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Acid Breath {@recharge}
actions.description: The braxat exhales a 15-foot cone of acid. Each creature in the cone must make a DC 18 Constitution saving throw, taking 26 (4d12) acid damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

reactions.name: Psionic Shield (3/Day)
reactions.description: When the braxat would be hit by an attack roll or a magic missile spell that originates from a source the braxat can see, the braxat can create an invisible barrier of magical force around itself that lasts until the start of its next turn. This barrier gives the braxat a +5 bonus to AC, including against the triggering attack, and prevents magic missile spells from damaging it.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting (Psionics)
spellcasting.header: The braxat casts one of the following spells, requiring no spell components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 14):

traits.name: Flame Aura
traits.description: At the end of each of the gorgon's turns, each creature in a 5-foot Emanation [Area of Effect] originating from the gorgon takes 13 (3d8) Fire damage.

traits.name: Illumination
traits.description: The gorgon sheds Bright Light in a 10-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 10 feet.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The gorgon makes two Gore attacks.

actions.name: Gore
actions.description: m +8, reach 5 ft. 11 (2d6 + 4) Piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) Fire damage.

actions.name: Smelting Charge {@recharge 5}
actions.description: The gorgon moves up to its Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks and can move through the spaces of Medium or smaller creatures. Each time the gorgon enters a creature's space for the first time during this move, that target is subjected to the following effect. dex DC 16. 13 (2d8 + 4) Piercing damage plus 13 (3d8) Fire damage, and the target is pulled into the gorgon's space and has the Grappled condition (escape DC 14); if the gorgon already has a creature Grappled, the target has the Prone condition instead. Until the grapple ends, the target has the Restrained condition. When the gorgon moves, the Grappled target moves with it, costing no extra movement.

traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
traits.description: The breath drinker can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

traits.name: Radiant Absorption
traits.description: When the breath drinker is subjected to radiant damage, it takes no damage and instead regains a number of hit points equal to the radiant damage dealt.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The breath drinker makes two Enervating Claw attacks. It can also use Drink Breath.

actions.name: Enervating Claw
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. 12 (2d6 + 5) necrotic damage, and if the target is Large or smaller, it has the grappled condition (escape DC 18). The target must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution saving throw or its hit point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the damage taken. This reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest. The target dies if this effect reduces its hit point maximum to 0.

actions.name: Drink Breath
actions.description: The breath drinker targets a creature that has the incapacitated condition or that the breath drinker is grappling and that isn't a Construct or an Undead. The target must make a DC 18 Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes 36 (8d8) necrotic damage, and its Charisma score is reduced by 1d6. This reduction lasts until the target finishes a short or long rest. If this reduces the target's Charisma to 0, the target dies. Until the breath drinker dies, the dead target can't be returned to life by any means short of divine intervention. On a successful save, the target takes half as much necrotic damage only. On a successful or failed save, the breath drinker regains a number of hit points equal to the necrotic damage dealt.

actions.name: Invisibility
actions.description: The breath drinker has the invisible condition. This invisibility ends immediately after the breath drinker hits or misses with an attack roll or uses Drink Breath.

traits.name: Fungus Stride
traits.description: Once on its turn, the bridesmaid can use 10 feet of its movement to step magically into one living mushroom or fungus patch within 5 feet and emerge from another within 60 feet of the first one, appearing in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the second mushroom or fungus patch. The mushrooms and patches must be large or bigger.

actions.name: Hallucination Spores
actions.description: The bridesmaid ejects spores at one creature it can see within 5 feet of it. The target must succeed on a DC 10 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 1 minute. While poisoned in this way, the target is incapacitated. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

actions.name: Infestation Spores (1/Day)
actions.description: The bridesmaid releases spores that burst out in a cloud that fills a 10-foot-radius sphere centered on it, and the cloud lingers for 1 minute. Any flesh-and-blood creature in the cloud when it appears, or that enters it later, must make a DC 10 Constitution saving throw. On a successful save, the creature can't be infected by these spores for 24 hours. On a failed save, the creature is infected with a disease called the spores of Zuggtmoy and also gains a random form of indefinite madness (determined by rolling on the Madness of Zuggtmoy table in appendix D) that lasts until the creature is cured of the disease or dies. While infected in this way, the creature can't be reinfected, and it must be repeat the saving throw at the end of every 24 hours, ending the infection on a success. On a failure, the infected creature's body is slowly taken over by fungal growth, and after three such failed saves, the creature dies and is reanimated as a spore servant if it's a type of creature that can be (see the "Myconids" entry in the Monster Manual).

traits.name: Fey Ancestry
traits.description: The brigganock has advantage on saving throws against being charmed, and magic can't put it to sleep.

traits.name: Soul Light
traits.description: The brigganock is accompanied by an insubstantial, invulnerable ball of light that contains its soul. The brigganock can't turn off the light or control its brightness. The soul light sheds bright light in a 10-foot radius and dim light for an additional 10 feet. If the brigganock dies, its soul light fades away.

traits.name: Tunneler
traits.description: Using a pickaxe or similar tool, a brigganock can burrow through solid rock at a speed of 5 feet, leaving a 6-inch-diameter tunnel in its wake.

actions.name: Pickaxe
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.

actions.name: Time Lapse (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
actions.description: The brigganock accelerates the passage of time around itself, enabling it to accomplish up to 1 hour of work in a matter of seconds. This work can't affect any creature other than the brigganock, or any object being worn or carried by another creature, and the activity must take place within a 10-foot cube. For example, the brigganock could use this action to rapidly carve a pumpkin, cook and eat dinner, move a pile of stones, or tie a dozen knots in a length of rope.

bonus_actions.name: Move Soul Light
bonus_actions.description: The brigganock moves its soul light up to 30 feet in any direction to an unoccupied space it can see. At the end of the current turn, the light returns to the brigganock.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.header: The brigganock casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 11):

traits.name: Bladed Hide
traits.description: At the start of each of its turns, the moorbounder deals 5 (2d4) piercing damage to any creature grappling it.

traits.name: Standing Leap
traits.description: The moorbounder's long jump is up to 40 feet and its high jump is up to 20 feet, with or without a running start.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The moorbounder makes two attacks: one with its blades and one with its claws.

actions.name: Blades
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage.

actions.name: Claws
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 14 (4d4 + 4) slashing damage.

traits.name: Charge
traits.description: If Antigonos moves at least 10 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a gore attack on the same turn, the target takes an extra 9 (2d8) piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 14 Strength saving throw or be pushed up to 10 feet away and knocked prone.

traits.name: Labyrinthine Recall
traits.description: Antigonos can perfectly recall any path he has traveled.

traits.name: Reckless
traits.description: At the start of his turn, Antigonos can gain advantage on all melee weapon attack rolls he makes during that turn, but attack rolls against him have advantage until the start of his next turn.

traits.name: Decrepit State
traits.description: Antigonos has disadvantage on his attack rolls.

actions.name: Greataxe
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 17 (2d12 + 4) slashing damage.

actions.name: Gore
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 13 (2d8 + 4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Amphora
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one Medium or smaller creature. 8 (1d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage. If there is not already a creature inside the amphora, the target is restrained inside. As an action, the restrained creature can make a DC 14 Dexterity (Acrobatics) check, escaping from the amphora on a success. The effect also ends if the amphora is destroyed. The amphora has AC 8, 20 hit points, and immunity to poison and psychic damage.

actions.name: Stomp
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +8 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. 27 (5d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 14 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

actions.name: Tail
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +8 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. 32 (6d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.description: The dragon can breathe air and water.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The dragon makes two Rend attacks.

actions.name: Rend
actions.description: m +5, reach 5 ft. 8 (1d10 + 3) Slashing damage.

actions.name: Lightning Breath {@recharge 5}
actions.description: dex DC 12, each creature in a 40-foot-long, 5-foot-wide Line [Area of Effect]. 16 (3d10) Lightning damage. Half damage.

actions.name: Repulsion Breath
actions.description: str DC 12, each creature in a 30-foot Cone [Area of Effect]. The target is pushed up to 30 feet straight away from the dragon and has the Prone condition.

traits.description: If the greatwyrm fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

name: Bronze Sable
languages: understands one language of its creator but can't speak

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.description: While the sable remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal statue.

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.description: The sable has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the sable's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

traits.name: Surprise Attack
traits.description: If the sable surprises a creature and hits it with an attack during the first round of combat, the target takes an extra 10 (3d6) damage from the attack.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The sable makes two bite attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage.

name: Bronze Scout
languages: understands one language of its creator but can't speak

traits.name: Earth Armor
traits.description: The bronze scout doesn't provoke opportunity attacks when it burrows.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The bronze scout has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) lightning damage.

actions.name: Lightning Flare (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
actions.description: Each creature in contact with the ground within 15 feet of the bronze scout must make a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw, taking 14 (4d6) lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

traits.name: Constructed Nature
traits.description: An animated object doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep. The magic that animates an object is dispelled when the construct drops to 0 hit points. An animated object reduced to 0 hit points becomes inanimate and is too damaged to be of much use or value to anyone.

traits.name: Antimagic Susceptibility
traits.description: The broom is incapacitated while in the area of an antimagic field. If targeted by dispel magic, the broom must succeed on a Constitution saving throw against the caster's spell save DC or fall unconscious for 1 minute.

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.description: While the broom remains motionless and isn't flying, it is indistinguishable from a normal broom.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The broom makes two melee attacks.

actions.name: Broomstick
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 5 (1d4 + 3) bludgeoning damage.

reactions.name: Animated Attack
reactions.description: If the broom is motionless and a creature grabs hold of it, the broom makes a Dexterity check contested by the creature's Strength check. If the broom wins the contest, it flies out of the creature's grasp and makes a melee attack against it with advantage on the attack roll.
