name: Caldron Magen
languages: understands Common plus two other languages but can't speak

traits.name: Disintegration
traits.description: If the magen dies, it disintegrates into dust, leaving behind anything it was wearing or carrying.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The magen has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The magen makes two attacks, using Extended Fist or Acid Spittle in any combination.

actions.name: Extended Fist
actions.description: m +6, reach 15 ft. 8 (1d8 + 4) Bludgeoning damage plus 5 (1d10) Acid damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 14) from one of two fists.

actions.name: Acid Spittle
actions.description: r +6, range 60 ft. 13 (2d8 + 4) Acid damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The cambion makes two attacks, using Claw or Fire Ray in any combination.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: m +7, reach 5 ft. 8 (1d8 + 4) Slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) Fire damage.

actions.name: Fire Ray
actions.description: r +7, range 120 ft. 13 (3d6 + 3) Fire damage.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.header: The cambion casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 14):

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: m +4, reach 5 ft. 4 (1d4 + 2) Bludgeoning damage.

traits.name: Death Throes
traits.description: Camlash explodes when reduced to 0 hit points, and each creature within 30 feet of Camlash must make a DC 21 Dexterity saving throw, taking 70 (20d6) fire damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. The explosion ignites flammable objects in that area that aren't being worn or carried.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: Camlash has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Spider Aura
traits.description: Camlash is surrounded by tiny biting spiders that magically appear and disappear from moment to moment. At the start of each of Camlash's turns, each creature within 10 feet of Camlash takes 10 (3d6) poison damage and must succeed on a DC 21 Constitution saving throw or have the paralyzed condition until the start of Camlash's next turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Camlash makes one Flaming Whip attack and one Lightning Blade attack. Camlash can replace one of these attacks with Teleport.

actions.name: Flaming Whip
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +15 to hit, reach 30 ft., one target. 25 (5d6 + 8) fire damage, and if the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 21 Strength saving throw or be pulled up to 25 feet toward Camlash.

actions.name: Lightning Blade
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +15 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 21 (3d8 + 8) slashing damage plus 13 (3d8) lightning damage.

actions.name: Teleport
actions.description: Camlash magically teleports, along with any equipment she is wearing or carrying, up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space she can see.

name: Campestri
languages: understands Common but speaks only through the use of its Mimicry trait

traits.name: Mimicry
traits.description: The campestri can mimic any voice or song it has heard, albeit in a nasal falsetto.

actions.name: Head Butt
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +0 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 1 bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Spores (1/Day)
actions.description: A 5-foot radius of spores extends from the campestri. These spores can go around corners, and they have no effect on Constructs, Elementals, Plants, or Undead. Each other creature in the area must make a DC 10 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the creature is incapacitated and its speed is halved, both for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The artificer makes two attacks, using Battering Mace or Artillery Strike in any combination.

actions.name: Battering Mace
actions.description: m +6, reach 5 ft. 14 (3d6 + 4) Bludgeoning damage, and if the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Prone condition.

actions.name: Artillery Strike
actions.description: r +6, range 120 ft. 22 (4d8 + 4) Force damage.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.header: The artificer casts one of the following spells, using its Tinker's Tools as an Arcane Focus and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 14):

traits.name: Dimensional Lock
traits.description: Other creatures can't teleport to or from a space within 60 feet of the canoloth. Any attempt to do so is wasted.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The canoloth has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Uncanny Senses
traits.description: The canoloth can't be surprised unless it's incapacitated.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The canoloth makes one Bite or Tongue attack and one Claw attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage plus 18 (4d8) force damage.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 7 (1d6 + 4) slashing damage plus 9 (2d8) force damage.

actions.name: Tongue
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +7 to hit, reach 30 ft., one target. 10 (1d12 + 4) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) acid damage. If the target is Medium or smaller, it is grappled (escape DC 15), pulled up to 30 feet toward the canoloth, and restrained until the grapple ends. The canoloth can grapple one target at a time with its tongue.

traits.name: Limited Spell Immunity
traits.description: The golem automatically succeeds on saving throws against spells of 7th level or lower, and the attack rolls of such spells always miss it.

traits.name: Unusual Nature
traits.description: The golem doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The golem makes two attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 27 (4d10 + 5) force damage.

actions.name: Crystal Dart
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack +10 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. 14 (2d8 + 5) force damage.

reactions.name: Spell Deflection
reactions.description: In response to a spell attack missing the golem, it causes that spell to hit another creature within 120 feet of it that it can see.

traits.name: Action Surge (Recharges on a Short or Long Rest)
traits.description: On his turn, Othelstan can take one additional action.

traits.name: Tiamat's Blessing of Retribution
traits.description: When Othelstan takes damage that reduces him to 0 hit points, he immediately regains 20 hit points. If he has 20 hit points or fewer at the end of his next turn, he dies.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Othelstan attacks twice with his flail or spear, or makes two ranged attacks with his spears.

actions.name: Flail
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 8 (1d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Spear
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. or ranged 20/60 ft., one target. 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage.

traits.name: Bound Haunting
traits.description: Caradoc's spirit is bound to Dargaard Keep. At the start of his turn, if he's outside the keep's walls and not possessing a creature using his Possession action, he must succeed on a DC 15 Charisma saving throw or vanish and reappear in an unoccupied space within the keep.

traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
traits.description: Caradoc can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. He takes 5 (1d10) force damage if he ends his turn inside an object.

traits.name: Rejuvenation
traits.description: If Caradoc dies, he reforms within Dargaard Keep in 2d6 days.

traits.name: Unusual Nature
traits.description: Caradoc doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Caradoc makes two Withering Touch attacks.

actions.name: Withering Touch
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 15 (2d10 + 4) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Possession {@recharge 5}
actions.description: One Humanoid that Caradoc can see within 5 feet of himself must succeed on a DC 15 Charisma saving throw or be possessed by him; he then disappears, and the target is incapacitated and loses control of its body. Caradoc now controls the body but doesn't deprive the target of awareness. Caradoc can't be targeted by any attack, spell, or other effect, except ones that turn Undead, and he retains his alignment, Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma, immunity to being charmed and frightened, and his Divisive Whispers bonus action. He otherwise uses the possessed target's statistics but doesn't gain access to the target's knowledge, class features, or proficiencies. The possession lasts until the body drops to 0 hit points, Caradoc ends it as a bonus action, or he is turned or forced out by an effect like the dispel evil and good spell. When the possession ends, Caradoc reappears in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the body. The target is immune to Caradoc's Possession for 24 hours after succeeding on the saving throw or after the possession ends.

bonus_actions.name: Divisive Whispers
bonus_actions.description: Caradoc magically whispers to one creature within 60 feet of himself. The target must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw, or the target must immediately use its reaction to make a melee attack against another creature of Caradoc's choice (wasting its reaction if there are no other creatures within reach).

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.description: The carrion crawler can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The carrion crawler uses Paralyzing Tentacles and makes one Bite attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: m +4, reach 5 ft. 7 (2d4 + 2) Piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) Poison damage.

actions.name: Paralyzing Tentacles
actions.description: con DC 12, one creature the carrion crawler can see within 10 feet. The target has the Poisoned condition and repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. After 1 minute, it succeeds automatically. While Poisoned, the target has the Paralyzed condition.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The creature makes two attacks: one with its tentacles and one with its bite.

actions.name: Tentacles
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. 4 (1d4 + 2) poison damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 1 minute. Until this poison ends, the target is paralyzed. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the poison on itself on a success.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 7 (2d4 + 2) piercing damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The carrion stalker makes three Tentacle attacks. If it is attached to a creature, it can replace one Tentacle attack with Larval Burst, if available.

actions.name: Tentacle
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage, and the carrion stalker attaches to the target and pulls itself into the target's space. While attached, the carrion stalker moves with the target and has advantage on attack rolls against it. A creature can use its action to try to detach the carrion stalker and force it to move into the nearest unoccupied space, doing so with a successful DC 11 Strength check. On its turn, the carrion stalker can detach itself from the target by using 5 feet of movement. When it dies, the carrion stalker detaches from any creature it is attached to.

actions.name: Larval Burst (1/Day)
actions.description: The carrion stalker releases a burst of larvae in a 10-foot-radius sphere centered on itself. Each creature in that area must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned. A creature poisoned in this way takes 7 (2d6) poison damage at the start of each of its turns as larvae infest its body. The creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. Any effect that cures disease or removes the poisoned condition instantly kills the larvae in the creature, ending the effect on it. If a creature is reduced to 0 hit points by the infestation, it dies. The larvae remain in the corpse, and one survives to become a fully grown carrion stalker in 1d4 weeks. Any effect that cures diseases or removes the poisoned condition that targets the corpse instantly kills the larvae.

name: Carrionette
languages: understands the languages of its creator

traits.name: False Object
traits.description: If the carrionette is motionless at the start of combat, it has advantage on its initiative roll. Moreover, if a creature hasn't observed the carrionette move or act, that creature must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom (Perception) check to discern that the carrionette is animate.

traits.name: Unusual Nature
traits.description: The carrionette doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

actions.name: Silver Needle
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. 1 piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) necrotic damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 12 Charisma saving throw or become cursed for 1 minute. While cursed in this way, the target's speed is reduced by 10 feet, and it must roll a 1d4 and subtract the number rolled from each ability check or attack roll it makes.

actions.name: Soul Swap
actions.description: The carrionette targets a creature it can see within 15 feet of it that is cursed by its Silver Needle. Unless the target is protected by a protection from evil and good spell, it must succeed on a DC 12 Charisma saving throw or have its consciousness swapped with the carrionette. The carrionette gains control of the target's body, and the target is unconscious for 1 hour, after which it gains control of the carrionette's body. While controlling the target's body, the carrionette retains its Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores. It otherwise uses the controlled body's statistics, but doesn't gain access to the target's knowledge, class features, or proficiencies. If the carrionette's body is destroyed, both the carrionette and the target die. A protection from evil and good spell cast on the controlled body drives the carrionette out and returns the consciousness of both creatures to their original bodies. The swap is also undone if the controlled body takes damage from the carrionette's Silver Needle.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.header: Cassiok is an 18th-level spellcaster. His spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save DC 19, +11 to hit with spell attacks). Cassiok can cast disguise self and invisibility at will and has the following wizard spells prepared:

traits.name: Jumper
traits.description: The cat's jump distance is determined using its Dexterity rather than its Strength.

actions.name: Scratch
actions.description: m +4, reach 5 ft. 1 Slashing damage.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.description: The krasis can breathe air and water.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The krasis makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its claws.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. 8 (1d10 + 3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claws
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 7 (1d8 + 3) slashing damage.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.description: The krasis can breathe air and water.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The krasis makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its claws.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. 17 (2d12 + 4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claws
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 17 (2d12 + 4) slashing damage.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.description: The krasis can breathe air and water.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The krasis makes three attacks: one with its bite, one with its claws, and one with its tail.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. 27 (6d6 + 6) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claws
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 22 (3d10 + 6) slashing damage.

actions.name: Tail
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +11 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. 33 (6d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 19 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

traits.name: Stench
traits.description: Any creature other than a catoblepas that starts its turn within 10 feet of the catoblepas must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned until the start of the creature's next turn. On a successful saving throw, the creature is immune to the Stench of any catoblepas for 1 hour.

actions.name: Tail
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 21 (5d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or be stunned until the start of the catoblepas's next turn.

actions.name: Death Ray {@recharge 5}
actions.description: The catoblepas targets one creature it can see within 30 feet of it. The target must make a DC 16 Constitution saving throw, taking 36 (8d8) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. If the saving throw fails by 5 or more, the target instead takes 64 necrotic damage. The target dies if reduced to 0 hit points by this ray.

traits.name: Keen Smell
traits.description: The bear has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The bear makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its claws.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 9 (1d8 + 5) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claws
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 12 (2d6 + 5) slashing damage.

traits.name: Flammable Blood
traits.description: If the cave fisher drops to half its hit points or fewer, it gains vulnerability to fire damage.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.description: The cave fisher can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The cave fisher makes two Claw attacks.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 10 (2d6 + 3) slashing damage.

actions.name: Retract Filament
actions.description: One Large or smaller creature grappled by the cave fisher's Adhesive Filament must make a DC 13 Strength saving throw. On a failed save, the target is pulled into an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the cave fisher, and the cave fisher makes one Claw attack against it. Anyone else who was attached to the filament is released. Until the grapple ends on the target, the cave fisher can't use Adhesive Filament.

bonus_actions.name: Adhesive Filament
bonus_actions.description: The cave fisher extends a sticky filament up to 60 feet, and the filament adheres to anything that touches it. A creature the filament adheres to is grappled by the cave fisher (escape DC 13), and ability checks made to escape this grapple have disadvantage. The filament can be attacked (AC 15; 5 hit points; immunity to poison and psychic damage). A weapon that fails to sever it becomes stuck to it, requiring an action and a successful DC 13 Strength check to pull free. Destroying the filament deals no damage to the cave fisher. The filament crumbles away if the cave fisher takes this bonus action again.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The spirit makes a number of attacks equal to half this spell's level (round down).

actions.name: Radiant Bow (Avenger Only)
actions.description: r Bonus equals your spell attack modifier, range 600 ft. 2d6 + 2 + summonSpellLevel Radiant damage.

actions.name: Radiant Mace (Defender Only)
actions.description: m Bonus equals your spell attack modifier, reach 5 ft. 1d10 + 3 + summonSpellLevel Radiant damage, and the spirit can choose itself or another creature it can see within 10 feet of the target. The chosen creature gains 1d10 Temporary Hit Points.

actions.name: Healing Touch (1/Day)
actions.description: The spirit touches another creature. The target regains Hit Points equal to 2d8 + summonSpellLevel.

traits.name: Charge
traits.description: If the centaur moves at least 30 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a pike attack on the same turn, the target takes an extra 10 (3d6) piercing damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The centaur makes two attacks: one with its pike and one with its hooves or two with its longbow.

actions.name: Pike
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 9 (1d10 + 4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Hooves
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Longbow
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack +4 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage.

traits.name: Charge
traits.description: If the centaur mummy moves at least 20 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a pike attack on the same turn, the target takes an extra 10 (3d6) piercing damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The centaur mummy makes two melee attacks, one with its pike and one with its hooves, or it attacks with its pike and uses Dreadful Glare.

actions.name: Pike
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 10 (1d10 + 5) piercing damage.

actions.name: Hooves
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 12 (2d6 + 5) piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) necrotic damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or be cursed with mummy rot. The cursed target can't regain hit points, and its hit point maximum decreases by 10 (3d6) for every 24 hours that elapse. If the curse reduces the target's hit point maximum to 0, the target dies, and its body turns to dust. The curse lasts until removed by the remove curse spell or similar magic.

actions.name: Dreadful Glare
actions.description: The centaur mummy targets one creature it can see within 60 feet of it. If the target can see the mummy, the target must succeed on a DC 12 Wisdom saving throw against this magic or become frightened until the end of the mummy's next turn. If the target fails the saving throw by 5 or more, it is also paralyzed for the same duration. A target that succeeds on the saving throw is immune to the Dreadful Glare of all mummies (but not mummy lords) for the next 24 hours.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The centaur makes two attacks, using Pike or Longbow in any combination.

actions.name: Pike
actions.description: m +6, reach 10 ft. 9 (1d10 + 4) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Longbow
actions.description: r +4, range 150/600 ft. 6 (1d8 + 2) Piercing damage.

bonus_actions.name: Trampling Charge {@recharge 5}
bonus_actions.description: The centaur moves up to its Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks and can move through the spaces of Medium or smaller creatures. Each creature whose space the centaur enters is targeted once by the following effect. str DC 14. 7 (1d6 + 4) Bludgeoning damage, and the target has the Prone condition.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The centaur makes two attacks, using Forest Staff or Sun Ray in any combination.

actions.name: Forest Staff
actions.description: m +7, reach 5 ft. 13 (2d8 + 4) Bludgeoning damage plus 14 (4d6) Poison damage.

actions.name: Sun Ray
actions.description: r +7, range 90 ft. 14 (3d6 + 4) Radiant damage, and the target has the Blinded condition until the start of the centaur's next turn.

bonus_actions.name: Entangling Trail {@recharge 5}
bonus_actions.description: The centaur moves up to its Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks. Each creature within 5 feet of the centaur as it moves is targeted once by the following effect. str DC 15. 11 (2d6 + 4) Bludgeoning damage, and the target has the Restrained condition until the end of its next turn.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.header: The centaur casts one of the following spells, using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 15):

traits.name: Diabolical Restoration
traits.description: If the devil dies outside the Nine Hells, its body disappears in sulfurous smoke, and it gains a new body instantly, reviving with all its Hit Points somewhere in the Nine Hells.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The devil has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The devil makes two Chain attacks and uses Conjure Infernal Chain.

actions.name: Chain
actions.description: m +7, reach 10 ft. 11 (2d6 + 4) Slashing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 14) from one of two chains, and it has the Restrained condition until the grapple ends.

actions.name: Conjure Infernal Chain
actions.description: The devil conjures a fiery chain to bind a creature. dex DC 15, one creature the devil can see within 60 feet. 9 (2d4 + 4) Fire damage, and the target has the Restrained condition until the end of the devil's next turn, at which point the chain disappears. If the target is Large or smaller, the devil moves the target up to 30 feet straight toward itself. The chain disappears.

reactions.name: Unnerving Gaze
reactions.description: A creature the devil can see starts its turn within 30 feet of the devil and can see the devil. dwis DC 15, the triggering creature. The target has the Frightened condition until the end of its turn. The target is immune to this devil's Unnerving Gaze for 24 hours.

traits.name: Mushroom Portal
traits.description: The chamberlain counts as a mushroom for the Fungus Stride feature of the bridesmaid of Zuggtmoy.

traits.name: Poison Spores
traits.description: Whenever the chamberlain takes damage, it releases a cloud of spores. Creatures within 5 feet of the chamberlain when this happens must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The chamberlain makes two slam attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 10 (2d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Infestation Spores (1/Day)
actions.description: The chamberlain releases spores that burst out in a cloud that fills a 10-foot-radius sphere centered on it, and the cloud lingers for 1 minute. Any flesh-and-blood creature in the cloud when it appears, or that enters it later, must make a DC 12 Constitution saving throw. On a successful save, the creature can't be infected by these spores for 24 hours. On a failed save, the creature is infected with a disease called the spores of Zuggtmoy and also gains a random form of indefinite madness (determined by rolling on the Madness of Zuggtmoy table in appendix D) that lasts until the creature is cured of the disease or dies. While infected in this way, the creature can't be reinfected, and it must be repeat the saving throw at the end of every 24 hours, ending the infection on a success. On a failure, the infected creature's body is slowly taken over by fungal growth, and after three such failed saves, the creature dies and is reanimated as a spore servant if it's a type of creature that can be (see the "Myconids" entry in the Monster Manual).

traits.name: Indomitable (2/Day)
traits.description: The champion rerolls a failed saving throw.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The champion makes three Greatsword or Shortbow attacks.

actions.name: Greatsword
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 12 (2d6 + 5) slashing damage, plus 7 (2d6) slashing damage if the champion has more than half of its total hit points remaining.

actions.name: Shortbow
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack +6 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage, plus 7 (2d6) piercing damage if the champion has more than half of its total hit points remaining.

bonus_actions.name: Second Wind (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
bonus_actions.description: The champion regains 20 hit points.

traits.name: Brave
traits.description: The champion has advantage on saving throws against the frightened condition.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The champion makes two Lightning Mace attacks or three Handaxe attacks.

actions.name: Lightning Mace
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage plus 5 (2d4) lightning damage.

actions.name: Handaxe
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. 6 (1d6 + 3) slashing damage.

bonus_actions.name: Aura of Resilience (1/Day)
bonus_actions.description: The champion exudes an aura of ghostly lightning that fills a 10-foot-radius sphere centered on itself. While this aura is active, the champion and each creature of its choice within the aura have advantage on saving throws. The aura moves with the champion and lasts for 1 minute, until the champion has the incapacitated condition, or until the champion uses another bonus action to end the aura.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The champion makes three Longsword attacks.

actions.name: Longsword
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage, or 8 (1d10 + 3) piercing damage if used with two hands.

bonus_actions.name: Aura of Fury (1/Day)
bonus_actions.description: The champion summons an aura of ghostly animals that fills a 10-foot-radius sphere centered on itself. While this aura is active, the champion and all its allies in the aura have advantage on attack rolls. The aura moves with the champion and lasts for 1 minute, until the champion has the incapacitated condition, or until the champion uses another bonus action to end the aura.

reactions.name: Parry
reactions.description: The champion adds 2 to its AC against one melee attack that would hit it. To do so, the champion must see the attacker and be wielding a melee weapon.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The champion makes two Arcane Burst attacks or makes one Arcane Burst attack and uses Spellcasting.

actions.name: Arcane Burst
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Spell Attack +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft., one target. 8 (1d10 + 3) force damage.

bonus_actions.name: Aura of Deception (1/Day)
bonus_actions.description: The champion emits an aura of ghostly illusions that fills a 10-foot-radius sphere centered on itself. While this aura is active, creatures have disadvantage on attack rolls against the champion and any of the champion's allies that are in the aura. The aura moves with the champion and lasts for 1 minute, until the champion has the incapacitated condition, or until the champion uses another bonus action to end the aura.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.header: The champion casts one of the following spells, using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 13):

traits.name: Change Appearance
traits.description: The changeling can use its action to polymorph into a Medium humanoid it has seen, or back into its true form. Its statistics, other than its size, are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The changeling makes two attacks with its dagger.

actions.name: Dagger
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.

actions.name: Unsettling Visage (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
actions.description: Each creature within 30 feet of the changeling must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The chaos quadrapod has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The chaos quadrapod makes up to two tentacle attacks.

actions.name: Tentacle
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +6 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it is grappled (escape DC 14). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained. The chaos quadrapod can grapple no more than two targets at a time.

actions.name: Chaos Cloud (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
actions.description: The chaos quadrapod shoots forth a knot of roiling ethereal light that explodes at a point it can see within 60 feet of it. Each creature in a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on that point must succeed on a DC 14 Charisma saving throw or be stunned until the end of its next turn.

traits.name: Chardalyn Madness
traits.description: The berserker must roll a d6 at the start of each of its turns. On a 1, the berserker does nothing on its turn except speak to a nonexistent, evil master whom it has pledged to serve.

traits.name: Reckless
traits.description: At the start of its turn, the berserker can gain advantage on all melee weapon attack rolls during that turn, but attack rolls against it have advantage until the start of its next turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The berserker attacks three times with a melee weapon.

actions.name: Chardalyn Flail
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 7 (1d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Chardalyn Javelin
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft., one target. 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned until the end of its next turn.

name: Chardalyn Dragon
languages: the languages known by its creator

traits.name: Immutable Form
traits.description: The dragon is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The dragon has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Siege Monster
traits.description: The dragon deals double damage to objects and structures.

traits.name: Unusual Nature
traits.description: The dragon doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep, and it gains no benefit from finishing a short or long rest.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The dragon uses its Malevolent Presence. It then makes three attacks: two with its claws and one with its tail. If the dragon isn't flying, it can also make one attack with its wings.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 14 (2d6 + 7) slashing damage.

actions.name: Tail
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 18 (2d10 + 7) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Wings
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 12 (2d4 + 7) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Malevolent Presence
actions.description: Any creature with an Intelligence of 4 or more that is within 30 feet of the dragon must succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw or be charmed by it for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to the dragon's Malevolent Presence for the next 24 hours. A creature charmed in this way fixates on another creature or object that the dragon mentally chooses and must, on each of its turns, move as close as it can to that target and use its action to make a melee attack against it. If the dragon doesn't choose a target, the charmed creature can act normally on its turn.

actions.name: Radiant Breath {@recharge 5}
actions.description: The dragon exhales a ray of radiant energy in a 120-foot line that is 5 feet wide. Each creature in that line must make a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw, taking 31 (7d8) radiant damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.description: If Charmayne fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Charmayne makes three Ashen Burst attacks. She can replace one of these attacks with one use of Spellcasting.

actions.name: Ashen Burst
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Spell Attack +9 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft., one target. 17 (5d6) fire damage.

actions.name: Cinder Spite {@recharge 5}
actions.description: Charmayne creates a magical explosion of fire centered on a point she can see within 120 feet of herself. Each creature in a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on that point must make a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw, taking 35 (10d6) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A Humanoid reduced to 0 hit points by this damage dies and is transformed into a Tiny charcoal figurine.

reactions.name: Elemental Rebuke
reactions.description: In response to being hit by an attack, Charmayne utters a word in Ignan, dealing 10 (3d6) fire damage to the attacker. Charmayne then teleports, along with any equipment she is wearing or carrying, up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space she can see, leaving a harmless cloud of ash and embers in the space she just left.

reactions.name: Fiery Counterspell
reactions.description: Charmayne interrupts a creature she can see within 60 feet of herself that is casting a spell. If the spell is 4th level or lower, it fails and has no effect. If the spell is 5th level or higher, Charmayne makes an Intelligence check (DC 10 + the spell's level). On a success, the spell fails and has no effect. Whatever the spell's level, the caster takes 10 (3d6) fire damage if the spell fails.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.header: Charmayne casts one of the following spells, using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 17):

traits.name: Demonic Restoration
traits.description: If the chasme dies outside the Abyss, its body dissolves into ichor, and it gains a new body instantly, reviving with all its Hit Points somewhere in the Abyss.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The chasme has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.description: The chasme can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

actions.name: Proboscis
actions.description: m +5, reach 5 ft. 16 (4d6 + 2) Piercing damage plus 21 (6d6) Necrotic damage. If the target is a creature, its Hit Point maximum decreases by an amount equal to the Necrotic damage taken.

bonus_actions.name: Drone
bonus_actions.description: con DC 12, each creature in a 30-foot Emanation [Area of Effect] originating from the chasme (demons automatically succeed on this save). The target has the Unconscious condition and repeats the save at the end of each of its turns. The target succeeds automatically after 10 minutes or if it takes damage or a creature within 5 feet of it takes an action to empty a flask of Holy Water on it. The target is immune to this chasme's Drone for 24 hours.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The giant makes two greatclub attacks or two unarmed attacks.

actions.name: Greatclub
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 18 (3d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Unarmed Attack
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 12 (3d4 + 5) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Rock
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack +8 to hit, range 60/240 ft., one target. 21 (3d10 + 5) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The chimera makes one Ram attack, one Bite attack, and one Claw attack. It can replace the Claw attack with a use of Fire Breath if available.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: m +7, reach 5 ft. 11 (2d6 + 4) Piercing damage, or 18 (4d6 + 4) Piercing damage if the chimera had Advantage on the attack roll.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: m +7, reach 5 ft. 7 (1d6 + 4) Slashing damage.

actions.name: Ram
actions.description: m +7, reach 5 ft. 10 (1d12 + 4) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the Prone condition.

actions.name: Fire Breath {@recharge 5}
actions.description: dex DC 15, each creature in a 15-foot Cone [Area of Effect]. 31 (7d8) Fire damage. Half damage.

traits.name: Chimeric Creation
traits.description: The fox has fur that changes color to match its surroundings, giving it advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks.

traits.name: Keen Hearing
traits.description: The fox has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. 1 piercing damage.

traits.name: Fey Ancestry
traits.description: The chitine has advantage on saving throws against being charmed, and magic can't put the chitine to sleep.

traits.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
traits.description: While in sunlight, the chitine has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

traits.name: Web Sense
traits.description: While in contact with a web, the chitine knows the exact location of any other creature in contact with the same web.

traits.name: Web Walker
traits.description: The chitine ignores movement restrictions caused by webbing.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The chitine makes three Dagger attacks.

actions.name: Dagger
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.

traits.name: Aberrant Quickness (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
traits.description: The choker can take an extra action on its turn.

traits.name: Boneless
traits.description: The choker can move through and occupy a space as narrow as 4 inches wide without squeezing.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.description: The choker can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The choker makes two Tentacle attacks.

actions.name: Tentacle
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +5 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it is grappled (escape DC 15). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, and the choker can't use this tentacle on another target. The choker has two tentacles. If this attack is a critical hit, the target also can't breathe or speak until the grapple ends.

traits.name: Fey Ancestry
traits.description: The choldrith has advantage on saving throws against being charmed, and magic can't put the choldrith to sleep.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.description: The choldrith can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

traits.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
traits.description: While in sunlight, the choldrith has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

traits.name: Web Sense
traits.description: While in contact with a web, the choldrith knows the exact location of any other creature in contact with the same web.

traits.name: Web Walker
traits.description: The choldrith ignores movement restrictions caused by webbing.

actions.name: Dagger
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) poison damage.

actions.name: Web {@recharge 5}
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack +5 to hit, range 30/60 ft., one Large or smaller creature. The target is restrained by webbing. As an action, the restrained target can make a DC 11 Strength check, bursting the webbing on a success. The webbing can also be attacked and destroyed (AC 10; 5 hit points; vulnerability to fire damage; immunity to bludgeoning, poison, and psychic damage).

bonus_actions.name: Spectral Dagger (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
bonus_actions.description: The choldrith conjures a floating, spectral dagger within 60 feet of itself. The choldrith can make a melee spell attack (+4 to hit) against one creature within 5 feet of the dagger. On a hit, the target takes 6 (1d8 + 2) force damage. The dagger lasts for 1 minute. As a bonus action on later turns, the choldrith can move the dagger up to 20 feet and repeat the attack against one creature within 5 feet of the dagger.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.header: The choldrith casts one of the following spells, using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 12):

actions.name: Silvered Pike
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 5 (1d10) piercing damage.

traits.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
traits.description: While in sunlight, the chupacabra has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 7 (2d4 + 2) piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 13 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

actions.name: Drain Blood
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature that is prone, incapacitated, or restrained. 5 (1d6 + 2) necrotic damage. The target must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or its hit point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the damage taken, and the chupacabra regains hit points equal to that amount. The reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest. The target dies if this effect reduces its hit point maximum to 0.

reactions.name: Pin
reactions.description: If a creature within 5 feet of the chupacabra stands up, the chupacabra can use its reaction to make a bite attack.

name: Chuul
languages: understands Deep Speech but can't speak

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.description: The chuul can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Sense Magic
traits.description: The chuul senses magic within 120 feet of itself. This trait otherwise works like the Detect Magic spell but isn't itself magical.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The chuul makes two Pincer attacks and uses Paralyzing Tentacles.

actions.name: Pincer
actions.description: m +6, reach 10 ft. 9 (1d10 + 4) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 14) from one of two pincers.

actions.name: Paralyzing Tentacles
actions.description: con DC 13, one creature Grappled by the chuul. The target has the Poisoned condition and repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. After 1 minute, it succeeds automatically. While Poisoned, the target has the Paralyzed condition.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The spore servant makes two pincer attacks.

actions.name: Pincer
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage. The target is grappled (Escape DC 14) if it is a Large or smaller creature and the spore servant doesn't have two other creatures grappled.

traits.name: Unusual Nature
traits.description: The chwinga doesn't require air, food, or drink. When it dies, it turns into a handful of flower petals, a cloud of pollen, a stone statuette resembling its former self, a tiny sphere of smooth stone, or a puddle of fresh water (your choice).

traits.name: Evasion
traits.description: When the chwinga is subjected to an effect that allows it to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, it instead takes no damage if it succeeds on the saving throw, and only half damage if it fails.

actions.name: Magical Gift (1/Day)
actions.description: The chwinga targets a humanoid it can see within 5 feet of it. The target gains a type=charm of the DM's choice. See chapter 7 of the Dungeon Masters Guide for more information on supernatural charms.

actions.name: Natural Shelter
actions.description: The chwinga magically takes shelter inside a rock, a living plant, or a natural source of fresh water in its space. The chwinga can't be targeted by any attack, spell, or other effect while inside this shelter, and the shelter doesn't impair the chwinga's blindsight. The chwinga can use its action to emerge from a shelter. If its shelter is destroyed, the chwinga is forced out and appears in the shelter's space, but is otherwise unharmed.

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
spellcasting.header: The chwinga's innate spellcasting ability is Wisdom. It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material or verbal components:

traits.name: Evasion
traits.description: When the chwinga is subjected to an effect that allows it to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, it instead takes no damage if it succeeds on the saving throw, and only half damage if it fails, provided it isn't incapacitated.

traits.name: Unusual Nature
traits.description: The chwinga doesn't require air, food, or drink. When it dies, it turns into a tiny pile of moondust, a cloud of glittering spores, a statuette resembling its former self, a chunk of ice, or a sponge shaped like a dodecahedron (DM's choice).

actions.name: Magical Gift (1/Day)
actions.description: The chwinga targets a Humanoid it can see within 5 feet of itself. The target gains a type=charm of the DM's choice. See chapter 7 for more information on supernatural charms.

actions.name: Natural Shelter
actions.description: The chwinga takes shelter inside a rock, a bush, a tree, or a natural source of fresh water in its space. The chwinga can't be targeted by any attack, spell, or other effect while it is magically protected in this way, and the shelter doesn't impair the chwinga's blindsight. The chwinga can use its action to emerge from a shelter. If its shelter is destroyed, the chwinga is forced out and appears in the shelter's space, but is otherwise unharmed.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.header: The chwinga casts one of the following spells, requiring no material or verbal components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability:

traits.name: Death Burst
traits.description: When the cinder hulk dies, it leaves behind a cloud of cinders and smoke that fills a 10-foot-radius sphere centered on its space. The sphere is heavily obscured. Any creature that moves into the area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or take 10 (3d6) fire damage. The cloud lasts for 1 minute or until it is dispersed by strong wind.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The cinder hulk makes two Slam attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 16 (2d10 + 5) bludgeoning damage plus 10 (3d6) fire damage.

actions.name: Wave of Cinders {@recharge 5}
actions.description: The cinder hulk emits a wave of smoldering ash from its face, hands, or chest in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 31 (7d8) fire damage and has the blinded condition until the end of its next turn. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage only.

actions.name: Golden Pin
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 9 (2d4 + 4) piercing damage.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.description: If the spider fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.description: The spider can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

traits.name: Web Walker
traits.description: The spider ignores movement restrictions caused by webbing.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The spider makes two Bite attacks. It can replace one of these attacks with a use of Web Bomb.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +14 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. 19 (2d10 + 8) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) poison damage.

actions.name: Web Bomb
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack +14 to hit, range 300 ft./600 ft., one target. 24 (3d10 + 8) bludgeoning damage, and the target and all creatures within 10 feet of it must succeed on a DC 19 Dexterity saving throw or take 10 (3d6) acid damage and have the restrained condition until the start of the spider's next turn.

reactions.name: Absorb Blow
reactions.description: In response to being hit with an attack roll, the spider's carapace absorbs some of the blow, reducing the damage it takes by 11 (2d10).

traits.name: Unusual Nature
traits.description: Clapperclaw doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

actions.name: Claws
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 7 (2d4 + 2) slashing damage.

actions.name: Stuffing
actions.description: Clapperclaw stuffs straw or other dead plant matter into itself and regains 2d4 + 2 hit points. Roll a d6; on a 1 or 2, Clapperclaw runs out of stuffing and must spend 8 hours foraging for more before it can use this action again.

bonus_actions.name: Unsettling Presence {@recharge}
bonus_actions.description: Clapperclaw targets one creature it can see within 15 feet of it. The target must succeed on a DC 11 Wisdom saving throw or be magically frightened until the end of Clapperclaw's next turn.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.description: The clawfoot has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the clawfoot's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

traits.name: Pounce

If the target is prone, the clawfoot can make one bite attack against it as a bonus action.

actions.name: Multiattack

actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage.

traits.name: Steadfast

traits.name: Brute

traits.name: Immutable Form

traits.name: Magic Resistance

In addition, the cloaker halves the damage it takes (round down), and the target takes the same amount of damage. The cloaker can detach itself by spending 5 feet of movement. The target or a creature within 5 feet of it can take an action to try to detach the cloaker, doing so by succeeding on a DC 14 Strength (Athletics) check.

actions.name: Tail
actions.description: m +6, reach 10 ft. 8 (1d10 + 3) Slashing damage.

spellcasting.name: Phantasms (Recharge after a Short or Long Rest)
