spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.header: The dragon casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 13):

spellcasting.name: Superior Invisibility
spellcasting.header: The dragon casts Greater Invisibility on itself, requiring no spell components and using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The dragon has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: m +5, reach 5 ft. 5 (1d4 + 3) Piercing damage plus 2 (1d4) Psychic damage.

actions.name: Euphoria Breath {@recharge 5}
actions.description: wis DC 12, each creature in a 15-foot Cone [Area of Effect]. The target has the Incapacitated condition until the end of its next turn and uses all its movement on its turn to move in a random direction.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.header: The dragon casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 12):

spellcasting.name: Superior Invisibility
spellcasting.header: The dragon casts Greater Invisibility on itself, requiring no spell components and using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

traits.name: Faerie Illumination
traits.description: The faerie sheds dim light in a 15-foot radius.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The faerie makes two Shining Strike attacks.

actions.name: Shining Strike
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Spell Attack +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30 ft., one target. 7 (2d6) radiant damage, and if the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw or be wreathed in light until the end of the faerie's next turn. While a creature is wreathed in light, attack rolls against the creature have advantage, and the creature can't benefit from the invisible condition.

bonus_actions.name: Guiding Light (2/Day)
bonus_actions.description: The faerie summons a 30-foot-radius sphere of magical light centered on itself, which lasts for 1 minute or until the faerie has the incapacitated condition. Each creature of the faerie's choice (other than the faerie) that starts its turn in that area gains 5 temporary hit points and has advantage on Wisdom saving throws and Wisdom checks until the start of its next turn. The sphere is bright light, sheds dim light for an additional 30 feet, and moves with the faerie. If any of the sphere's area overlaps with an area of darkness created by a spell of 3rd level or lower, the spell that created the darkness is dispelled.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.header: The faerie casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability:

actions.name: Stingblade
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 6 (1d6 + 3) slashing damage plus 5 (2d4) poison damage. If the faerie had advantage on the attack roll, the target takes an additional 3 (1d6) slashing damage.

actions.name: Theft of Nerves (1/Day)
actions.description: The faerie unleashes a burst of mind-muddling magic in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that area must succeed on a DC 12 Intelligence saving throw or have the frightened condition for 1 minute. A frightened creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

bonus_actions.name: Mischievous Stealth
bonus_actions.description: The faerie takes the Hide action.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.header: The faerie casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 12):

traits.name: Fey Ancestry
traits.description: Faerl has advantage on saving throws against being charmed, and magic can't put him to sleep.

actions.name: Rapier
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 5 (1d8 + 1) piercing damage.

reactions.name: Parry
reactions.description: Faerl adds 2 to his AC against one melee attack that would hit it. To do so, he must see the attacker and be wielding a melee weapon.

traits.name: Archer
traits.description: A longbow or shortbow deals one extra die of its damage when Falcon hits with it (included in his longbow attack).

traits.name: Sharpshooter
traits.description: Falcon's ranged weapon attacks ignore half cover and three-quarters cover.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Falcon makes three melee attacks or two ranged attacks.

actions.name: Longsword
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 6 (1d8 + 2) slashing damage, or 7 (1d10 + 2) slashing damage if used with two hands.

actions.name: Longbow
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack +4 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. 11 (2d8 + 2) piercing damage.

traits.name: Staff of the Woodlands
traits.description: This staff can be wielded as a magic quarterstaff that grants a +2 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with it and grants Faldorn a +2 bonus to spell attack rolls (already factored into Faldorn's attacks). The staff has 10 charges. It regains 1d6 + 4 expended charges each dawn. Faldorn can use an action to expend 1 or more of the staff's charges to cast one of the following spells from it, with a spell save DC of 14: 0 charges: pass without trace 1 charge each: animal friendship, speak with animals 2 charges each: barkskin, locate animals or plants 3 charges: speak with plants 5 charges: awaken 6 charges: wall of thorns

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Faldorn makes two Staff of the Woodlands attacks and uses Spellcasting. Or she uses Spellcasting and then Change Shape if available.

actions.name: Staff of the Woodlands
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 6 (1d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage, or 7 (1d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage if wielded with two hands plus 7 (2d6) acid damage.

actions.name: Shadowlight {@recharge}
actions.description: A beam of dim light emerges from Faldorn in a 5-foot-wide, 300-foot-long line. Each creature in the line must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 27 (6d8) radiant damage and is blinded until Faldorn's next turn. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage and isn't blinded.

actions.name: Change Shape (2/Day)
actions.description: Faldorn magically polymorphs into a Beast or Elemental with a challenge rating of 6 or less, and can remain in this form for up to 9 hours. Faldorn reverts to her true form if she dies or falls unconscious. She can revert to her true form using a bonus action on her turn. While in a new form, Faldorn retains her game statistics and ability to speak, but her AC, movement modes, Strength, and Dexterity are replaced by those of the new form, and she gains any special senses, proficiencies, traits, actions, and reactions (except class features, legendary actions, and lair actions) that the new form has but that she lacks. She can cast her spells with verbal or somatic components in her new form. The new form's attacks count as magical for the purpose of overcoming resistances and immunity to nonmagical attacks.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.header: Faldorn casts one of the following spells, using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 18):

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.description: If the false lich fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The false lich has advantage on saving throws against spells and magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The false lich makes two Death Rend attacks and uses Bloodcurdling Lament if available.

actions.name: Death Rend
actions.description: Melee Spell Attack +14 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 23 (3d10 + 7) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Bloodcurdling Lament {@recharge 5}
actions.description: The false lich emits a hideous shriek charged with malignant energy. Each creature within 30 feet of the false lich must succeed on a DC 22 Wisdom saving throw or have the frightened condition for 1 minute. While frightened in this way, a creature also has the unconscious condition. An affected creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

bonus_actions.name: Soul Siphon
bonus_actions.description: The false lich targets one creature it can see within 120 feet of itself. The target must make a DC 22 Charisma saving throw; if the target has the unconscious condition, it has disadvantage on this saving throw. The target takes 21 (6d6) force damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. The false lich then regains a number of hit points equal to the amount of force damage taken. If this damage reduces the target to 0 hit points, the target immediately dies, its body disappears, and its soul is trapped inside one of the soul gems within the false lich's skull. After 24 hours, the gem transfers the soul to the false lich's creator. When the false lich is reduced to 0 hit points, it is destroyed and disintegrates, leaving behind the gems. Crushing a gem releases any souls trapped within, at which point the soul's body re-forms in an unoccupied space nearest to the gem and in the same state as it was when its soul was trapped.

legendary_actions.name: Spiteful Teleport
legendary_actions.description: The false lich, along with anything it is wearing or carrying, teleports to an unoccupied space it can see within 60 feet of itself. It then makes one Death Rend attack if possible.

legendary_actions.name: Cast a Spell (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.description: The false lich uses Spellcasting.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.header: The false lich casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 22):

traits.name: Boundless Movement
traits.description: The farastu ignores difficult terrain, and magical effects can't reduce its speed. It can spend 5 feet of movement to automatically remove the grappled condition from itself.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The farastu has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.description: The farastu can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without an ability check.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The farastu makes two Claw attacks and one Bite attack.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 16 (2d10 + 5) slashing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the grappled condition (escape DC 15, with disadvantage). The farastu has two claws, each of which can grapple one creature.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +9 to hit (with advantage against a creature the farastu is grappling), reach 5 ft., one target. 12 (2d6 + 5) piercing damage plus 24 (7d6) acid damage.

actions.name: Summon Demodand (1/Day)
actions.description: The farastu has a 40 percent chance of summoning 1 farastu demodand. A summoned demodand appears in an unoccupied space within 60 feet of the farastu, acts as an ally of the farastu, and can't summon other demodands. It remains for 1 minute, until it or the farastu dies, or until the farastu dismisses it as an action.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.header: The farastu casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability:

traits.name: Adhesive Slime
traits.description: The farastu secretes a thick, tar-like slime and it can choose to use this slime to secure enemies that it has grappled or to make weapons become attached to it. It is able to end the adhesion with a bonus action, causing all items and creatures secured to it to be released. The adhesion also ends after the farastu dies.

traits.name: Devil's Sight
traits.description: Magical darkness doesn't impede the farastu's darkvision.

traits.name: Keen Smell
traits.description: The farastu has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The farastu has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Magic Weapons
traits.description: The farastu's weapon attacks are magical.

traits.name: Reckless
traits.description: At the start of its turn, the farastu can gain advantage on all melee weapon attack rolls it makes during that turn, but attack rolls against it have advantage until the start of its next turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The farastu makes one Bite attack and two Claws attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claws
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 7 (1d6 + 4) slashing damage. The target is held fast by the farastu's adhesive slime (grappled condition, escape DC 15) if the farastu isn't already grappling a creature.

reactions.name: Adhesive Hide
reactions.description: After taking damage from a melee weapon, the farastu uses its reaction to attach the weapon to its hide. The attacker must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, the weapon becomes attached to the farastu's adhesive hide until the farastu dies or releases the weapon. A creature can also use an action to make a DC 15 Strength check, prying the weapon free from the farastu, if successful.

traits.name: Quickness {@recharge 5}
traits.description: The fastieth can take the Dodge action as a bonus action.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 8 (1d8 + 4) piercing damage.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (2/Day)
traits.description: If the hag fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Trace the Threads (1/Day)
traits.description: The hag can cast the Legend Lore spell, requiring no material components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The hag makes two Shears attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Spellcasting.

actions.name: Shears
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 8 (1d8 + 4) force damage. If the target is a creature, it has disadvantage on attack rolls until the end of the hag's next turn.

legendary_actions.name: Destined Jaunt
legendary_actions.description: The hag magically teleports, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, to an unoccupied space it can see within 30 feet of itself.

legendary_actions.name: Tangle Threads
legendary_actions.description: The hag magically tangles a creature it can see within 60 feet of itself in spectral silver threads. The creature must succeed on a DC 14 Strength saving throw, or its speed is reduced to 0 until the end of its next turn.

legendary_actions.name: Destiny Curse (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.description: The hag magically curses a creature it can see within 60 feet of itself. The creature must make a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw, and the creature has disadvantage on this save if it has damaged the hag within the last minute. On a failed save, the creature has disadvantage on ability checks, attack rolls, and saving throws until the curse ends. Once per turn, when the cursed creature fails one of those d20 rolls, it takes 7 (2d6) force damage. The curse ends after 1 minute; when the creature succeeds on a total of three ability checks, attack rolls, or saving throws in any combination; or when the hag uses this action again.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.header: While holding its shears, the hag casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 14):

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The shaker makes two Golden Rod or Radiant Bolt attacks.

actions.name: Golden Rod
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 6 (1d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage plus 9 (2d8) radiant damage.

actions.name: Radiant Bolt
actions.description: Ranged Spell Attack +6 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. 14 (2d10 + 3) radiant damage.

bonus_actions.name: Commanding Words
bonus_actions.description: The shaker speaks magical words to order a creature it can see within 30 feet of itself. The target must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or be affected by one of the following effects (choose one or roll a d4): 1-2: Grovel. The target takes 14 (4d6) psychic damage, drops whatever it is holding, and has the prone condition. 3-4: Cower. The target takes 10 (3d6) psychic damage and has the frightened condition until the end of its next turn.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.header: The shaker casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 14):

traits.name: Shapechanger (2/Day)
traits.description: The fathomer can use its action to polymorph into a Medium serpent composed of water, or back into its true form. Anything the fathomer is wearing or carrying is subsumed into the serpent form during the change, inaccessible until the fathomer returns to its true form. The fathomer reverts to its true form after 4 hours, unless it can expend another use of this trait. If the fathomer is knocked unconscious or dies, it also reverts to its true form. While in serpent form, the fathomer gains a swimming speed of 40 feet, the ability to breathe underwater, immunity to poison damage, as well as resistance to fire damage and bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical attacks. It also has immunity to the following conditions: exhaustion, grappled, paralyzed, poisoned, restrained, prone, unconscious. The serpent form can enter a hostile creature's space and stop there. In addition, if water can pass through a space, the serpent can do so without squeezing.

traits.name: Olhydra's Armor (Human Form Only)
traits.description: The fathomer can cast mage armor at will, without expending material components.

actions.name: Constrict (Serpent Form Only)
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 9 (2d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage. If the target is Medium or smaller, it is grappled (escape DC 12). Until the grapple ends, the target is restrained, and the fathomer can't constrict another target.

actions.name: Dagger (Human Form Only)
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting (Human Form Only)
spellcasting.header: The fathomer is a 5th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 12, +4 to hit with spell attacks). It has two 3rd-level spell slots, which it regains after finishing a short or long rest, and knows the following warlock spells:

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The knight makes two melee attacks.

actions.name: Longsword
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 6 (1d8 + 2) slashing damage, or 7 (1d10 + 2) slashing damage if used with two hands.

actions.name: Spear
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage, or 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.header: The knight is a 1st-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 12, +4 to hit with spell attacks). It knows the following sorcerer spell:

traits.name: Pounce
traits.description: If the felidar moves at least 20 feet straight toward a creature and then hits it with a claws attack on the same turn, the target must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. If the target is prone, the felidar can make one bite attack against it as a bonus action.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The felidar has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Magic Weapons
traits.description: The felidar's weapon attacks are magical.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The felidar makes two attacks with its claws.

actions.name: Claws
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 8 (1d8 + 4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Healing Touch (3/Day)
actions.description: The felidar touches another creature with its horns. The target magically regains 11 (2d8 + 2) hit points. In addition, the touch removes all diseases and neutralizes all poisons afflicting the target

actions.name: Teleport (1/Day)
actions.description: The felidar magically teleports itself and up to three willing creatures it can see within 5 feet of it, along with any equipment they are wearing or carrying, to a location the felidar is familiar with, up to 1 mile away.

legendary_actions.name: Claws
legendary_actions.description: The felidar makes one attack with its claws.

legendary_actions.name: Shimmering Shield (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.description: The felidar creates a shimmering magical field around itself or another creature it can see within 60 feet of it. The target gains a +2 bonus to AC until the end of the felidar's next turn.

legendary_actions.name: Heal Self (Costs 3 Actions)
legendary_actions.description: The felidar magically regains 11 (2d8 + 2) hit points.

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
spellcasting.header: The felidar's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 14). The felidar can innately cast the following spells, requiring no components:

traits.name: Extraordinary Leap
traits.description: The distance of the steeder's long jumps is tripled; every foot of its walking speed that it spends on the jump allows it to move 3 feet.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.description: The steeder can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage plus 9 (2d8) poison damage.

actions.name: Sticky Leg
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one Medium or smaller creature. The target is stuck to the steeder's leg and grappled (escape DC 12). The steeder can have only one creature grappled at a time.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Fennor makes two attacks with her greatsword

actions.name: Greatsword
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 10 (2d6 + 3) slashing damage.

traits.name: Death Curse
traits.description: When the fensir starts its turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate, it releases a curse on those around it. Each creature within 30 feet of the fensir when it dies must succeed on a DC 13 Charisma saving throw or be cursed for the next 24 hours. While cursed in this way, an affected creature gains no benefit from finishing a short or long rest. At the end of every hour, the creature must succeed on a DC 13 Charisma saving throw or take 11 (2d10) psychic damage.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.description: The fensir regains 10 hit points at the start of its turn if it isn't in sunlight. If the fensir takes acid or fire damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of the fensir's next turn. The fensir dies only if it starts its turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate.

traits.name: Sunlight Hypersensitivity
traits.description: When the fensir starts its turn in sunlight, it must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or have the petrified condition until the fensir is no longer in sunlight.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The fensir makes two attacks, using Rend, Boulder, or a combination of them.

actions.name: Rend
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 21 (3d10 + 5) slashing damage.

actions.name: Boulder
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack +8 to hit, range 60/240 ft., one target. 18 (2d12 + 5) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it must succeed on a DC 16 Strength saving throw or have the prone condition. After the fensir throws the boulder, roll a d6; on a roll of 4 or lower, the fensir has no more boulders to throw.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.description: The fensir regains 10 hit points at the start of its turn if it isn't in sunlight. If the fensir takes acid or fire damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of the fensir's next turn. The fensir dies only if it starts its turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate.

traits.name: Sunlight Hypersensitivity
traits.description: When the fensir starts its turn in sunlight, it must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or have the petrified condition until the fensir is no longer in sunlight.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The fensir makes three Battleaxe attacks or two Magic Stone attacks.

actions.name: Battleaxe
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 13 (2d8 + 4) slashing damage, or 15 (2d10 + 4) slashing damage if used with two hands.

actions.name: Magic Stone
actions.description: Ranged Spell Attack +5 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. 15 (2d12 + 2) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it must succeed on a DC 13 Strength saving throw or have the prone condition.

actions.name: Mud to Stone {@recharge}
actions.description: The fensir lobs a magical mass of mud that splashes all creatures in a 30-foot-radius sphere centered on a point the fensir can see within 60 feet of itself. Each non-fensir creature in that area must succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw or take 13 (3d8) bludgeoning damage and have the restrained condition as the mud begins to turn to stone. An affected creature must repeat the saving throw at the end of its next turn. On a successful save, the effect ends on the creature. On a failed save, the creature has the petrified condition for 24 hours.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.header: The fensir casts one of the following spells, using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability:

name: Feral Ashenwight
languages: understands the languages it knew in life but can't speak

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The ashenwight makes two Necrotic Shard attacks.

actions.name: Necrotic Shard
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft., one target. 7 (1d6 + 4) necrotic damage. If the target is a creature, it has disadvantage on the next attack roll it makes before the end of its next turn.

traits.name: Bladed Edges
traits.description: A creature takes 10 (3d6) slashing damage if it starts its turn grappling or being grappled by the ferrumach.

traits.name: Skewering Charge
traits.description: If the ferrumach moves at least 20 feet in a straight line toward a Large or smaller creature and ends within 5 feet of it, that creature must succeed on a DC 16 Strength saving throw or have the grappled condition (escape DC 18) and take 10 (3d6) piercing damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The ferrumach makes three Sharpened Limb or Bolt attacks.

actions.name: Sharpened Limb
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 9 (1d10 + 4) slashing damage plus 11 (2d10) psychic damage.

actions.name: Bolt
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack +8 to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage plus 11 (2d10) psychic damage.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.header: The ferrumach casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 14):

actions.name: Greatclub
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Javelin
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft., one target. 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The spirit makes a number of Fey Blade attacks equal to half this spell's level (round down).

actions.name: Fey Blade
actions.description: m Bonus equals your spell attack modifier, reach 5 ft. 2d6 + 3 + summonSpellLevel Force damage.

bonus_actions.name: Fey Step
bonus_actions.description: The spirit magically teleports up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space it can see. Then one of the following effects occurs, based on the spirit's chosen mood: Fuming. The spirit has Advantage on the next attack roll it makes before the end of this turn. Mirthful. wis DC equals your spell save DC, one creature the spirit can see within 10 feet of itself. The target is Charmed by you and the spirit for 1 minute or until the target takes any damage. Tricksy. The spirit fills a 10-foot Cube within 5 feet of it with magical Darkness, which lasts until the end of its next turn.

traits.name: Unusual Nature
traits.description: The feyr doesn't require air.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The feyr makes one Frightful Bite attack and one Tentacle attack.

actions.name: Frightful Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. 8 (1d10 + 3) piercing damage, and each creature within 10 feet of the feyr that can see it must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened of the feyr until the end of the feyr's next turn.

actions.name: Tentacle
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. 17 (4d6 + 3) psychic damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 13). Until this grapple ends, the feyr can't use this tentacle against other targets. The feyr has two tentacles, each of which can grapple one creature.

actions.name: Invisibility
actions.description: The feyr becomes invisible until it attacks, uses Nightmare Fuel, or uses a bonus action to become visible.

actions.name: Nightmare Fuel (1/Day)
actions.description: The feyr targets one unconscious creature it can see within 10 feet of itself. The target must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or take 27 (5d10) psychic damage, and the feyr gains temporary hit points equal to the damage dealt.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The cultist makes three Pact Axe attacks.

actions.name: Pact Axe
actions.description: m +7, reach 5 ft. 10 (1d12 + 4) Slashing damage plus 13 (3d8) Fire damage.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.header: The cultist casts one of the following spells, using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 15, +7 to hit with spell attacks):

spellcasting.name: Hellish Rebuke
spellcasting.header: The cultist casts Hellish Rebuke in response to that spell's trigger, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

traits.name: Siege Monster
traits.description: The auger deals double damage to objects and structures.

traits.name: Tunneler
traits.description: The auger can burrow through solid rock at half its burrow speed and leaves a 10-foot-diameter tunnel in its wake.

actions.name: Flaming Drill
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 17 (2d10 + 6) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) fire damage. If the auger moves at least 20 feet in a straight line toward the target immediately before the hit, the target takes an additional 11 (2d10) piercing damage, and if the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 17 Strength saving throw or have the prone condition.

bonus_actions.name: Burst of Heat {@recharge 5}
bonus_actions.description: The auger releases an intense burst of heat in a 30-foot-radius sphere centered on itself. This heat spreads around corners. Each creature in this area must make a DC 17 Constitution saving throw, taking 13 (3d8) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

name: Fiendish Flesh Golem
languages: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

traits.name: Berserk
traits.description: Whenever the golem starts its turn with 100 hit points or fewer, roll a d6. On a 6, the golem goes berserk. On each of its turns while berserk, the golem attacks the nearest creature it can see. If no creature is near enough to move to and attack, the golem attacks an object, with preference for an object smaller than itself. Once the golem goes berserk, it continues to do so until it is destroyed or regains all its hit points. If the golem's creator is within 60 feet of the berserk golem, the creator can try to calm it by speaking firmly and persuasively. The golem must be able to hear its creator, who must take an action to make a DC 15 Charisma (Persuasion) check. If the check succeeds, the golem ceases being berserk. If it takes damage while still at 100 hit points or fewer, the golem might go berserk again.

traits.name: Immutable Form
traits.description: The golem is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

traits.name: Lightning Absorption
traits.description: Whenever the golem is subjected to lightning damage, it takes no damage and instead regains a number of hit points equal to the lightning damage dealt.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The golem has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Magic Weapons
traits.description: The golem's weapon attacks are magical.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The golem makes two slam attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 16 (2d10 + 5) bludgeoning damage.

traits.name: Hive Mind
traits.description: All fiendish formians within 1 mile of Ekengarik can telepathically communicate with each other and Ekengarik.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The fiendish formian makes two Claw attacks.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 7 (1d6 + 4) slashing damage.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 8 (1d8 + 4) piercing damage and the target must make a DC 14 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the target's Strength score is reduced by 1. The target dies if this reduces its Strength to 0. Otherwise, the reduction lasts until the target finishes a short or long rest.

name: Fiendish Icon
languages: understands Common and Infernal but can't speak

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The icon has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The icon makes two Slam attacks and uses Fiery Eruption.

actions.name: Slam
actions.description: m +4, reach 5 ft. 4 (1d4 + 2) Bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Fiery Eruption
actions.description: dex DC 11, each creature in a 5-foot Emanation [Area of Effect] originating from the icon. 7 (2d6) Fire damage.

traits.name: Death Throes (Demon Only)
traits.description: When the spirit drops to 0 Hit Points or the spell ends, the spirit explodes. dex DC equals your spell save DC, each creature in a 10-foot Emanation originating from the spirit. 2d10 plus this spell's level Fire damage. Half damage.

traits.name: Devil's Sight (Devil Only)
traits.description: Magical Darkness doesn't impede the spirit's Darkvision.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The spirit has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The spirit makes a number of attacks equal to half this spell's level (round down).

actions.name: Bite (Demon Only)
actions.description: m Bonus equals your spell attack modifier, reach 5 ft. 1d12 + 3 + summonSpellLevel Necrotic damage.

actions.name: Claws (Yugoloth Only)
actions.description: m Bonus equals your spell attack modifier, reach 5 ft. 1d8 + 3 + summonSpellLevel Slashing damage. Immediately after the attack hits or misses, the spirit can teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

actions.name: Fiery Strike (Devil Only)
actions.description: m,r Bonus equals your spell attack modifier, reach 5 ft. or range 150 ft. 2d6 + 3 + summonSpellLevel Fire damage.

traits.name: Fear Aura
traits.description: When a creature starts their turn within 120 feet of Fierna, they must succeed on a DC 22 Wisdom saving throw or have the frightened condition until they leave the aura. A creature that succeeds on the saving throw is immune to this effect for 1 hour.

traits.name: Fiendish Regeneration
traits.description: Fierna regains 20 hit points at the start of her turn. If she takes radiant damage this trait doesn't function at the start of her next turn. Fierna dies only if she starts her turn with 0 hit points and is unable to regenerate.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.description: If Fierna fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: Fierna has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Princess of Hellfire
traits.description: Fire conjured by Fierna becomes Hellfire. It ignores resistances and immunities to fire damage, deals double damage to creatures vulnerable to fire or necrotic damage, can't be extinguished through any means, and is capable of melting stone or igniting inflammable objects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Fierna makes three attacks using Flame Blade, Mote of Flame, or a combination of the two.

actions.name: Flame Blade
actions.description: Melee Spell Attack +20 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 23 (4d6 + 9) fire damage.

actions.name: Mote of Flame
actions.description: Fierna targets a creature she can see within 90 feet of her. The target must make a DC 25 Dexterity saving throw, taking 22 (3d8 + 9) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

reactions.name: Wreath of Flames
reactions.description: When hit by a melee attack and Fierna can see her attacker, she covers herself in Hellfire, and the attacker takes 13 (3d8) fire damage.

legendary_actions.name: Blade
legendary_actions.description: Fierna makes a Flame Blade attack.

legendary_actions.name: Conjure Hellfire (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.description: Fierna chooses a point she can see within 150 feet of her. All creatures in a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on that point must make a DC 25 Dexterity saving throw, taking 28 (8d6) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

legendary_actions.name: Call Underling (Costs 3 Actions)
legendary_actions.description: Fierna summons an allied spined devil in an unoccupied space that she can see.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The firbolg makes two Spear or Fire Lance attacks.

actions.name: Spear
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage plus 9 (2d8) fire damage.

actions.name: Fire Lance
actions.description: Ranged Spell Attack +5 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. 14 (2d10 + 3) fire damage.

bonus_actions.name: Hidden Step (2/Day)
bonus_actions.description: The firbolg magically turns invisible until the start of its next turn, until it makes an attack roll, or until it forces someone to make a saving throw.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.header: The firbolg casts one of the following spells, using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 13):

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The firbolg makes two attacks using Longsword, Bewitching Bolt, or a combination of them.

actions.name: Longsword
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 7 (1d8 + 3) slashing damage, or 8 (1d10 + 3) slashing damage if used with two hands, plus 9 (2d8) psychic damage.

actions.name: Bewitching Bolt
actions.description: Ranged Spell Attack +6 to hit, range 60 ft., one creature. 10 (2d6 + 3) psychic damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 14 Charisma saving throw or have the charmed condition until the start of the target's next turn.

bonus_actions.name: Duplicitous Movement (1/Day)
bonus_actions.description: The firbolg projects an illusory duplicate of itself in an unoccupied space it can see within 30 feet of itself. The firbolg can then swap places with the illusion. The illusion vanishes after 1 minute, if the firbolg is incapacitated, or if the illusion is more than 120 feet from the firbolg. As a bonus action on later turns, the firbolg can move the illusion up to 30 feet and can then swap places with it.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.header: The firbolg casts one of the following spells, using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 14):

traits.name: Fire Aura
traits.description: At the end of each of the elemental's turns, each creature in a 10-foot Emanation [Area of Effect] originating from the elemental takes 5 (1d10) Fire damage. Creatures and flammable objects in the Emanation [Area of Effect] start burning.

traits.name: Fire Form
traits.description: The elemental can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch without expending extra movement to do so, and it can enter a creature's space and stop there. The first time it enters a creature's space on a turn, that creature takes 5 (1d10) Fire damage.

traits.name: Illumination
traits.description: The elemental sheds Bright Light in a 30-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 30 feet.

traits.name: Water Susceptibility
traits.description: The elemental takes 3 (1d6) Cold damage for every 5 feet the elemental moves in water or for every gallon of water splashed on it.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The elemental makes two Burn attacks.

actions.name: Burn
actions.description: m +6, reach 5 ft. 10 (2d6 + 3) Fire damage. If the target is a creature or a flammable object, it starts burning.

name: Fire Elemental Myrmidon
languages: one language of its creator's choice

traits.name: Illumination
traits.description: The myrmidon sheds bright light in a 20-foot radius and dim light in a 40-foot radius.

traits.name: Water Susceptibility
traits.description: For every 5 feet the myrmidon moves in 1 foot or more of water, it takes 2 (1d4) cold damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The myrmidon makes three Scimitar attacks.

actions.name: Scimitar
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 7 (1d6 + 4) force damage.

actions.name: Fiery Strikes {@recharge}
actions.description: The myrmidon uses Multiattack. Each attack that hits deals an extra 7 (2d6) fire damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The giant makes two attacks, using Flame Sword or Hammer Throw in any combination.

actions.name: Flame Sword
actions.description: m +11, reach 10 ft. 21 (4d6 + 7) Slashing damage plus 10 (3d6) Fire damage.

actions.name: Hammer Throw
actions.description: r +11, range 60/240 ft. 23 (3d10 + 7) Bludgeoning damage plus 4 (1d8) Fire damage, and the target is pushed up to 15 feet straight away from the giant and has Disadvantage on the next attack roll it makes before the end of its next turn.

traits.name: Dual Shields
traits.description: The giant carries two shields, which together give the giant +3 to its AC (accounted for above).

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The giant makes two Fireshield or Rock attacks.

actions.name: Fireshield
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +13 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 22 (4d6 + 8) bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) fire damage plus 7 (2d6) piercing damage.

actions.name: Rock
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack +13 to hit, range 60/240 ft., one target. 30 (4d10 + 8) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Shield Charge {@recharge 5}
actions.description: The giant moves up to 30 feet in a straight line and can move through the space of any creature smaller than Huge. The first time it enters a creature's space during this move, that creature must succeed on a DC 21 Strength saving throw or take 36 (8d6 + 8) bludgeoning damage plus 14 (4d6) fire damage and be pushed up to 30 feet and knocked prone.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.description: If the giant fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Fire Rune
traits.description: The giant has a fire rune inscribed on a medallion or some other object in its possession. While holding or wearing the object bearing the rune, the giant can use its Magma Wave action and Furnace Armor bonus action. The object bearing the rune has AC 15; 40 hit points; and immunity to necrotic, poison, and psychic damage. The object regains all its hit points at the end of every turn, but it turns to dust if reduced to 0 hit points or when the giant dies. If the rune is destroyed, the giant can inscribe a fire rune on an object in its possession when it finishes a short or long rest.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The giant makes three Forge Hammer attacks or two Heated Rock attacks.

actions.name: Forge Hammer
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +13 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 24 (5d6 + 7) bludgeoning damage. The giant can cause the hammer to emit a burst of heat in a 30-foot-radius sphere centered on the target. Metal objects in that area glow red-hot until the start of the giant's next turn. Any creature in physical contact with a heated object at the start of its turn must make a DC 19 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 10 (3d6) fire damage and has disadvantage on attack rolls until the start of its next turn unless it has immunity to fire damage. The hammer can emit heat in this way only once per turn.

actions.name: Heated Rock
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack +13 to hit, range 60/240 ft., one target. 23 (3d10 + 7) bludgeoning damage plus 19 (3d12) fire damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it must succeed on a DC 21 Strength saving throw or have the prone condition. After the giant throws the rock, roll a d6; on a roll of 3 or lower, the giant has no more rocks to throw.

actions.name: Magma Wave (Requires Fire Rune)
actions.description: The giant emits a wave of magma from its fire rune in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 19 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 36 (8d8) fire damage and has the restrained condition. As an action, a creature can make a DC 19 Strength (Athletics) check, freeing itself or a creature within its reach from the rock on a success. The rock restraining each creature has AC 17; 20 hit points; and immunity to fire, poison, and psychic damage. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage only.

bonus_actions.name: Furnace Armor (Requires Fire Rune)
bonus_actions.description: The giant causes smoke and cinders to billow from its armor, filling a 30-foot-radius sphere centered on the giant. While the armor is billowing smoke, the giant has half cover. The armor stops billowing smoke after 1 minute, when the giant dies, when the giant uses a bonus action to end the effect, or when the giant's fire rune is destroyed.

traits.name: Shrapnel Explosion
traits.description: When the giant drops to 0 hit points, its armor explodes, destroying the giant's body and scattering the armor as shrapnel. Creatures within 10 feet of the giant when its armor explodes must make a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw, taking 21 (6d6) piercing damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The giant makes two Searing Scepter attacks or two Bolt of Imix attacks.

actions.name: Searing Scepter
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 17 (3d6 + 7) bludgeoning damage plus 9 (2d8) fire damage, and the target is magically branded. While branded in this way, the target becomes visible if it's invisible, can't become invisible, and sheds dim light in a 5-foot radius. The brand disappears after 24 hours, or it can be removed from a creature or an object by any spell that ends a curse.

actions.name: Bolt of Imix
actions.description: Ranged Spell Attack +8 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. 20 (3d10 + 4) fire damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw or have the frightened condition until the end of the target's next turn.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The hellion has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Soul Taker
traits.description: A Giant or a Humanoid that is reduced to 0 hit points by the hellion dies, and its soul rises as a lemure (see the Monster Manual) on Avernus, one of the Nine Hells, in 1d4 hours. If the creature isn't revived before then, it can be restored to life only by a wish spell or by killing the lemure and casting true resurrection on the creature's original body.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The hellion makes two Morningstar attacks.

actions.name: Morningstar
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 20 (3d8 + 7) piercing damage plus 11 (2d10) fire damage. If the target is a creature, it can't regain hit points until the start of the hellion's next turn.

actions.name: Infernal Orb
actions.description: The hellion hurls a magical ball of fire that explodes in a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on a point the hellion can see within 120 feet of itself. The sphere spreads around corners. Each creature in that area must make a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw. A creature takes 18 (4d8) fire damage and 18 (4d8) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

traits.name: Freedom of Movement
traits.description: The kraken ignores difficult terrain, and magical effects can't reduce its speed or cause it to be restrained. It can spend 5 feet of movement to escape from nonmagical restraints or grapples.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.description: If the kraken fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Siege Monster
traits.description: The kraken deals double damage to objects and structures.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The kraken makes two attacks using its Tentacle, Fling, or a combination of the two.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +15 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 18 (3d6 + 8) piercing damage and 7 (2d6) fire damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature grappled by the kraken, the creature is swallowed and the grapple ends. While swallowed, a creature has the blinded and restrained conditions, has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the kraken, and takes 42 (12d6) fire damage at the start of the kraken's turns. If the kraken takes 50 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, it must succeed on a DC 23 Constitution saving throw or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, which fall into a space within 10 feet of the kraken and now have the prone condition. If the kraken dies, a swallowed creature is no longer restrained by it and can escape from the corpse using 15 feet of movement, exiting with the prone condition.

actions.name: Tentacle
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +15 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. 13 (2d4 + 8) fire damage. If the target is a Huge or smaller creature, it has the grappled condition (escape DC 16). While grappled, the target also has the restrained condition. Any target that starts its turn grappled by the kraken takes 5 (2d4) fire damage. The kraken has five tentacles, each of which can grapple one target.

actions.name: Fling
actions.description: One Large or smaller object or creature grappled by the kraken is thrown up to 60 feet in a random direction, and now has the prone condition. If a thrown target strikes a solid surface, the target takes 3 (1d6) bludgeoning damage for every 10 feet it was thrown. If the target is thrown at a creature, that creature must succeed on a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw or take the same damage and be knocked down with the prone condition.

legendary_actions.name: Appendage
legendary_actions.description: The kraken makes a Fling attack.

legendary_actions.name: Fire Breath (Costs 3 Actions)
legendary_actions.description: The kraken exhales fire in a 60-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 20 Dexterity saving throw, taking 36 (8d8) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

traits.name: Heated Body
traits.description: A creature that touches the snake or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 3 (1d6) fire damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The snake makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its tail.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 3 (1d4 + 1) piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) fire damage.

actions.name: Tail
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 3 (1d4 + 1) bludgeoning damage plus 3 (1d6) fire damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The firefist makes two greatsword attacks.

actions.name: Greatsword
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 10 (2d6 + 3) slashing damage.

reactions.name: Guided Attack (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
reactions.description: When the firefist or one creature it can see within 30 feet of it makes an attack roll, the firefist grants a +10 bonus to that roll.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.header: The firefist is a 9th-level Boros spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 14, +6 to hit with spell attacks). It has the following cleric spells prepared:

traits.name: Fire Blood
traits.description: Whenever a creature within 5 feet of the firegaunt hits the firegaunt with a melee attack that deals piercing or slashing damage, that creature takes 5 (1d10) fire damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The firegaunt makes two Heated Maul attacks.

actions.name: Heated Maul
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 23 (3d10 + 7) bludgeoning damage. The firegaunt can cause the maul to erupt with crimson flames, and the target must succeed on a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw or take 10 (3d6) fire damage and 10 (3d6) necrotic damage. The maul can erupt with flames in this way only once per turn.

actions.name: Crimson Rays {@recharge 5}
actions.description: The firegaunt emits beams of fire from its eyes, mouth, and wounds in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw, taking 31 (7d8) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. On a success or failure, that creature catches fire. Until the burning creature or another creature that can reach it takes an action to extinguish the fire, the burning creature can't regain hit points and takes 5 (1d10) fire damage at the start of each of its turns.

traits.name: Flyby
traits.description: The angel doesn't provoke an opportunity attack when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The angel has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Relentless (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
traits.description: If the angel takes 21 damage or less that would reduce it to 0 hit points, it is reduced to 1 hit point instead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The angel makes two melee attacks.

actions.name: Longsword
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 10 (1d8 + 6) slashing damage, or 11 (1d10 + 6) slashing damage if used with two hands, plus 22 (5d8) fire or radiant damage (angel's choice).

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
spellcasting.header: The angel's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 18, +10 to hit with spell attacks). The angel can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.description: The firenewt can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Devil's Sight
traits.description: Magical darkness doesn't impede the firenewt's darkvision.

traits.name: Imix's Blessing
traits.description: When the firenewt reduces an enemy to 0 hit points, the firenewt gains 5 temporary hit points.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The firenewt makes three Morningstar or Fire Ray attacks.

actions.name: Morningstar
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 5 (1d8 + 1) piercing damage.

actions.name: Fire Ray
actions.description: Ranged Spell Attack +4 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. 5 (1d6 + 2) fire damage.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.header: The firenewt casts one of the following spells, using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 12):

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.description: The firenewt can breathe air and water.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The firenewt makes two Scimitar attacks.

actions.name: Scimitar
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 4 (1d6 + 1) slashing damage.

actions.name: Spit Fire (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
actions.description: The firenewt spits fire at a creature within 10 feet of it. The creature must make a DC 11 Dexterity saving throw, taking 9 (2d8) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

traits.name: Excited to Be Here
traits.description: The student has advantage on initiative rolls.

actions.name: Magic Flare
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Spell Attack +3 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft., one target. 7 (1d12 + 1) force damage.

reactions.name: Beginner's Luck (2/Day)
reactions.description: When the student fails a saving throw, it can reroll the d20. It must use the new roll.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.header: The student casts one of the following spells, using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 11):

traits.name: Tactical Discipline
traits.description: The fist of Bane has advantage on all ability checks and saving throws made during combat.

actions.name: Mace
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 6 (1d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Longbow
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack +2 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. 4 (1d8) piercing damage.

actions.name: Dagger
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.header: Flabbergast is a 9th-level spellcaster. His spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save DC 13, +5 to hit with spell attacks). He has the following wizard spells prepared:

traits.name: Antimagic Shell
traits.description: The snail has advantage on saving throws against spells, and any creature making a spell attack against the snail has disadvantage on the attack roll. If the snail succeeds on its saving throw against a spell or a spell's attack roll misses it, the snail's shell converts some of the spell's energy into a burst of destructive force if the spell is of 1st level or higher; each creature within 30 feet of the snail must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw, taking 3 (1d6) force damage per level of the spell on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The snail makes five Flail Tentacle attacks.

actions.name: Flail Tentacle
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +5 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 5 (1d4 + 3) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Scintillating Shell (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
actions.description: The snail's shell emits dazzling, colored light until the end of the snail's next turn. During this time, the shell sheds bright light in a 30-foot radius and dim light for an additional 30 feet, and creatures that can see the snail have disadvantage on attack rolls against it. In addition, any creature within the bright light and able to see the snail when this power is activated must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or be stunned until the light ends.

actions.name: Shell Defense
actions.description: The flail snail withdraws into its shell. Until it emerges, it gains a +4 bonus to its AC and is restrained. It can emerge from its shell as a bonus action on its turn.

traits.name: Illumination
traits.description: The flameskull sheds Bright Light in a 15-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 15 feet.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The flameskull has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Undead Restoration
traits.description: If the flameskull is destroyed, it regains all its Hit Points in 1 hour unless Holy Water is sprinkled on its remains or the Dispel Evil and Good spell is cast on them.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The flameskull makes two Fire Ray attacks.

actions.name: Fire Ray
actions.description: m,r +5, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft. 13 (3d6 + 3) Fire damage.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.header: The flameskull casts one of the following spells, requiring no Somatic or Material components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 13):

traits.name: Wreathed in Flame
traits.description: For the flamewrath, the warm version of the fire shield spell has a duration of "until dispelled." The fire shield burns for 10 minutes after the flamewrath dies, consuming its body.

actions.name: Dagger
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.header: The flamewrath is a 7th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 14, +6 to hit with spell attacks). It knows the following sorcerer spells:

name: Flaming Skeleton
languages: understands Common plus one other language but can't speak

traits.name: Death Burst
traits.description: The skeleton explodes when it dies. dex DC 12, each creature in a 10-foot Emanation [Area of Effect] originating from the skeleton. 14 (4d6) Fire damage. Half damage.

traits.name: Illumination
traits.description: The skeleton sheds Bright Light in a 15-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 15 feet.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The skeleton makes two attacks, using Flame Scepter or Hurl Flame in any combination.

actions.name: Flame Scepter
actions.description: m +4, reach 5 ft. 5 (1d6 + 2) Bludgeoning damage plus 3 (1d6) Fire damage.

actions.name: Hurl Flame
actions.description: r +4, range 60 ft. 7 (1d10 + 2) Fire damage.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.header: Flapjack casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 12):

traits.name: Keen Smell
traits.description: The lion has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

traits.name: Pounce
traits.description: If the lion moves at least 20 feet straight toward a creature and then hits it with a claw attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a DC 14 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. If the target is prone, the lion can make one bite attack against it as a bonus action.

traits.name: Running Leap
traits.description: With a 10-foot running start, the lion can long jump up to 25 feet.

traits.name: Spell Turning
traits.description: The lion has advantage on saving throws against any spell that targets only the lion (not an area). If the lion's saving throw succeeds and the spell is of 4th level or lower, the spell has no effect on the lion and instead targets the caster.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The lion makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its claw.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 8 (1d8 + 4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 7 (1d6 + 4) slashing damage.

legendary_actions.name: Claw
legendary_actions.description: The lion makes one claw attack.

legendary_actions.name: Roar (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.description: The lion emits a magical roar. Each creature within 60 feet of the lion that can hear the roar must succeed on a DC 12 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened of the lion until the end of the lion's next turn.

traits.name: Berserk
traits.description: If the core inside the colossus is destroyed, the colossus goes berserk. On each of its turns while berserk, the colossus attacks the nearest creature it can see. If no creature is near enough to move to and attack, the colossus attacks an object. Once the colossus goes berserk, it remains berserk until it is destroyed.

traits.name: Immutable Form
traits.description: The colossus is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The colossus has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Siege Monster
traits.description: The colossus deals double damage to objects and structures.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The colossus makes two Fist attacks.

actions.name: Fist
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +13 to hit (with advantage if the colossus is berserk), reach 20 ft., one target. 17 (3d6 + 7) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it is pulled up to 15 feet toward the colossus, it has the grappled condition (escape DC 17), and it has the restrained condition until this grapple ends. The colossus can have up to two creatures grappled this way at a time.

actions.name: Elemental Breath {@recharge 5}
actions.description: The colossus exhales a cloud swirling with elemental energy in a 90-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 21 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 40 (9d8) damage of a type of the colossus's choosing: acid, cold, fire, or lightning. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage. At the same time as the colossus releases this exhalation, creatures inside the colossus's chest cavity take 40 (9d8) force damage from churning elemental energy.

bonus_actions.name: Bite
bonus_actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +13 to hit, reach 5 ft., one Large or smaller creature grappled by the colossus. 20 (3d8 + 7) bludgeoning damage, and the creature is swallowed. A swallowed creature has the restrained condition, has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the colossus, and takes 10 (3d6) force damage at the start of each of the colossus's turns. The colossus's chest cavity can hold up to two creatures at a time. Inside its chest cavity is its core, which is a Large object with AC 16 that is immune to lightning, poison, and psychic damage. It has 140 hit points and sheds dim light in a 10-foot radius. If the core is destroyed, the colossus regurgitates all swallowed creatures, each of which falls in a space within 10 feet of the colossus and has the prone condition, and the colossus can no longer swallow a creature. If the colossus dies, any swallowed creature no longer has the restrained condition and can escape from the corpse using 10 feet of movement, exiting with the prone condition.

name: Flesh Golem
languages: understands Common plus one other language but can't speak

traits.name: Aversion to Fire
traits.description: If the golem takes Fire damage, it has Disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks until the end of its next turn.

traits.name: Berserk
traits.description: Whenever the golem starts its turn Bloodied, roll 1d6. On a 6, the golem goes berserk. On each of its turns while berserk, the golem attacks the nearest creature it can see. If no creature is near enough to move to and attack, the golem attacks an object. Once the golem goes berserk, it remains so until it is destroyed or it is no longer Bloodied. The golem's creator, if within 60 feet of the berserk golem, can try to calm it by taking an action to make a DC 15 Charisma (Persuasion) check; the golem must be able to hear its creator. If this check succeeds, the golem ceases being berserk until the start of its next turn, at which point it resumes rolling for the Berserk trait again if it is still Bloodied.

traits.name: Immutable Form
traits.description: The golem can't shape-shift.

traits.name: Lightning Absorption
traits.description: Whenever the golem is subjected to Lightning damage, it regains a number of Hit Points equal to the Lightning damage dealt.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The golem has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The golem makes two Slam attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.description: m +7, reach 5 ft. 13 (2d8 + 4) Bludgeoning damage plus 4 (1d8) Lightning damage.

traits.name: Amorphous
traits.description: The flesh meld can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch without squeezing.

traits.name: Aura of Death
traits.description: At the start of each of the flesh meld's turns, each creature within 5 feet of it must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or take 3 (1d6) necrotic damage and have the poisoned condition until the start of the flesh meld's next turn.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The flesh meld has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.description: The flesh meld can climb difficult surfaces, including ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The flesh meld makes two Bite attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +8 to hit, reach 30 ft., one target. 16 (2d10 + 5) piercing damage, and if the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the grappled condition (escape DC 15) and is pulled up to 15 feet toward the flesh meld.

bonus_actions.name: Consume Creature
bonus_actions.description: The flesh meld targets one Large or smaller creature within 5 feet of itself that it's grappling. The target must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or be swallowed by the flesh meld. The flesh meld can have one creature swallowed at a time. A swallowed creature no longer has the grappled condition. While swallowed, it has the blinded and restrained conditions, has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the flesh meld, and takes 10 (3d6) necrotic damage at the start of each of the flesh meld's turns. If this damage reduces a swallowed creature to 0 hit points, the creature dies, and the flesh meld consumes its body. If the flesh meld takes 30 damage or more on a single turn from the swallowed creature, the flesh meld must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate the creature, which falls with the prone condition in a space within 5 feet of the flesh meld. If the flesh meld dies, the swallowed creature is no longer restrained by it and can escape from the corpse by using 10 feet of movement, exiting with the prone condition.

traits.name: Battle Smith
traits.description: Flimp uses his Intelligence modifier for attack and damage rolls with his weapons.

traits.name: Gnome Cunning
traits.description: Flimp has advantage on all Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma Saving Throws against magic.

traits.name: Special Equipment
traits.description: Flimp wears a cloak of the manta ray, a cloak of protection, +2 plate armor, and winged boots. Flimp wields a +2 warhammer. These items vanish 4 days after Flimp dies.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Flimp makes two Magic Warhammer attacks.

actions.name: Magic Warhammer
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 10 (1d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage plus 3 (1d6) force damage.

actions.name: Hurl Acid {@recharge}
actions.description: Flimp hurls a vial of acid at a location within 60 feet. Every creature within 10 feet of the target location must succeed on a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw or take 21 (6d6) acid damage.

actions.name: Summon Steel Defender (1/Day)
actions.description: Flimp summons a metallic panther to aid him in combat. The panther has 24 hit points and is immune to poison damage and the poison and charmed conditions.

reactions.name: Flash of Genius
reactions.description: When Flimp or another creature he can see within 30 feet of him makes an ability check or a saving throw, Flimp can use his reaction to add +4 to the roll.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting

traits.name: Aura of Blood Thirst
traits.description: If the flind isn't incapacitated, any creature with the Rampage trait can make a Bite attack as a bonus action while within 10 feet of the flind.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The flind makes one Flail of Chaos attack, one Flail of Pain attack, and one Flail of Paralysis attack, or it makes three Longbow attacks.

actions.name: Flail of Chaos
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 10 (1d10 + 5) bludgeoning damage, and the target must make a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the target must use its reaction, if available, to make one melee attack against a random creature, other than the flind, within its reach. If there's no creature within reach, the target instead moves half its speed in a random direction.

actions.name: Flail of Pain
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 10 (1d10 + 5) bludgeoning damage plus 16 (3d10) psychic damage.

actions.name: Flail of Paralysis
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 10 (1d10 + 5) bludgeoning damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or be paralyzed until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Longbow
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack +6 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage.

name: Flitterstep Eidolon
languages: the languages it knew in life

traits.name: Blurred Form
traits.description: Attack rolls against the eidolon are made with disadvantage unless the eidolon is incapacitated.

traits.name: Evasion
traits.description: If the eidolon is subjected to an effect that allows it to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, the eidolon instead takes no damage if it succeeds on the saving throw, and only half damage if it fails. It can't use this trait if it's incapacitated.

traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
traits.description: The eidolon can move through other creatures and objects as if they were 3. It takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

traits.name: Turn Resistance
traits.description: The eidolon has advantage on saving throws against any effect that turns undead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The eidolon makes two melee attacks. Immediately before or after one of its attacks, it can use Flitterstep if it is available.

actions.name: Flickering Dagger
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 6 (1d4 + 4) piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) psychic damage.

actions.name: Flitterstep {@recharge 5}
actions.description: The eidolon magically teleports to an unoccupied space it can see within 30 feet of it. If it makes an attack immediately after teleporting, it has advantage on the attack roll.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: Flizzlebin has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Ventriloquist
traits.description: Flizzlebin can project his voice from anywhere within 1 mile of himself.

actions.name: Dazzling Confetti
actions.description: m,r +5, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft. 10 (2d6 + 3) Radiant damage.

actions.name: Vanishing Trick (3/Day)
actions.description: Flizzlebin has the Invisible condition for 10 minutes. This effect ends early immediately after Flizzlebin makes an attack roll, deals damage, or has the Incapacitated condition, or if his hat is removed.

reactions.name: Distracting Glitter
reactions.description: Flizzlebin is hit by an attack roll. Flizzlebin adds 2 to his AC against that attack, possibly causing it to miss.

name: Flumph
languages: understands Undercommon but can't speak; telepathy 60 ft.

traits.name: Advanced Telepathy
traits.description: The flumph perceives the content of any telepathic communication within 60 feet of it.

traits.name: Prone Deficiency
traits.description: If the flumph receives the Prone condition, roll a die. On an odd number, it has the Incapacitated condition. At the end of each of its turns, the flumph makes a DC 10 Dexterity saving throw, ending the Incapacitated condition on a success.

traits.name: Telepathic Shroud
traits.description: The flumph's thoughts can't be read by any means, and magic can't detect its location or observe it remotely.

actions.name: Tentacle
actions.description: m +4, reach 5 feet. 4 (1d4 + 2) Acid damage.

actions.name: Stench Spray (1/Day)
actions.description: dex DC 10, one creature the flumph can see within 15 feet. The target is coated in a foul-smelling liquid, exudes a stench for 1d4 hours, and has the Poisoned condition while the stench lasts. Other creatures have the Poisoned condition while in a 5-foot Emanation [Area of Effect] originating from the coated target. The target can remove the stench on itself if it bathes during a Short Rest or Long Rest.

traits.name: Fluxbending Overcast {@recharge 5}
traits.description: The blastseeker can create an additional effect immediately after casting a spell. Roll a d6 to determine the effect: 1-3. The blastseeker teleports, swapping places with a creature it can see within 30 feet of it. 4-6. The blastseeker and each creature within 10 feet of it must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or take 11 (2d10) thunder damage.

actions.name: Quarterstaff
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 3 (1d6) bludgeoning damage, or 4 (1d8) bludgeoning damage if used with two hands.
