actions.name: Flesh-Crushing Stride
actions.description: The hellfire engine moves up to its speed in a straight line. During this move, it can enter Large or smaller creatures' spaces. A creature whose space the hellfire engine enters must make a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw. On a successful save, the creature is pushed to the nearest space out of the hellfire engine's path. On a failed save, the creature falls prone and takes 28 (8d6) bludgeoning damage. If the hellfire engine remains in the prone creature's space, the creature is also restrained until it's no longer in the same space as the hellfire engine. While restrained in this way, the creature, or another creature within 5 feet of it, can make a DC 18 Strength check. On a success, the creature is shunted to an unoccupied space of its choice within 5 feet of the hellfire engine and is no longer restrained.

actions.name: Hellfire Weapons
actions.description: The hellfire engine uses one of the following options (choose one or roll a d6): 1–2: Bonemelt Sprayer. The hellfire engine spews acidic flame in a 60-foot cone. Each creature in the cone must make a DC 20 Dexterity saving throw, taking 11 (2d10) fire damage plus 18 (4d8) acid damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Creatures that fail the saving throw are drenched in burning acid and take 5 (1d10) fire damage plus 9 (2d8) acid damage at the end of their turns. An affected creature or another creature within 5 feet of it can take an action to scrape off the burning fuel. 3–4: Lightning Flail. Melee Weapon Attack +10 to hit, reach 15 ft., one creature. 18 (3d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage plus 22 (5d8) lightning damage. Up to three other creatures of the hellfire engine's choice that it can see within 30 feet of the target must each make a DC 20 Dexterity saving throw, taking 22 (5d8) lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. 5–6: Thunder Cannon. The hellfire engine targets a point within 120 feet of it that it can see. Each creature within 30 feet of that point must make a DC 20 Dexterity saving throw, taking 27 (5d10) bludgeoning damage plus 19 (3d12) thunder damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. If the chosen option kills a creature, the creature's soul rises from the River Styx as a lemure in Avernus in 1d4 hours. If the creature isn't revived before then, only a wish spell or killing the lemure and casting true resurrection on the creature's original body can restore it to life. Constructs and devils are immune to this effect.

traits.name: Magic Weapons
traits.description: The hellwasp's weapon attacks are magical.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The hellwasp makes two attacks: one with its sting and one with its sword talons.

actions.name: Sting
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. 8 (1d8 + 4) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) fire damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 1 minute. While poisoned in this way, the target is also paralyzed. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

actions.name: Sword Talons
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage.

name: Helmed Horror
languages: understands Common plus one other language but can't speak

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The helmed horror has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Spell Immunity
traits.description: The helmed horror is immune to three spells chosen by its creator. Typical choices include Heat Metal, Lightning Bolt, and Magic Missile.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The helmed horror makes two Arcane Sword attacks.

actions.name: Arcane Sword
actions.description: m +6, reach 5 ft. 8 (1d8 + 4) Slashing damage plus 5 (1d10) Force damage.

traits.name: Incorruptible Vessel
traits.description: The exorcist can't be possessed by Celestials, Fiends, or Undead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The exorcist makes two Grave Burst attacks.

actions.name: Grave Burst
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Spell Attack +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft., one target. 19 (3d10 + 3) necrotic or radiant damage (exorcist's choice).

actions.name: Admit Entity {@recharge 5}
actions.description: The exorcist thins the veil of death for a creature it can see within 60 feet of itself, exposing the target to malevolent entities. The target must make a DC 14 Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes 36 (8d8) psychic damage and has the incapacitated condition for 1 minute, during which time it retches and babbles incoherently in a voice that is not its own. On a successful save, the target takes half as much damage only. An incapacitated target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.header: The exorcist casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 14, +6 to hit with spell attacks):

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The remnant makes two Necrotic Surge attacks.

actions.name: Necrotic Surge
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Spell Attack +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft., one target. 14 (2d10 + 3) necrotic damage.

bonus_actions.name: Phase (2/Day)
bonus_actions.description: The remnant becomes partially incorporeal for as long as it maintains concentration on the effect (as if concentrating on a spell). While partially incorporeal, the remnant has resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.header: The remnant casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 13):

traits.name: Legendary Resistances (3/Day)
traits.description: If the hertilod fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The hertilod has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Shock Susceptibility
traits.description: If the hertilod takes lightning damage, its speed is halved until the end of its next turn, and it must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or immediately regurgitate all swallowed creatures, each of which lands in a space within 10 feet of the hertilod and has the prone condition.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.description: The hertilod can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The hertilod makes one Bite attack and two Claw attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +12 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 15 (2d8 + 6) piercing damage plus 13 (2d12) poison damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it must succeed on a DC 20 Strength saving throw or be swallowed by the hertilod. A swallowed creature has the blinded and restrained conditions, and it has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the hertilod. At the start of each of the hertilod's turns, each swallowed creature takes 13 (2d12) poison damage from the poisonous secretion in the hertilod's gullet. The hertilod's gullet can hold up to two creatures at a time. If the hertilod takes 40 damage or more on a single turn from a swallowed creature, the hertilod must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, each of which lands in a space within 10 feet of the hertilod and has the prone condition. If the hertilod dies, a swallowed creature is no longer restrained and can escape from the corpse by using 10 feet of movement, exiting with the prone condition.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 17 (2d10 + 6) slashing damage.

legendary_actions.name: Sprint
legendary_actions.description: The hertilod moves up to its speed. This movement doesn't provoke opportunity attacks.

legendary_actions.name: Feed (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.description: The hertilod drains life from the creatures in its gullet to bolster itself. Each creature in the hertilod's gullet takes 10 (3d6) necrotic damage, and the hertilod regains a number of hit points equal to the damage.

traits.name: Dwarven Resilience
traits.description: Hew has resistance to poison damage and advantage on saving throws against being poisoned.

traits.name: Reckless
traits.description: At the start of his turn, Hew can gain advantage on all melee weapon attack rolls during that turn, but attack rolls against him have advantage until the start of his next turn.

actions.name: Battleaxe
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 7 (1d8 + 3) slashing damage.

traits.name: Axiomatic Mind
traits.description: The hexton can't be compelled to act in a manner contrary to its nature or its instructions.

traits.name: Combat Ready
traits.description: The hexton has advantage on initiative rolls.

traits.name: Disintegration
traits.description: If the hexton dies, its body disintegrates into dust, leaving behind anything it was carrying.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (4/Day)
traits.description: If the hexton fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The hexton makes one Pincer attack and two Tentacle attacks.

actions.name: Pincer
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus 10 (3d6) force damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or have the incapacitated condition until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Tentacle
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 15 (2d10 + 4) piercing damage, and if the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the grappled condition (escape DC 14). Until this grapple ends, the hexton can't use this tentacle against other targets. The hexton has six tentacles, each of which can grapple one target.

reactions.name: Counter Magic
reactions.description: The hexton attempts to interrupt a creature it can see that is casting a spell. If the spell is 3rd level or lower, it fails and has no effect. If the spell is 4th level or higher, the hexton makes an Intelligence check (DC 10 + the spell's level). On a success, the spell fails and has no effect.

reactions.name: Lightning Rebuke
reactions.description: When a creature within 120 feet of the hexton damages it, the hexton magically retaliates with an arc of lightning. The creature must make a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw, taking 11 (2d10) lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.header: The hexton casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 17):

traits.name: Demonic Restoration
traits.description: If the hezrou dies outside the Abyss, its body dissolves into ichor, and it gains a new body instantly, reviving with all its Hit Points somewhere in the Abyss.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The hezrou has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Stench
traits.description: con DC 16, any creature that starts its turn in a 10-foot Emanation [Area of Effect] originating from the hezrou. The target has the Poisoned condition until the start of its next turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The hezrou makes three Rend attacks.

actions.name: Rend
actions.description: m +7, reach 5 ft. 6 (1d4 + 4) Slashing damage plus 9 (2d8) Poison damage.

bonus_actions.name: Leap
bonus_actions.description: The hezrou jumps up to 30 feet by spending 10 feet of movement.

name: Hierophant Medusa
languages: Common plus any three languages (Abyssal, Celestial, Druidic, or Infernal recommended)

traits.name: Devotion's Call (1/Day)
traits.description: The medusa can cast the Resurrection spell, requiring no material components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (4/Day)
traits.description: If the medusa fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The medusa makes one Constrict attack, one Final Blade attack, and one Snake Hair attack. Alternatively, it makes two Wrathful Strike attacks.

actions.name: Constrict
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +12 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 16 (3d6 + 6) bludgeoning damage, and if the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the grappled condition (escape DC 20). Until this grapple ends, the target has the restrained condition, and the medusa can't constrict another creature.

actions.name: Final Blade
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 13 (2d6 + 6) slashing damage plus 21 (6d6) force damage. If the target has at least one head and the medusa rolled a 20 on the attack roll, the target is decapitated and dies if it fails a DC 20 Constitution saving throw and can't survive without that head. A target is immune to this effect if it takes none of the damage, has legendary actions, or is Huge or larger. Such a creature takes an extra 28 (8d6) force damage from the hit.

actions.name: Snake Hair
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 11 (1d10 + 6) piercing damage plus 5 (1d10) poison damage.

actions.name: Wrathful Strike
actions.description: Ranged Spell Attack +12 to hit, range 120 ft., one creature. 22 (3d10 + 6) radiant damage, and the target has the blinded condition until the end of its next turn.

bonus_actions.name: Petrifying Gaze {@recharge 4}
bonus_actions.description: The medusa unleashes petrifying magic from its eyes in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 18 Constitution saving throw if it doesn't have the blinded condition. If the saving throw fails by 5 or more, the creature has the petrified condition. Otherwise, on a failed save, the creature takes 10 (3d6) force damage, begins to turn to stone, and has the restrained condition. The restrained creature must repeat the saving throw at the end of its next turn. On a failed save, it has the petrified condition, and on a successful save, the effect ends on it. The petrification lasts until the creature is freed by the Greater Restoration spell or other magic. A creature can use its reaction, if available, to shut its eyes to avoid the saving throw. If the creature does so, it has the blinded condition until the end of its next turn.

legendary_actions.name: Move
legendary_actions.description: The medusa moves up to its speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

legendary_actions.name: Wrathful Blast (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.description: The medusa makes one Wrathful Strike attack.

legendary_actions.name: Final Slash (Costs 3 Actions)
legendary_actions.description: The medusa makes one Final Blade attack with advantage.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.header: The medusa casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 20):

traits.name: Comet's Voice (1/Day)
traits.description: The hierophant can cast Contact Other Plane, using Charisma as the spellcasting ability.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The hierophant has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Thought Shield
traits.description: The hierophant's thoughts can't be read by any means unless the hierophant allows it.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The hierophant makes two Herald's Axe attacks or three Comet Blast attacks.

actions.name: Herald's Axe
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 11 (1d12 + 5) slashing damage plus 10 (3d6) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Comet Blast
actions.description: Ranged Spell Attack +9 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. 16 (2d10 + 5) force damage.

actions.name: All-Consuming Star {@recharge}
actions.description: The hierophant conjures a manifestation of the All-Consuming Star: brilliant light and haunting screams that fill a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on a point the hierophant can see within 60 feet of itself. Each creature within the sphere has the blinded and deafened conditions. Each creature that enters the sphere for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there must make a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 27 (6d8) psychic damage and has the incapacitated condition until the start of its next turn. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage only. The manifestation persists until the hierophant dies, has the incapacitated condition, uses a bonus action to end the effect, or uses this action again.

bonus_actions.name: Star's Hunger
bonus_actions.description: The hierophant targets one creature within 30 feet of the center of its All-Consuming Star. The target must succeed on a DC 17 Strength saving throw or be pulled up to 30 feet toward the center of the All-Consuming Star.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.header: The hierophant casts one of the following spells, using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 17):

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The high fae has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The high fae makes two Fae Blade attacks and uses Vexing Prank once.

actions.name: Fae Blade
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 18 (3d8 + 5) force damage.

actions.name: Vexing Prank
actions.description: The high fae targets one creature it can see within 60 feet of itself with a magical trick. The target must make a DC 18 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes 21 (6d6) psychic damage and has the frightened condition until the start of the high fae's next turn. On a successful save, the target takes half as much damage only.

bonus_actions.name: Loot Likeness
bonus_actions.description: The high fae magically transforms into a duplicate of a Small or Medium creature it can see. While transformed, the high fae retains its game statistics (other than its size) but gains access to enough general information about the imitated creature, such as background and personality, to reasonably pass itself off as the creature. This transformation ends if the high fae is reduced to 0 hit points, uses this bonus action again, or uses a bonus action to revert to its true form.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.header: The high fae casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 18):

traits.name: Evasion
traits.description: If the high fae is subjected to an effect that allows it to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, it instead takes no damage if it succeeds on the saving throw and only half damage if it fails, provided it doesn't have the incapacitated condition.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The high fae has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The high fae makes two Fae Claymore attacks and uses Tripping Feint.

actions.name: Fae Claymore
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 20 (4d6 + 6) force damage, and the target's speed is reduced by 10 feet, to a minimum speed of 5 feet. The reduction lasts until the start of the high fae's next turn.

actions.name: Tripping Feint
actions.description: The high fae targets one Large or smaller creature it can see within 10 feet of itself. The target must succeed on a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw or have the prone condition.

bonus_actions.name: Darting Flight
bonus_actions.description: The high fae moves up to its speed. This movement doesn't provoke opportunity attacks.

reactions.name: Parry and Riposte
reactions.description: The high fae adds 4 to its AC against one melee attack roll that would hit it, provided it can see the attacker. After the attack hits or misses, the high fae then makes one Fae Claymore attack against the attacker.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The high fae has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The high fae makes two Elemental Strike attacks.

actions.name: Elemental Strike
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Spell Attack +11 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft., one target. 18 (2d10 + 7) acid, cold, fire, force, lightning, or thunder damage (the high fae's choice).

actions.name: Negotiate Life {@recharge 5}
actions.description: The high fae enacts a magical bargain, siphoning energy from its opponents to heal its wounds. The high fae targets up to three creatures it can see within 60 feet of itself. Each target must make a DC 19 Constitution saving throw, taking 26 (4d12) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The high fae then regains 30 hit points.

reactions.name: Fae Counterspell
reactions.description: The high fae interrupts a creature it can see that is casting a spell with verbal, somatic, or material components. The caster takes 10 (3d6) psychic damage and must make a DC 19 Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, the spell fails and has no effect, but the spell slot used to cast it is not expended.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.header: The high fae casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 19):

traits.name: Aura of Overwhelming Splendor
traits.description: The high fae radiates dazzling and mollifying magic. Each creature of the high fae's choice that starts its turn within 5 feet of the high fae must succeed on a DC 19 Wisdom saving throw or have the charmed condition until the start of its next turn. While charmed, the creature also has the incapacitated condition.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.description: If the high fae fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The high fae has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The high fae makes two Fae Blade attacks. It can replace one of these attacks with Stunning Soliloquy if available.

actions.name: Fae Blade
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 20 (3d8 + 7) force damage.

actions.name: Stunning Soliloquy {@recharge 5}
actions.description: The high fae unleashes a string of magical words. Each creature of the high fae's choice within 30 feet of itself must succeed on a DC 19 Wisdom saving throw or have the stunned condition for 1 minute. A stunned creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

reactions.name: Capricious Step
reactions.description: Immediately after taking damage, the high fae magically has the invisible condition and teleports, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, to an unoccupied space it can see within 30 feet of itself. The invisibility lasts until the end of the high fae's next turn.

reactions.name: Ridicule
reactions.description: When a creature misses the high fae with an attack roll, the high fae magically mocks the creature, dealing 5 (2d4) psychic damage to the attacker.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.header: The high fae casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 19):

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The giant makes two attacks, using Tree Club or Trash Lob in any combination.

actions.name: Tree Club
actions.description: m +8, reach 10 ft. 18 (3d8 + 5) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Prone condition.

actions.name: Trash Lob
actions.description: r +8, range 60/240 ft. 16 (2d10 + 5) Bludgeoning damage, and the target has the Poisoned condition until the end of its next turn.

traits.name: Hill Rune
traits.description: The giant has a hill rune inscribed on a rock or some other object in its possession. While holding or wearing the object bearing the rune, the giant can use its Stone Avalanche action and Hill Rebuff reaction. The object bearing the rune has AC 15; 20 hit points; and immunity to necrotic, poison, and psychic damage. The object regains all its hit points at the end of every turn, but it turns to dust if reduced to 0 hit points or when the giant dies. If the rune is destroyed, the giant can inscribe a hill rune on an object in its possession when it finishes a short or long rest.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.description: If the giant fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The giant makes one Greatclub attack and uses Stone Bolas.

actions.name: Greatclub
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 18 (3d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage plus 9 (2d8) thunder damage.

actions.name: Stone Bolas
actions.description: The giant conjures three stone balls connected by lines of magical force and throws them at one creature it can see within 60 feet of itself. The target must make a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the target has the restrained condition until the start of the giant's next turn, and the stones erupt in a burst of thunderous energy that deals 14 (4d6) thunder damage to the target and each creature within 10 feet of the target. On a successful save, the stones vanish without erupting.

actions.name: Stone Avalanche (Requires Hill Rune)
actions.description: The giant conjures a hail of rocks in a 20-foot-radius, 40-foot-high cylinder centered on a point on the ground it can see within 120 feet of itself. Each creature in that area must make a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 28 (8d6) bludgeoning damage and has the prone condition. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage only. The rocks turn the ground in that area into difficult terrain until the start of the giant's next turn, when the rocks vanish.

reactions.name: Hill Rebuff (Requires Hill Rune)
reactions.description: Immediately after the giant takes damage from a creature it can see within 10 feet of itself, that creature must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or take 10 (3d6) force damage and be pushed horizontally 10 feet away from the giant.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.header: The giant casts one of the following spells, using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 16):

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The giant makes two greatclub attacks.

actions.name: Greatclub
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +8 to hit, one target. 18 (3d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Rock
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack +8 to hit, one target. 21 (3d10 + 5) bludgeoning damage.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.description: The hippocamp can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Charge
traits.description: If the hippocamp moves at least 20 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a ram attack on the same turn, the target takes an extra 7 (2d6) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 12 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

actions.name: Hooves
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 9 (2d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Ram
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 5 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage.

traits.name: Flyby
traits.description: The hippogriff doesn't provoke an Opportunity Attack when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The hippogriff makes two Rend attacks.

actions.name: Rend
actions.description: m +5, reach 5 ft. 7 (1d8 + 3) Slashing damage.

traits.name: Hold Breath
traits.description: The hippopotamus can hold its breath for 10 minutes.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The hippopotamus makes two Bite attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: m +7, reach 5 ft. 16 (2d10 + 5) Piercing damage.

traits.name: Evasion
traits.description: If Hlam is subjected to an effect that allows him to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, he instead takes no damage if he succeeds on the saving throw, and only half damage if he fails. He can't use this trait if he's incapacitated.

traits.name: Magic Attacks
traits.description: Hlam's unarmed strikes are magical.

traits.name: Unarmored Defense
traits.description: While Hlam is wearing no armor and wielding no shield, his AC includes his Wisdom modifier.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Hlam attacks three times using his unarmed strike, darts, or both.

actions.name: Unarmed Strike
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 12 (1d10 + 7) bludgeoning, magic damage. If the target is a creature, Hlam can choose one of the following additional effects: The target must succeed on a DC 18 Strength saving throw or drop one item it is holding (Hlam's choice). The target must succeed on a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw or be knocked prone. The target must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution saving throw or be stunned until the end of Hlam's next turn.

actions.name: Dart
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack +12 to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. 9 (1d4 + 7) piercing damage.

actions.name: Quivering Palm {@recharge}
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. The target must make a DC 18 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the target is reduced to 0 hit points. On a successful save, the target takes 55 (10d10) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Wholeness of Body (Recharges after a Long Rest)
actions.description: Hlam regains 60 hit points.

reactions.name: Deflect Missile
reactions.description: In response to being hit by a ranged weapon attack, Hlam deflects the missile. The damage he takes from the attack is reduced by 1d10 + 27. If the damage is reduced to 0, Hlam catches the missile if it's small enough to hold in one hand and he has a hand free.

reactions.name: Slow Fall
reactions.description: Hlam reduces the bludgeoning damage he takes from a fall by 100.

legendary_actions.name: Quick Step
legendary_actions.description: Hlam moves up to his speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

legendary_actions.name: Unarmed Strike (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.description: Hlam makes one unarmed strike.

legendary_actions.name: Invisibility (Costs 3 Actions)
legendary_actions.description: Hlam becomes invisible until the end of his next turn. The effect ends if Hlam attacks or casts a spell.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.header: Hlam is a 5th-level spellcaster. His spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 18, +10 to hit with spell attacks) He has the following cleric spells prepared:

traits.name: False Appearance (Hoard Form Only)
traits.description: If the mimic is motionless at the start of combat, it has advantage on its initiative roll. Moreover, if a creature hasn't observed the mimic move or act, that creature must succeed on a DC 18 Intelligence (Investigation) check to discern that the mimic is animate.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The mimic makes one Bite attack and two Pseudopod attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. 16 (2d10 + 5) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) acid damage.

actions.name: Pseudopod
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 12 (2d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage, and the mimic adheres to the target. A creature adhered to the mimic is also grappled by it (escape DC 16). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained. Ability checks made to escape this grapple have disadvantage.

actions.name: Caustic Mist {@recharge 5}
actions.description: The mimic sprays a fine mist of acid in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 27 (6d8) acid damage and is blinded until the end of its next turn. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage and isn't blinded.

actions.name: Shapechanger
actions.description: The mimic transforms into a hoard or back into its true, amorphous form. Its statistics are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.description: If the scarab is motionless at the start of combat, it has advantage on its initiative roll. Moreover, if a creature hasn't observed the scarab move or act, that creature must succeed on a DC 18 Intelligence (Investigation) check to discern that the scarab is animate.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it has disadvantage on attack rolls until the start of its next turn.

bonus_actions.name: Scale Dust (1/Day)
bonus_actions.description: The scarab releases magical glittering dust from its wings. Each creature within 5 feet of the scarab must succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw or be outlined in blue light for 10 minutes. While outlined in this way, a creature sheds dim light in a 10-foot radius and can't benefit from being invisible. In addition, every Dragon within 1 mile of the creature becomes aware of it and can unerringly track the creature. Casting dispel magic on the creature ends the effect on it.

traits.name: Martial Advantage
traits.description: Once per turn, the hobgoblin can deal an extra 7 (2d6) damage to a creature it hits with a weapon attack if that creature is within 5 feet of an ally of the hobgoblin that isn't incapacitated.

actions.name: Longsword
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 5 (1d8 + 1) slashing damage, or 6 (1d10 + 1) slashing damage if used with two hands.

actions.name: Longbow
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack +3 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. 5 (1d8 + 1) piercing damage.

traits.name: Aura of Authority
traits.description: While in a 10-foot Emanation [Area of Effect] originating from the hobgoblin, the hobgoblin and its allies have Advantage on attack rolls and saving throws, provided the hobgoblin doesn't have the Incapacitated condition.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The hobgoblin makes two attacks, using Greatsword or Longbow in any combination.

actions.name: Greatsword
actions.description: m +4, reach 5 ft. 9 (2d6 + 2) Slashing damage plus 3 (1d6) Poison damage.

actions.name: Longbow
actions.description: r +4, range 150/600 ft. 6 (1d8 + 2) Piercing damage plus 5 (2d4) Poison damage.

traits.name: Army Arcana
traits.description: When the hobgoblin casts a spell that causes damage or that forces other creatures to make a saving throw, it can choose itself and any number of allies to be immune to the damage caused by the spell and to succeed on the required saving throw.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The hobgoblin makes two Quarterstaff or Devastating Bolt attacks.

actions.name: Quarterstaff
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 4 (1d6 + 1) bludgeoning damage, or 5 (1d8 + 1) bludgeoning damage if used with two hands, plus 13 (3d8) force damage.

actions.name: Devastating Bolt
actions.description: Ranged Spell Attack +5 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. 21 (4d8 + 3) force damage, and the target is knocked prone.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.header: The hobgoblin casts one of the following spells, using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 13):

traits.name: Unarmored Defense
traits.description: While the hobgoblin is wearing no armor and wielding no shield, its AC includes its Wisdom modifier.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The hobgoblin makes four attacks, each of which can be an Unarmed Strike or a Dart attack. It can also use Shadow Jaunt once, either before or after one of the attacks.

actions.name: Unarmed Strike
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 5 (1d4 + 3) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Dart
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack +5 to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Shadow Jaunt
actions.description: The hobgoblin teleports, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space it can see. Both the space it leaves and its destination must be in dim light or darkness.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.header: The hobgoblin casts one of the following spells, using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 12):

traits.name: Aura of Authority
traits.description: While in a 30-foot Emanation [Area of Effect] originating from the hobgoblin, the hobgoblin and its allies have Advantage on attack rolls and saving throws, provided the hobgoblin doesn't have the Incapacitated condition.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The hobgoblin makes three attacks, using Javelin or Longsword in any combination.

actions.name: Javelin
actions.description: m,r +6, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft. 11 (2d6 + 4) Piercing damage, and the target's Speed decreases by 10 feet until the start of the hobgoblin's next turn.

actions.name: Longsword
actions.description: m +6, reach 5 ft. 12 (2d8 + 3) Slashing damage.

reactions.name: Parry
reactions.description: The hobgoblin is hit by a melee attack roll while holding a weapon. The hobgoblin adds 3 to its AC against that attack, possibly causing it to miss.

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.description: The hobgoblin has Advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the hobgoblin's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally doesn't have the Incapacitated condition.

actions.name: Longsword
actions.description: m +3, reach 5 ft. 12 (2d10 + 1) Slashing damage.

actions.name: Longbow
actions.description: r +3, range 150/600 ft. 5 (1d8 + 1) Piercing damage plus 7 (3d4) Poison damage.

traits.name: Reckless
traits.description: At the start of her turn, Holga can gain advantage on melee weapon attack rolls during that turn, but attack rolls against her have advantage until the start of her next turn.

traits.name: Special Equipment
traits.description: Holga carries a darksteel greataxe, a magic weapon that grants her resistance to lightning damage while she carries it (included above).

traits.name: Unarmored Defense
traits.description: While Holga isn't wearing armor, her AC includes her Constitution modifier.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Holga makes three Darksteel Greataxe or Improvised Weapon attacks, in any combination.

actions.name: Darksteel Greataxe
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 10 (1d12 + 4) slashing damage.

actions.name: Improvised Weapon
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., or range 20/60 ft., one target. 7 (1d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

bonus_actions.name: Wrestle
bonus_actions.description: Holga shoves a creature within 5 feet of herself. That creature must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or be moved 5 feet into an unoccupied space of Holga's choice.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.description: If the hollow dragon fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Reconstruction
traits.description: When the hollow dragon is reduced to 0 hit points, its body breaks into nine pieces: two arms, two legs, two wings, a tail, a torso, and a head. Each piece is a Large object with AC 19, 27 hit points, and immunity to psychic and poison damage. After 1d6 days, if all pieces are still within 6 miles of each other, they all teleport to the location of the head piece and merge with it, whereupon the hollow dragon regains all its hit points and becomes active again.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The hollow dragon makes one Bite attack and two Claw attacks, and it can use Sapping Presence.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +12 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 17 (2d10 + 6) piercing damage plus 9 (2d8) radiant damage.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 13 (2d6 + 6) slashing damage.

actions.name: Sapping Presence
actions.description: Each creature of the hollow dragon's choice within 60 feet of it must make a DC 19 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the creature's speed is halved and it has disadvantage on attack rolls until the end of its next turn. On a successful save, the creature is immune to this hollow dragon's Sapping Presence for 24 hours.

actions.name: Radiant Breath {@recharge 5}
actions.description: The hollow dragon exhales radiant flames in a 60-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 19 Dexterity saving throw, taking 54 (12d8) radiant damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

legendary_actions.name: Claw
legendary_actions.description: The hollow dragon makes one Claw attack.

legendary_actions.name: Ghostly Binding (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.description: The hollow dragon creates ethereal bindings around a creature it can see within 60 feet of it. The target must succeed on a DC 19 Strength saving throw or be restrained until the end of the dragon's next turn.

legendary_actions.name: Booming Scales (Costs 3 Actions)
legendary_actions.description: A sudden loud ringing noise, painfully intense, erupts from the hollow dragon's frame. Each creature within 10 feet of the hollow dragon must make a DC 19 Constitution saving throw, taking 24 (7d6) thunder damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

traits.name: Aura of Invulnerability
traits.description: An invisible aura forms a 10-foot-radius sphere around the hollyphant for as long as it lives. Any spell of 5th level or lower cast from outside the barrier can't affect creatures or objects within it, even if the spell is cast using a higher level spell slot. Such a spell can target creatures and objects within the barrier, but the spell has no effect on them. Similarly, the area within the barrier is excluded from the areas affected by such spells. The hollyphant can use an action to suppress this trait until its concentration ends (as if concentrating on a spell).

traits.name: Magic Weapons
traits.description: The hollyphant's weapon attacks are magical.

actions.name: Tusks
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 3 (1d6) piercing damage.

actions.name: Trumpet (3/Day)
actions.description: The hollyphant blows air through its trunk, creating a trumpet sound that can be heard out to a range of 600 feet. The trumpet also creates a 30-foot cone of energy that has one of the following effects, chosen by the hollyphant:

actions.name: Trumpet of Blasting
actions.description: Each creature in the cone must make a DC 14 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 17 (5d6) thunder damage and is deafened for 1 minute. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and isn't deafened. Nonmagical objects in the cone that aren't being held or worn take 35 (10d6) thunder damage.

actions.name: Trumpet of Sparkles
actions.description: Creatures in the cone must make a DC 14 Constitution saving throw, taking 22 (4d8 + 4) radiant damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Evil creatures have disadvantage on the saving throw. Good creatures in the cone take no damage.

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
spellcasting.header: The hollyphant's innate spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 15). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

daily_1: shapechange (into a golden-furred mammoth with feathered wings and a flying speed of 120 ft.)

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.description: The homarid can breathe air and water.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The homarid makes two claw attacks.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 5 (1d8 + 1) slashing damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 11). The homarid has two claws, each of which can grapple only one target.

name: Homunculus
languages: understands Common plus one other language but can't speak

traits.name: Telepathic Bond
traits.description: While the homunculus is on the same plane of existence as its master, the two of them can communicate telepathically with each other.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: m +4, reach 5 ft. 1 Piercing damage, and the target is subjected to the following effect. con DC 12. The target has the Poisoned condition until the end of the homunculus's next turn. 5 The target has the Poisoned condition for 1 minute. While Poisoned, the target has the Unconscious condition, which ends early if the target takes any damage.

traits.name: Evasion
traits.description: If the homunculus is subjected to an effect that allows it to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, it instead takes no damage if it succeeds on the saving throw, and only half damage if it fails. It can't use this trait if it's incapacitated.

actions.name: Force Strike
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack to hit, range 30 ft., one target you can see. 1d4 + PB force damage.

reactions.name: Channel Magic
reactions.description: The homunculus delivers a spell you cast that has a range of touch. The homunculus must be within 120 feet of you.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The hook horror makes two Hook attacks.

actions.name: Hook
actions.description: m +6, reach 10 ft. 11 (2d6 + 4) Piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, the hook horror moves the target 5 feet straight toward or away from itself.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The spore servant makes two hook attacks.

actions.name: Hook
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.description: The tortoise can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Massive Frame
traits.description: The tortoise can carry up to 20,000 pounds of weight atop its shell, but moves at half speed if the weight exceeds 10,000 pounds. Medium or smaller creatures can move underneath the tortoise while it's not prone. Any creature under the tortoise when it falls prone is grappled (escape DC 18). Until the grapple ends, the creature is prone and restrained.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +12 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 28 (3d12 + 9) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Shell Defense {@recharge 4}
actions.description: The tortoise withdraws into its shell, falls prone, and gains a +5 bonus to AC. While the tortoise is in its shell, its speed is 0 and can't increase. The tortoise can emerge from its shell as an action, whereupon it is no longer prone.

traits.name: Speak with Beasts
traits.description: The horncaller can communicate with beasts as if they shared a language.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The horncaller makes two melee attacks with its staff and uses One with the Worldsoul.

actions.name: Staff
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 4 (1d6 + 1) piercing damage, or 5 (1d8 + 1) bludgeoning damage if used with two hands.

actions.name: One with the Worldsoul
actions.description: The horncaller chooses one beast it can see within 30 feet of it. If the beast can hear the horncaller, the beast uses its reaction to make one melee attack against a target that the horncaller can see.

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
spellcasting.header: The horncaller's innate spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 14). The horncaller can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

traits.name: Diabolical Restoration
traits.description: If the devil dies outside the Nine Hells, its body disappears in sulfurous smoke, and it gains a new body instantly, reviving with all its Hit Points somewhere in the Nine Hells.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The devil has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The devil makes three attacks, using Searing Fork or Hurl Flame in any combination. It can replace one attack with a use of Infernal Tail.

actions.name: Searing Fork
actions.description: m +10, reach 10 ft. 15 (2d8 + 6) Piercing damage plus 9 (2d8) Fire damage.

actions.name: Hurl Flame
actions.description: r +8, range 150 ft. 26 (5d8 + 4) Fire damage. If the target is a flammable object that isn't being worn or carried, it starts burning.

actions.name: Infernal Tail
actions.description: dex DC 17, one creature the devil can see within 10 feet. 10 (1d8 + 6) Necrotic damage, and the target receives an infernal wound if it doesn't have one. While wounded, the target loses 10 (3d6) Hit Points at the start of each of its turns. The wound closes after 1 minute, after a spell restores Hit Points to the target, or after the target or a creature within 5 feet of it takes an action to stanch the wound, doing so by succeeding on a DC 17 Wisdom (Medicine) check.

traits.name: Horrid Plant Varieties
traits.description: A horrid plant comes in one of three varieties (choose or roll a d6): 1-2, dew drinker; 3-4, purple blossom; or 5-6, snapper saw. This form determines certain traits in this stat block.

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.description: If the horrid plant is motionless at the start of combat, it has advantage on its initiative roll. Moreover, if a creature hasn't observed the horrid plant move or act, that creature must succeed on a DC 18 Intelligence (Nature) check to discern that the horrid plant isn't an ordinary plant.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The horrid plant makes two Tendril attacks.

actions.name: Tendril
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +6 to hit, reach 30 ft., one target. 7 (2d6) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Huge or smaller creature, it has the grappled condition (escape DC 14), and the horrid plant can pull the target up to 25 feet closer to itself. Until the grapple ends, the target has the restrained condition, and the horrid plant can't use the same tendril on another target. The horrid plant has two tendrils.

bonus_actions.name: Sap Squirt (Purple Blossom Only)
bonus_actions.description: The horrid plant targets one creature it can see within 15 feet of itself. The target must succeed on a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw or take 28 (8d6) acid damage and become covered in acidic sap. This sap lasts for 1 minute or until a creature uses its action to scrape the sap off itself or another creature it can reach. A creature covered in sap takes 14 (4d6) acid damage at the start of each of its turns.

bonus_actions.name: Spiked Leaves (Snapper Saw Only)
bonus_actions.description: Creatures within 10 feet of the horrid plant and not behind total cover must make a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw, taking 21 (6d6) slashing damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

bonus_actions.name: Vampiric Tendril (Dew Drinker Only)
bonus_actions.description: One creature grappled by the horrid plant must make a DC 13 Constitution saving throw, taking 10 (3d6) necrotic damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. The target's hit point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the damage taken, and the horrid plant regains hit points equal to that amount. This reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest. The target dies if this effect reduces its hit point maximum to 0.

traits.name: Aura of Menace
traits.description: As long as the archon doesn't have the incapacitated condition, each creature of the archon's choice that starts its turn within 20 feet of the archon must make a DC 12 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the creature has the frightened condition until the start of its next turn. On a successful save, the creature is immune to all archons' Aura of Menace for 24 hours.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The archon makes two Bite attacks. It can replace one of the attacks with a Shining Blade attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it must succeed on a DC 14 Strength saving throw or have the prone condition.

actions.name: Shining Blade (True Form Only)
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 11 (2d6 + 4) radiant damage.

actions.name: Teleport
actions.description: The archon teleports, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, to an unoccupied space it can see within 120 feet of itself.

bonus_actions.name: Change Shape
bonus_actions.description: The archon magically transforms into any Medium or Large dog or wolf while retaining its game statistics (other than its size and losing its Shining Blade attack). The archon reverts to its true form if reduced to 0 hit points or if it uses a bonus action to do so.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.header: The archon casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability:

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.description: A howler has advantage on attack rolls against a creature if at least one of the howler's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The howler makes two Rending Bite attacks.

actions.name: Rending Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 10 (2d6 + 3) piercing damage, plus 22 (4d10) psychic damage if the target is frightened. This attack ignores damage resistance.

actions.name: Mind-Breaking Howl {@recharge 4}
actions.description: The howler emits a keening howl in a 60-foot cone. Each creature in that area must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or take 16 (3d10) psychic damage and be frightened until the end of the howler's next turn. While a creature is frightened in this way, its speed is halved, and it is incapacitated. A target that successfully saves is immune to the Mind-Breaking Howl of all howlers for the next 24 hours.

traits.name: Guiding Wind (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
traits.description: As a bonus action, the initiate gains advantage on the next ranged attack roll it makes before the end of its next turn.

traits.name: Hold Breath
traits.description: The initiate can hold its breath for 30 minutes.

actions.name: Dagger
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.

traits.name: Hold Breath
traits.description: The priest can hold its breath for 30 minutes.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The priest makes two melee attacks or two ranged attacks.

actions.name: Scimitar
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 6 (1d6 + 3) slashing damage.

actions.name: Dagger
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.header: The priest is a 5th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 12, +4 to hit with spell attacks). It knows the following sorcerer spells:

traits.name: Indomitable (2/Day)
traits.description: Hrabbaz can reroll a saving throw that he fails. He must use the new roll.

traits.name: Relentless Endurance (Recharges after a Long Rest)
traits.description: When Hrabbaz is reduced to 0 hit points but not killed outright, he drops to 1 hit point instead.

traits.name: Extra Damage
traits.description: As long as Hrabbaz has more than half his hit points left he deals an extra 3 (1d6) damage on all hits.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Hrabbaz makes three attacks with his morningstar.

actions.name: Morningstar
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 9 (1d8 + 5) piercing damage.

traits.name: Bonus Proficiencies
traits.description: Hrigg is proficient with simple and martial weapons and light and medium armor.

traits.name: Dwarven Resilience
traits.description: Hrigg has advantage on saving throws made to avoid or end the poisoned condition on himself.

actions.name: Maul
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 9 (2d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.header: Hrigg's spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 12, +4 to hit with spell attacks). He has the following cleric spells prepared:

traits.name: Banded Claw
traits.description: On one of its claws, the crab wears a rune-covered copper band that makes it immune to being charmed, frightened, and paralyzed. The copper band is worthless as a treasure, as the magic is keyed to this crab.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.description: The crab can breathe air and water.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 27 (4d10 + 5) bludgeoning damage, and the target is grappled, escape DC 14. The crab has two claws, each of which can grapple only one target.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: As an action, it can make two attacks with its pseudopods.

actions.name: Pseudopod
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 21 (6d6) acid damage, or 42 (12d6) acid damage while the ooze is enlarged. If the target is wearing nonmagical metal armor, its armor is partly corroded and takes a permanent and cumulative −1 penalty to the AC it offers. The armor is destroyed if the penalty reduces its AC to 10.

actions.name: Enlarge (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
actions.description: For 1 minute, the ooze magically increases in size. While enlarged, the ooze is Gargantuan, doubles its damage dice with its pseudopod attack, and makes Strength checks and Strength saving throws with advantage.

actions.name: Invisibility (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
actions.description: The ooze magically turns invisible for up to 1 hour until it attacks, it uses its Enlarge, or its concentration is broken (as if concentrating on a spell).

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.description: If Hulgaz fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: Hulgaz has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Hulgaz makes two Claw attacks and one Intoxicating Sting attack.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 12 (2d8 + 3) slashing damage.

actions.name: Intoxicating Sting
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. 8 (1d10 + 3) piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) poison damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw or have the charmed condition until the start of Hulgaz's next turn.

actions.name: Brimstone Vapor {@recharge 5}
actions.description: Hulgaz exhales a 30-foot cone of noxious, scorching-hot vapor. Each creature in that area must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or have the poisoned condition for 1 minute. While poisoned in this way, a creature takes 31 (7d8) fire damage at the start of each of its turns and has disadvantage on Wisdom saving throws. A target can repeat the Constitution saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

legendary_actions.name: Attack
legendary_actions.description: Hulgaz makes one Claw attack.

legendary_actions.name: Charm
legendary_actions.description: Hulgaz uses Spellcasting to cast Charm Person.

legendary_actions.name: Curdle Heart (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.description: Hulgaz sours the good feelings of her charmed victims. She chooses any number of creatures she can see who are charmed by her. Each target takes 17 (5d6) psychic damage as the charmed condition applied by Hulgaz ends on it.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting

The restrained creature must repeat the saving throw at the end of its next turn, becoming petrified on a failure or ending the effect on a success. The petrification lasts until the creature is freed by the greater restoration spell or other magic. Unless surprised, a creature can avert its eyes to avoid the saving throw at the start of its turn. traits.name: Displacement (Recharges after the Illusionist Casts an Illusion Spell of 1st Level or Higher)
traits.description: As a bonus action, the illusionist projects an illusion that makes the illusionist appear to be standing in a place a few inches from its actual location, causing any creature to have disadvantage on attack rolls against the illusionist. The effect ends if the illusionist takes damage, it is incapacitated, or its speed becomes 0.

actions.name: Quarterstaff

Nonmagical weapons that hit Imix are destroyed by fire immediately after dealing damage to him

A target on fire takes 10 (3d6) fire damage when it starts its turn, and remains on fire until it or another creature takes an action to douse the flames. On a successful save, the target takes half as much damage and doesn't catch fire.

A creature protected by a mind blank spell, a nondetection spell, or similar magic can't be perceived in this manner.

The target can use an action on its turn to attempt to break the link, doing so with a successful DC 17 Charisma check. If the target breaks the link this way, the target takes 10 (3d6) psychic damage. The link also ends if the target and the elder brain are more than 1 mile apart.
