traits.name: Aura of Murder
traits.description: As long as the night blade is not incapacitated, hostile creatures within 5 feet of it gain vulnerability to piercing damage unless they have resistance or immunity to such damage.

actions.name: Dagger
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The hag has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Soul Bag
traits.description: The hag has a soul bag. While holding or carrying the bag, the hag can use its Nightmare Haunting action. The bag has AC 15, HP 20, and Resistance to all damage. The bag turns to dust if reduced to 0 Hit Points. If the bag is destroyed, any souls the bag is holding are released. The hag can create a new bag after 7 days.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The hag makes two Claw attacks.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: m +7, reach 5 ft. 13 (2d8 + 4) Slashing damage.

bonus_actions.name: Shape-Shift
bonus_actions.description: The hag shape-shifts into a Small or Medium Humanoid, or it returns to its true form. Other than its size, its game statistics are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed.

spellcasting.name: Coven Magic
spellcasting.header: While within 30 feet of at least two hag allies, the hag can cast one of the following spells, requiring no Material components, using the spell's normal casting time, and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 14): Augury, Find Familiar, Identify, Locate Object, Scrying, or Unseen Servant. The hag must finish a Long Rest before using this trait to cast that spell again.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.header: The hag casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 14):

spellcasting.name: Nightmare Haunting (1/Day; Requires Soul Bag)
spellcasting.header: While on the Ethereal Plane, the hag casts Dream, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting. Only the hag can serve as the spell's messenger, and the target must be a creature the hag can see on the Material Plane. The spell fails and is wasted if the target is under the effect of the Protection from Evil and Good spell or within a Magic Circle spell. If the target takes damage from the Dream spell, the target's Hit Point maximum decreases by an amount equal to that damage. If the spell kills the target, its soul is trapped in the hag's soul bag, and the target can't be raised from the dead until its soul is released.

traits.name: Unusual Nature
traits.description: The scavver doesn't require air.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +8 to hit (with advantage if the target is a creature that is missing any hit points), reach 10 ft., one target. 27 (4d10 + 5) piercing damage.

traits.name: Confer Fire Resistance
traits.description: The nightmare can grant Resistance to Fire damage to a rider while it is on the nightmare.

traits.name: Illumination
traits.description: The nightmare sheds Bright Light in a 10-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 10 feet.

actions.name: Hooves
actions.description: m +6, reach 5 ft. 13 (2d8 + 4) Bludgeoning damage plus 10 (3d6) Fire damage.

actions.name: Ethereal Stride
actions.description: The nightmare and up to three willing creatures within 5 feet of it teleport to the Ethereal Plane from the Material Plane or vice versa.

name: Nightmare Beast
languages: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (2/Day)
traits.description: If the beast fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Siege Monster
traits.description: The beast deals double damage to objects and structures.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The beast makes two Claw attacks and one Tusk attack.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +13 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. 14 (1d12 + 8) slashing damage, and if the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 21 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

actions.name: Tusk
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +13 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. 17 (2d8 + 8) slashing damage.

actions.name: Disintegration Gaze {@recharge 5}
actions.description: The beast targets one creature it can see within 60 feet of itself. The target must make a DC 18 Constitution saving throw, taking 70 (10d6 + 40) force damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. If this magical effect reduces the target to 0 hit points, the target is disintegrated and leaves nothing behind, except a pile of ashes plus whatever equipment it was wearing or carrying.

bonus_actions.name: Teleport (2/Day)
bonus_actions.description: The beast magically teleports, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

legendary_actions.name: Tusk Attack
legendary_actions.description: The beast makes one Tusk attack.

legendary_actions.name: Charge (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.description: The beast moves up to its speed without provoking opportunity attacks, then makes two Tusk attacks.

legendary_actions.name: Frightful Howl (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.description: The beast howls as it exhales a cloud of magical fear gas in a 120-foot cone. Any creature in that area must succeed on a DC 18 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened of the beast for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The nightmare haunt has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Somnophage
traits.description: At the start of its turn, the nightmare haunt gains a number of temporary hit points equal to 5 times the number of unconscious creatures within 30 feet of itself.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The nightmare haunt makes two Claw attacks.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 6 (1d6 + 3) slashing damage plus 9 (2d8) psychic damage.

actions.name: Tendrils of Slumber {@recharge 5}
actions.description: The nightmare haunt creates spectral tendrils that cover the ground in a 20-foot square that it can see within 30 feet of itself for 1 minute or until it uses this action again. When a creature other than the nightmare haunt enters the affected area for the first time or starts its turn there, the creature must succeed on a DC 14 Strength saving throw or take 11 (2d10) necrotic damage and have the restrained condition. The affected ground is also considered difficult terrain for creatures other than the nightmare haunt for the duration of its effect. A creature that starts its turn in the area and is already restrained by the tendrils must repeat the saving throw. On a failed save, it has the unconscious condition and instead of the restrained condition caused by the tendrils. On a successful save, the effect ends on the creature. An unconscious creature remains asleep until it is no longer in the area with tendrils, takes any damage, or is targeted by a remove curse spell or similar magic.

bonus_actions.name: Shadow Stealth
bonus_actions.description: While in dim light or darkness, the nightmare haunt takes the Hide action.

traits.name: Aura of Nightmares
traits.description: Undead creatures within 30 feet of the shepherd gain a +5 bonus to attack and damage rolls. When any other creature that isn't undead or a construct starts its turn within 30 feet of the shepherd, that creature must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw or take 11 (2d10) psychic damage.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The shepherd has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The shepherd makes two attacks: one with its claws and one with its staff.

actions.name: Claws
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 13 (2d8 + 4) slashing damage plus 16 (3d10) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Staff
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage, or 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage if used with two hands, plus 26 (4d12) psychic damage.

actions.name: Herd the Underworld (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
actions.description: The shepherd pulls twisted souls from the Underworld; 1d6 shadows (without Sunlight Weakness) arise in unoccupied spaces within 20 feet of the shepherd. The shadows act right after the shepherd on the same initiative count and fight until they're destroyed. They disappear when the shepherd dies.

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
spellcasting.header: The shepherd's spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 17). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

traits.name: Mount
traits.description: If the specter isn't mounted, it can use a bonus action to magically teleport onto its gloamwing mount, provided the specter and the gloamwing are on the same plane of existence. When it teleports, the specter appears astride the gloamwing along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying. While mounted and not incapacitated, the specter can't be surprised, and both it and its mount gain advantage on Dexterity saving throws.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The specter makes two scythe attacks.

actions.name: Scythe
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage plus 13 (3d8) psychic damage.

actions.name: Mind Twist {@recharge 5}
actions.description: The specter magically emits psychic energy in a 60-foot cone. Each creature in that area must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or take 22 (5d8) psychic damage and be stunned for 1 minute. The stunned creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

actions.name: Reap Memory (3/Day)
actions.description: The specter touches one incapacitated creature and chooses 1 hour from among the past 24. Unless the creature succeeds on a DC 15 Intelligence saving throw, the creature loses all memory of that hour. The creature regains the memory only if the specter dies within the next 24 hours.

traits.name: Annihilating Aura
traits.description: Any creature that starts its turn within 30 feet of the nightwalker must succeed on a DC 21 Constitution saving throw or take 21 (6d6) necrotic damage. Undead are immune to this aura.

traits.name: Life Eater
traits.description: A creature dies if reduced to 0 hit points by the nightwalker and can't be revived except by a wish spell.

traits.name: Unusual Nature
traits.description: The nightwalker doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The nightwalker makes two Enervating Focus attacks, one of which can be replaced by Finger of Doom, if available.

actions.name: Enervating Focus
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +12 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. 28 (5d8 + 6) necrotic damage. The target must succeed on a DC 21 Constitution saving throw or its hit point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the necrotic damage taken. This reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest. The target dies if its hit point maximum is reduced to 0.

actions.name: Finger of Doom {@recharge}
actions.description: The nightwalker points at one creature it can see within 300 feet of it. The target must succeed on a DC 21 Wisdom saving throw or take 39 (6d12) necrotic damage and become frightened until the end of the nightwalker's next turn. While frightened in this way, the creature is also paralyzed. If a target's saving throw is successful, the target is immune to the nightwalker's Finger of Doom for the next 24 hours.

traits.name: Nilbogism
traits.description: Any creature that attempts to damage the nilbog must first succeed on a DC 12 Charisma saving throw or be charmed until the end of the creature's next turn. A creature charmed in this way must use its action praising the nilbog. The nilbog can't regain hit points, including through magical healing, except through its Reversal of Fortune reaction.

actions.name: Fool's Scepter
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 5 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Mocking Word
actions.description: The nilbog targets one creature it can see within 60 feet of it. The target must succeed on a DC 12 Wisdom saving throw or take 5 (2d4) psychic damage and have disadvantage on its next attack roll before the end of its next turn.

bonus_actions.name: Nimble Escape
bonus_actions.description: The nilbog takes the Disengage or Hide action.

reactions.name: Reversal of Fortune
reactions.description: In response to another creature dealing damage to the nilbog, the nilbog reduces the damage to 0 and regains 3 (1d6) hit points.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.header: The nilbog casts one of the following spells, using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 12):

name: Nimblewright
languages: understands one language known to its creator but can't speak

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The nimblewright has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Magic Weapons
traits.description: The nimblewright's weapon attacks are magical.

traits.name: Repairable
traits.description: As long as it has at least 1 hit point remaining, the nimblewright regains 1 hit point when a mending spell is cast on it.

traits.name: Sure-Footed
traits.description: The nimblewright has advantage on Strength and Dexterity saving throws made against effects that would knock it prone.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The nimblewright makes three attacks: two with its rapier and one with its dagger.

actions.name: Rapier
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 8 (1d8 + 4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Dagger
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 6 (1d4 + 4) piercing damage. Or Ranged Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. 6 (1d4 + 4) piercing damage.

reactions.name: Parry
reactions.description: The nimblewright adds 2 to its AC against one melee attack that would hit it. To do so, the nimblewright must see the attacker and be wielding a melee weapon.

name: Nimblewright Guard
languages: understands Common plus one other language but can't speak

traits.name: Evasion
traits.description: If the nimblewright is subjected to an effect that allows it to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, it instead takes no damage if it succeeds on the save and only half damage if it fails, provided it doesn't have the Incapacitated condition.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The nimblewright makes three attacks, using Scimitar or Clockwork Crossbow in any combination.

actions.name: Scimitar
actions.description: m +6, reach 5 ft. 7 (1d6 + 4) Slashing damage.

actions.name: Clockwork Crossbow
actions.description: r +6, range 80/320 ft. 8 (1d8 + 4) Piercing damage.

reactions.name: Parry
reactions.description: The nimblewright is hit by a melee attack roll while holding a weapon. The nimblewright adds 2 to its AC against that attack, potentially causing it to miss.

name: Nimblewright Hulk
languages: understands Common plus one other language but can't speak

traits.name: Evasion
traits.description: If the nimblewright is subjected to an effect that allows it to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, it instead takes no damage if it succeeds on the save and only half damage if it fails, provided it doesn't have the Incapacitated condition.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The nimblewright has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The nimblewright makes four attacks, using Halting Slam or Radiant Ray in any combination.

actions.name: Halting Slam
actions.description: m +7, reach 10 ft. 15 (2d10 + 4) Bludgeoning damage, and the target's Speed is reduced to 0 until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Radiant Ray
actions.description: r +7, range 60 ft. 14 (4d6) Radiant damage.

name: Nimblewright Steed
languages: understands Common plus one other language but can't speak

traits.name: Evasion
traits.description: If the nimblewright is subjected to an effect that allows it to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, it instead takes no damage if it succeeds on the save and only half damage if it fails, provided it doesn't have the Incapacitated condition.

actions.name: Hooves
actions.description: m +6, reach 5 ft. 7 (1d8 + 3) Bludgeoning damage. If the nimblewright moved at least 20 feet straight toward the target immediately before the hit, the target takes an extra 4 (1d8) Bludgeoning damage and, if it is Huge or smaller, has the Prone condition.

bonus_actions.name: Nimble Movement
bonus_actions.description: The nimblewright takes the Disengage action.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.header: The giant casts one of the following spells, requiring no material spell components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 17):

traits.name: Cunning Action
traits.description: On each of her turns in combat, Nine-Fingers can use a bonus action to take the Dash, Disengage, or Hide action.

traits.name: Dagger Thrower
traits.description: Nine-Fingers adds double her proficiency bonus to the damage she deals on ranged attacks made with daggers (already factored into her attacks).

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Nine-Fingers attacks three times with her daggers.

actions.name: Dagger
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. 6 (1d4 + 4) piercing damage, plus 6 piercing damage if it's a ranged attack.

reactions.name: Uncanny Dodge
reactions.description: Nine-Fingers halves the damage that she takes from an attack that hits her. She must be able to see the attacker.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.description: If Nintra fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Nintra makes two attacks.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 12 (2d4 + 7) piercing damage.

actions.name: Shard of Shadow
actions.description: Ranged Spell Attack +12 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. 10 (1d6 + 7) necrotic damage, and if the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 20 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Storm of Shattered Glass {@recharge}
actions.description: Nintra targets a point she can see within 60 feet of her and creates a 20-foot-radius sphere of swirling glass shards centered on that point. Each creature in the sphere must make a DC 20 Dexterity saving throw, taking 28 (8d6) slashing damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful save. If Nintra is in the sphere, the shards deal no damage to her.

legendary_actions.name: Attack
legendary_actions.description: Nintra makes one attack.

legendary_actions.name: Fey Step
legendary_actions.description: Nintra teleports to an unoccupied space she can see within 30 feet of her.

legendary_actions.name: Shadow Strikes (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.description: Provided she is in bright or dim light, Nintra causes her shadow to attack a creature within 10 feet of her. Her shadow makes two claw attacks, each attack identical to Nintra's claw attack except that it deals psychic damage instead of piercing damage.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.header: Nintra casts one of the following spells, using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (save DC 20) and requiring no material components:

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.description: If Niv-Mizzet fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Locus of the Firemind
traits.description: Niv-Mizzet can maintain concentration on two different spells at the same time. In addition, he has advantage on saving throws to maintain concentration on spells.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: Niv-Mizzet has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Master Chemister
traits.description: When Niv-Mizzet casts a spell that deals damage, he can change the spell's damage to cold, fire, force, lightning, or thunder.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Niv-Mizzet makes three attacks: one with his bite and two with his claws.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +17 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. 18 (2d8 + 9) piercing damage plus 14 (4d6) fire damage.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +17 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 14 (2d4 + 9) slashing damage.

actions.name: Tail
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +17 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. 16 (2d6 + 9) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Fire Breath {@recharge 5}
actions.description: Niv-Mizzet exhales fire in a 90-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 25 Dexterity saving throw, taking 91 (26d6) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

legendary_actions.name: Cantrip
legendary_actions.description: Niv-Mizzet casts one of his cantrips.

legendary_actions.name: Tail Attack
legendary_actions.description: Niv-Mizzet makes a tail attack.

legendary_actions.name: Wing Attack (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.description: Niv-Mizzet beats his wings. Each creature within 15 feet of him must succeed on a DC 25 Dexterity saving throw or take 14 (2d4 + 9) bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone. Niv-Mizzet can then fly up to half his flying speed.

legendary_actions.name: Dracogenius (Costs 3 Actions)
legendary_actions.description: Niv-Mizzet regains a spell slot of 3rd level or lower.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.header: Niv-Mizzet is a 20th-level Izzet spellcaster. His spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save DC 26, +18 to hit with spell attacks). He has the following wizard spells prepared:

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The cyclops has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The cyclops makes two slam attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 23 (3d10 + 7) bludgeoning damage.

reactions.name: Spell Vitalization
reactions.description: Immediately after a creature casts a spell of 1st level or higher within 120 feet of the cyclops, the cyclops can move up to twice its speed without provoking opportunity attacks. It can then make one slam attack against a target of its choice.

actions.name: Rapier
actions.description: m +3, reach 5 ft. 5 (1d8 + 1) Piercing damage.

reactions.name: Parry
reactions.description: The noble is hit by a melee attack roll while holding a weapon. The noble adds 2 to its AC against that attack, possibly causing it to miss.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The noble makes three Beguiling Strike attacks.

actions.name: Beguiling Strike
actions.description: m,r +8, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft. 18 (4d6 + 4) Psychic damage, and the target has the Charmed condition until the start of the noble's next turn.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.header: The noble casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 16):

spellcasting.name: Shield (2/Day)
spellcasting.header: The noble casts Shield in response to that spell's trigger, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

traits.name: Siege Monster
traits.description: The noggle deals double damage to objects and structures.

actions.name: Sabotaging Swipe
actions.description: m +4, reach 5 ft. 6 (1d8 + 2) Slashing damage. If the target is wearing armor, it is subjected to the following effect. dex DC 12. The armor takes a -1 penalty to the AC it offers. The target can take an action to remove the penalty from its armor.

bonus_actions.name: Nimble Escape
bonus_actions.description: The noggle takes the Disengage or Hide action.

traits.name: Bloodied Wild Magic
traits.description: While Bloodied, the noggle has a Fly Speed of 30 feet and it can choose for any damage it deals to be Force damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The noggle makes two attacks, using Noggling Stick or Befuddling Ray in any combination.

actions.name: Noggling Stick
actions.description: m +5, reach 5 ft. 5 (1d4 + 3) Bludgeoning damage plus 2 (1d4) Psychic damage.

actions.name: Befuddling Ray
actions.description: r +5, range 60 ft. 6 (1d6 + 3) Psychic damage, and the target subtracts 1d4 from the next saving throw it makes before the end of the noggle's next turn.

traits.name: Axiomatic Mind
traits.description: The nonaton can't be compelled to act in a manner contrary to its nature or its instructions.

traits.name: Combat Ready
traits.description: The nonaton has advantage on initiative rolls.

traits.name: Disintegration
traits.description: If the nonaton dies, its body disintegrates into dust, leaving behind anything it was carrying.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The nonaton makes three Arm attacks and uses Pillar of Truth or Spellcasting.

actions.name: Arm
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 13 (2d8 + 4) piercing damage, and if the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the grappled condition (escape DC 14). Until this grapple ends, the nonaton can't use this arm against other targets. The nonaton has nine arms, each of which can grapple one target.

actions.name: Pillar of Truth
actions.description: The nonaton chooses a point on the ground that it can see within 60 feet of itself. A 60-foot-tall, 20-foot-radius cylinder of magical force rises from that point. Each creature in that area must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 21 (6d6) force damage, and the creature reverts to its original form (if it's in a different form) and can't assume a different form until the end of its next turn. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage only.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.header: The nonaton casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 15):

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The norker makes one mace and one bite attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 4 (1d6 + 1) piercing damage.

actions.name: Mace
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 4 (1d6 + 1) bludgeoning damage.

reactions.name: Defensive Rebuke
reactions.description: If a creature within 5 feet of the norker makes a melee attack against it, the norker can use its reaction to cause 4 piercing damage to it.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The norker war leader makes one greataxe and one bite attack, and also uses Fight On, You Slugs.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Greataxe
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 9 (1d12 + 3) slashing damage.

actions.name: Fight On, You Slugs
actions.description: The norker war leader picks up to three allied goblinoids within 60 feet that can see it. The chosen creatures can each use their reactions to make a single melee attack.

reactions.name: Defensive Rebuke
reactions.description: If a creature within 5 feet of the norker makes a melee attack against it, the norker can use its reaction to cause 6 piercing damage to it.

name: Nosferatu
languages: the languages it knew in life

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.description: The nosferatu regains 10 hit points at the start of each of its turns if it has at least 1 hit point and isn't in sunlight. If the nosferatu takes radiant damage, this trait doesn't function until the start of the nosferatu's next turn.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.description: The nosferatu can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

traits.name: Sunlight Hypersensitivity
traits.description: The nosferatu takes 20 radiant damage when it starts its turn in sunlight. While in sunlight, it has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks.

traits.name: Unusual Nature
traits.description: The nosferatu doesn't require air.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The nosferatu makes two Claw attacks followed by one Bite attack. If both Claw attacks hit the same creature, the Bite attack is made with advantage.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 9 (1d8 + 5) slashing damage.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. 9 (1d8 + 5) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) necrotic damage. If the target is missing any of its hit points, it instead takes 11 (2d10) necrotic damage. The target's hit point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the necrotic damage taken, and the nosferatu regains hit points equal to that amount. The reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest. The target dies if its hit point maximum is reduced to 0. A Humanoid slain in this way and then buried in the ground rises as a nosferatu after 1d10 days.

actions.name: Blood Disgorge {@recharge 5}
actions.description: The nosferatu vomits blood in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 16 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 18 (4d8) necrotic damage, and it can't regain hit points for 1 minute. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage with no additional effects.

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.description: Noska has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of Noska's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

traits.name: Dwarven Resilience
traits.description: Noska has advantage on saving throws against poison and resistance to poison damage.

traits.name: Difficult Climber
traits.description: Noska has disadvantage on Strength checks made to climb, due to his disability.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Noska makes two melee attacks.

actions.name: Mace
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. 5 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Heavy Crossbow
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack +2 to hit, range 100/400 ft., one target. 5 (1d10) piercing damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The nothic makes two Claw attacks.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: m +5, reach 5 ft. 8 (1d10 + 3) Slashing damage.

actions.name: Rotting Gaze
actions.description: con DC 13, one creature the nothic can see within 120 feet. 17 (5d6) Necrotic damage. Half damage.

bonus_actions.name: Weird Insight {@recharge}
bonus_actions.description: wis DC 14, one creature the nothic can see within 120 feet. The nothic magically learns one fact or secret about the target.

traits.name: Cloud of Vermin
traits.description: Any creature, other than a devil, that starts its turn within 20 feet of one or more nupperibos must succeed on a DC 11 Constitution saving throw or take 5 (2d4) acid damage. A creature within the areas of two or more nupperibos makes the saving throw with disadvantage.

traits.name: Driven Tracker
traits.description: In the Nine Hells, the nupperibo can flawlessly track any creature that has taken damage from any nupperibo's Cloud of Vermin within the previous 24 hours.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.

traits.name: Fiendish Restoration
traits.description: If the nycaloth dies outside Gehenna, its body dissolves into ichor, and it gains a new body instantly, reviving with all its Hit Points somewhere in Gehenna.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The nycaloth has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The nycaloth makes two Mercurial Axe attacks.

actions.name: Mercurial Axe
actions.description: m,r +9, reach 10 ft. or range 30/90 ft. 18 (2d12 + 5) Slashing damage plus 10 (3d6) Force damage. The axe magically returns to the nycaloth's hand immediately after a ranged attack.

bonus_actions.name: Shadowy Teleport
bonus_actions.description: The nycaloth has the Invisible condition for 1 minute, and it teleports up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space it can see. the condition ends early immediately after it deals damage.

traits.name: Charge
traits.description: If the ram moves at least 20 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a ram attack on the same turn, the target takes an extra 5 (2d4) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 13 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The ram has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Sure-Footed
traits.description: The ram has advantage on Strength and Dexterity saving throws against effects that would knock it prone.

actions.name: Ram
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 8 (2d4 + 3) bludgeoning damage plus 3 (1d6) force damage.

name: Oaken Bolter
languages: understands one language of its creator but can't speak

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The oaken bolter has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The oaken bolter makes two lancing bolt attacks or one lancing bolt attack and one harpoon attack.

actions.name: Lancing Bolt
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 100/400 ft., one target. 15 (2d10 + 4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Harpoon
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack +7 to hit, range 50/200 ft., one target. 9 (1d10 + 4) piercing damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 12). While grappled in this way, a creature's speed isn't reduced, but it can move only in directions that bring it closer to the oaken bolter. A creature takes 5 (1d10) slashing damage if it escapes from the grapple or if it tries and fails. As a bonus action, the oaken bolter can pull a creature grappled by it 20 feet closer. The oaken bolter can grapple only one creature at a time.

actions.name: Explosive Bolt {@recharge 5}
actions.description: The oaken bolter launches an explosive charge at a point within 120 feet. Each creature within 20 feet of that point must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw, taking 17 (5d6) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

traits.name: Amorphous
traits.description: The oblex can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

traits.name: Aversion to Fire
traits.description: If the oblex takes fire damage, it has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks until the end of its next turn.

traits.name: Unusual Nature
traits.description: The oblex doesn't require sleep.

actions.name: Pseudopod
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 5 (1d4 + 3) bludgeoning damage plus 2 (1d4) psychic damage.

traits.name: Blood Frenzy
traits.description: Obliteros has advantage on melee attack rolls against any creature that doesn't have all its hit points.

traits.name: Water Breathing
traits.description: Obliteros can breathe only underwater.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 22 (3d10 + 6) piercing damage.

traits.name: Council of Five
traits.description: The ghost has a trait based on who it is, as shown below: Enezesku: Enfeebling Ray. Enezesku's Innate Spellcasting trait includes ray of enfeeblement, which he can cast at will. Fautomni: Undead Fortitude. If damage reduces Fautomni to 0 hit points, he must make a Constitution saving throw with a DC of 5 + the damage taken, unless the damage is radiant or from a critical hit. On a success, Fautomni drops to 1 hit point instead. Karlov: Unnatural Vigor. When Karlov regains hit points, he has advantage on attack rolls he makes on his next turn. Vuliev: Teleportation. Vuliev's Innate Spellcasting trait includes misty step, which he can cast at will. Xil Xaxosz: Lingering Spite. When Xil Xaxosz is reduced to 0 hit points, his incorporeal form explodes in a burst of necrotic energy. Each creature within 5 feet of him must make a DC 16 Constitution saving throw, taking 14 (4d6) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

traits.name: Ethereal Sight
traits.description: The ghost can see 60 feet into the Ethereal Plane when it is on the Material Plane, and vice versa.

traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
traits.description: The ghost can move through other creatures and objects as if they were 3. It takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (1/Day)
traits.description: If the ghost fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

actions.name: Life Drain
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. 18 (4d8) necrotic damage, and the ghost regains hit points equal to half the amount of damage the target takes. The target must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or its hit point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the damage taken. The target dies if its hit point maximum is reduced to 0. This reduction to the target's hit point maximum lasts until the target finishes a long rest.

actions.name: Convene the Ghost Council
actions.description: The ghost summons the other four members of the Obzedat. At the start of the ghost's next turn, the other members appear in unoccupied spaces within 30 feet of the summoner. The ghosts each roll initiative when they appear.

legendary_actions.name: Forced Obedience
legendary_actions.description: A target that all of the Obzedat ghosts can see must succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw or bow until the end of its next turn. Until this bow ends, the target can't take actions or reactions, and its speed is 0 and can't be increased.

legendary_actions.name: Indentured Spirits (Costs 3 Actions)
legendary_actions.description: The Obzedat ghosts conjure 1d6 indentured spirits (described in this chapter) within 60 feet of one of them.

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
spellcasting.header: The ghost's innate spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 16, +8 to hit with spell attacks). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no components:

at_will: chill touch (at 5th level, and the ghost regains hit points equal to half the amount of damage the target takes)

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The extollant makes two Crimson Bolt attacks.

actions.name: Crimson Bolt
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Spell Attack +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft., one creature. 20 (3d10 + 4) psychic damage.

reactions.name: Reflect Agony
reactions.description: When the extollant is damaged by a creature within 60 feet of it, the creature must make a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw, taking 16 (3d10) psychic damage on a failed saving throw, or half as much damage on a successful one.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.header: The extollant casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 15):

actions.name: Shortsword
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) psychic damage.

actions.name: Arcane Blast {@recharge 5}
actions.description: The initiate creates an explosion of magical force in a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on a point it can see within 120 feet of itself. Each creature in that area must make a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed saving throw, the creature takes 10 (3d6) force damage and is pushed 10 feet away from the center of the area. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage and isn't pushed.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.header: The initiate casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 13):

traits.name: Alien Mind
traits.description: If a creature tries to read the silvertongue's thoughts or deals psychic damage to the silvertongue, that creature must succeed on a DC 16 Intelligence saving throw or be stunned until the start of its next turn.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The silvertongue has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Crimson Bolt
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Spell Attack +8 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft., one creature. 27 (4d10 + 5) psychic damage.

bonus_actions.name: Elemental Servitor (1/Day)
bonus_actions.description: The silvertongue magically summons an earth elemental, which appears in an unoccupied space the silvertongue can see within 60 feet of itself. The earth elemental takes its turn immediately after the silvertongue on the same initiative count and obeys the silvertongue's commands. The earth elemental disappears after 1 minute or when it or the silvertongue dies.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.header: The silvertongue casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 16):

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.description: Oceanus can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Friend of the Sea
traits.description: Using gestures and sounds, Oceanus can communicate simple ideas with any beast that has an innate swimming speed.

actions.name: Trident
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage, or 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack.

actions.name: Light Crossbow
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack +3 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. 5 (1d8 + 1) piercing damage.

traits.name: Amorphous
traits.description: The jelly can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch without expending extra movement to do so.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.description: The jelly can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

actions.name: Pseudopod
actions.description: m +4, reach 5 ft. 12 (3d6 + 2) Acid damage.

reactions.name: Split
reactions.description: While the jelly is Large or Medium and has 10+ Hit Points, it becomes Bloodied or is subjected to Lightning or Slashing damage. The jelly splits into two new Ochre Jellies. Each new jelly is one size smaller than the original jelly and acts on its Initiative. The original jelly's Hit Points are divided evenly between the new jellies (round down).

traits.name: Axiomatic Mind
traits.description: The octon can't be compelled to act in a manner contrary to its nature or its instructions.

traits.name: Combat Ready
traits.description: The octon has advantage on initiative checks.

traits.name: Disintegration
traits.description: If the octon dies, its body disintegrates into dust, leaving behind anything it was carrying.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The octon makes three Tentacle attacks.

actions.name: Tentacle
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 14 (3d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus 9 (2d8) lightning damage.

actions.name: Whirlwind of Tentacles {@recharge 5}
actions.description: The octon rapidly extends and spins its ring of tentacles. Each creature within 20 feet of the octon must succeed on a DC 16 Strength saving throw or be pulled up to 10 feet in a straight line toward the octon. Then, the octon makes two Tentacle attacks against each creature within 10 feet of itself.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.header: The octon casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 15):

traits.name: Compression
traits.description: The octopus can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch without expending extra movement to do so.

traits.name: Water Breathing
traits.description: The octopus can breathe only underwater.

actions.name: Tentacles
actions.description: m +4, reach 5 ft. 1 Bludgeoning damage.

reactions.name: Ink Cloud (1/Day)
reactions.description: A creature ends its turn within 5 feet of the octopus while underwater. The octopus releases ink that fills a 5-foot Cube [Area of Effect] centered on itself, and the octopus moves up to its Swim Speed. The Cube [Area of Effect] is Heavily Obscured for 1 minute or until a strong current or similar effect disperses the ink.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The oculorb has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Watchful Eyes
traits.description: The oculorb has advantage on initiative rolls and can't be surprised.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The oculorb makes two Dreadful Contact attacks or four Eye Beam attacks.

actions.name: Dreadful Contact
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. 14 (3d6 + 4) psychic damage, or 25 (6d6 + 4) psychic damage if the target has the frightened condition.

actions.name: Eye Beam
actions.description: Ranged Spell Attack +8 to hit, range 120 ft., one creature. 14 (3d6 + 4) psychic damage.

actions.name: Antipathic Flood {@recharge 5}
actions.description: The oculorb releases a wave of negative emotions, choosing one of the following options:

actions.name: Weeping Eyes
actions.description: The oculorb weeps, releasing a wave of crushing despair. Each creature within 30 feet of the oculorb must make a DC 16 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature's speed is reduced to 0 feet until the end of the oculorb's next turn, and if the creature was concentrating, its concentration is broken.

actions.name: Withering Glare
actions.description: The oculorb's eyes unleash furious scarlet energy in a 60-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 33 (6d10) necrotic damage and has the frightened condition for 1 minute. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and isn't frightened. A frightened creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a successful save.

reactions.name: Obsessive Rebuke
reactions.description: When the oculorb is damaged by a creature it can see within 60 feet of itself, it forces the creature to make a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw. The creature takes 10 (3d6) psychic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

traits.name: Fortune Teller
traits.description: Oddlewin can cast the Augury spell as a ritual, using cards as the material component.

traits.name: Nilbogism
traits.description: Any creature that attempts to damage Oddlewin must first succeed on a DC 12 Charisma saving throw or have the charmed condition until the end of the creature's next turn. The creature must use its action praising Oddlewin. Oddlewin can't regain hit points, including through magical healing, except through his Reversal of Fortune reaction.

actions.name: Fool's Scepter
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 5 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Cloud of Cards
actions.description: Oddlewin conjures magical cards that slash at the air in a 5-foot cube within 60 feet of Oddlewin until the start of Oddlewin's next turn. A creature that starts its turn in the cube or that enters that area for the first time on a turn takes 10 (4d4) slashing damage.

bonus_actions.name: Nimble Escape
bonus_actions.description: Oddlewin takes the Disengage or Hide action.

reactions.name: Reversal of Fortune
reactions.description: In response to another creature dealing damage to Oddlewin, Oddlewin reduces the damage to 0 and regains 9 (2d8) hit points.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.header: Oddlewin casts one of the following spells, using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 12):

actions.name: Greatclub
actions.description: m +6, reach 5 ft. 13 (2d8 + 4) Bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Javelin
actions.description: m,r +6, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft. 11 (2d6 + 4) Piercing damage.

traits.name: Siege Monster
traits.description: The ogre deals double damage to objects and structures.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The ogre makes two Bash attacks.

actions.name: Bash
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 15 (2d10 + 4) bludgeoning damage, and the ogre can push the target 5 feet away if the target is Huge or smaller.

reactions.name: Block the Path
reactions.description: When a creature enters a space within 5 feet of the ogre, the ogre makes a Bash attack against that creature. If the attack hits, the target's speed is reduced to 0 until the start of the ogre's next turn.

actions.name: Fist
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 9 (2d4 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Bolt Launcher
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack +3 to hit, range 120/480 ft., one target. 17 (3d10 + 1) piercing damage.

actions.name: Fist
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 9 (2d4 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Chain Smash {@recharge}
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage, and the target must make a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or be stunned for 1 minute. The target repeats the saving throw if it takes damage and at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

actions.name: Chain Sweep
actions.description: The ogre swings its chain, and every creature within 10 feet of it must make a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed saving throw, a creature takes 8 (1d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage and is knocked prone. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage and isn't knocked prone.

traits.name: Speak with Rats
traits.description: The ogre can verbally communicate simple concepts to ordinary rats and giant rats.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The ogre makes two Club attacks, two Rat-Tail Whip attacks, or one of each.

actions.name: Club
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 15 (2d10 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Rat-Tail Whip
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 13 (2d8 + 4) slashing damage, and if the target is Large or smaller, it is pulled 5 feet toward the ogre.

bonus_actions.name: Call Rats (1/Day)
bonus_actions.description: The ogre magically calls 1d4 giant rats. Each rat appears in an unoccupied space within 30 feet of the ogre that the ogre can see. The rats act as the ogre's allies, obey its spoken commands, and take their turns immediately after the ogre's turn on the same initiative count. The rats remain for 1 hour, until the ogre dies, or until the ogre dismisses them as a bonus action.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.header: The ogre casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 11):

traits.name: Howdah
traits.description: The ogre carries a compact fort on its back. Up to four Small creatures can ride in the fort without squeezing. To make a melee attack against a target within 5 feet of the ogre, they must use spears or weapons with reach. Creatures in the fort have three-quarters cover against attacks and effects from outside it. If the ogre dies, creatures in the fort are placed in unoccupied spaces within 5 feet of the ogre.

actions.name: Mace
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

name: Ogre Zombie
languages: understands Common and Giant but can't speak

traits.name: Undead Fortitude
traits.description: If damage reduces the zombie to 0 Hit Points, it makes a Constitution saving throw (DC 5 plus the damage taken) unless the damage is Radiant or from a Critical Hit. On a successful save, the zombie drops to 1 Hit Point instead.

actions.name: Slam
actions.description: m +6, reach 5 ft. 13 (2d8 + 4) Bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Battleaxe
actions.description: m +5, reach 5 ft. 7 (1d8 + 3) Slashing damage.

actions.name: Javelin
actions.description: m,r +5, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft. 6 (1d6 + 3) Piercing damage.

traits.name: Empowered Attacks
traits.description: Ogrémoch's slam attacks are treated as magical and adamantine for the purpose of bypassing resistance and immunity to nonmagical attacks.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.description: If Ogrémoch fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: Ogrémoch has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Siege Monster
traits.description: Ogrémoch deals double damage to objects and structures with his melee and ranged weapon attacks.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Ogrémoch makes two slam attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +14 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. 30 (4d10 + 8) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Boulder
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack +6 to hit, range 500 ft., one target. 46 (7d10 + 8) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 23 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

actions.name: Summon Elementals (1/Day)
actions.description: Ogrémoch summons up to three earth elementals and loses 30 hit points for each elemental he summons. Summoned elementals have maximum hit points, appear within 100 feet of Ogrémoch, and disappear if Ogrémoch is reduced to 0 hit points.

legendary_actions.name: Illuminating Crystals
legendary_actions.description: Ogrémoch's crystalline protrusions flare. Each creature within 30 feet of Ogrémoch becomes outlined in orange light, shedding dim light in a 10-foot radius. Any attack roll against an affected creature has advantage if the attacker can see it, and the affected creature can't benefit from being invisible.

legendary_actions.name: Stomp (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.description: Ogrémoch stomps the ground, creating an earth tremor that extends in a 30-foot radius. Other creatures standing on the ground in that radius must succeed on a DC 23 Dexterity saving throw or fall prone.

legendary_actions.name: Create Gargoyle (Costs 3 Actions)
legendary_actions.description: Ogrémoch's hit points are reduced by 50 as he breaks off a chunk of his body and places it on the ground in an unoccupied space within 15 feet of him. The chunk of rock instantly transforms into a gargoyle and acts on the same initiative count as Ogrémoch. Ogrémoch can't use this action if he has 50 hit points or fewer. The gargoyle obeys Ogrémoch's commands and fights until destroyed.

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
spellcasting.header: Ogrémoch's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 20, +12 to hit with spell attacks). He can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The oinoloth has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The oinoloth makes two Claw attacks, and it uses Spellcasting or Teleport.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 14 (3d6 + 4) slashing damage plus 22 (4d10) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Corrupted Healing {@recharge}
actions.description: The oinoloth touches one willing creature within 5 feet of it. The target regains all its hit points. In addition, the oinoloth can end one disease on the target or remove one of the following conditions from it: blinded, deafened, paralyzed, or poisoned. The target then gains 1 level of exhaustion, and its hit point maximum is reduced by 7 (2d6). This reduction can be removed only by a wish spell or by casting greater restoration on the target three times within the same hour. The target dies if its hit point maximum is reduced to 0.

actions.name: Teleport
actions.description: The oinoloth teleports, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

bonus_actions.name: Bringer of Plagues {@recharge 5}
bonus_actions.description: The oinoloth blights the area in a 30-foot-radius sphere centered on itself. The blight lasts for 24 hours. While the area is blighted, all normal plants there wither and die. Furthermore, when a creature moves into the blighted area or starts its turn there, that creature must make a DC 16 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 14 (4d6) poison damage and is poisoned. On a successful save, the creature is immune to the oinoloth's Bringer of Plagues for the next 24 hours. The poisoned creature can't regain hit points. After every 24 hours that elapse, the poisoned creature can repeat the saving throw. On a failed save, the creature's hit point maximum is reduced by 5 (1d10). This reduction lasts until the poison ends, and the target dies if its hit point maximum is reduced to 0. The poison ends after the creature successfully saves against it three times.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.description: Olara can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Fey Ancestry
traits.description: Olara has advantage on saving throws to end the charmed condition on herself, and magic can't put her to sleep.

traits.name: Keen Hearing and Sight
traits.description: The scout has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or sight.

actions.name: Multiattack

traits.description: Olhydra's slam attacks are treated as magical for the purpose of bypassing resistance and immunity to nonmagical attacks.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.description: If Olhydra fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: Olhydra has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Water Form
traits.description: Olhydra can enter a hostile creature's space and stop there. She can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Olhydra makes two slam attacks or two water jet attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 21 (3d10 + 5) bludgeoning damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 19). Olhydra can grapple up to four targets. When Olhydra moves, all creatures she is grappling move with her.

actions.name: Water Jet
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack +12 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. 21 (6d6) bludgeoning damage, and the target is knocked prone if it fails a DC 19 Strength saving throw.

actions.name: Summon Elementals (1/Day)
actions.description: Olhydra summons up to three water elementals and loses 30 hit points for each elemental she summons. Summoned elementals have maximum hit points, appear within 100 feet of Olhydra, and disappear if Olhydra is reduced to 0 hit points.

legendary_actions.name: Crush
legendary_actions.description: One creature that Olhydra is grappling is crushed for 21 (3d10 + 5) bludgeoning damage.

legendary_actions.name: Fling (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.description: Olhydra releases one creature she is grappling by flinging the creature up to 60 feet away from her, in a direction of her choice. If the flung creature comes into contact with a solid surface, such as a wall or floor, the creature takes 1d6 bludgeoning damage for every 10 feet it was flung.

legendary_actions.name: Water to Acid (Costs 3 Actions)
legendary_actions.description: Olhydra transforms her watery body into acid. This effect lasts until Olhydra's next turn. Any creature that comes into contact with Olhydra or hits her with a melee attack while standing within 5 feet of her takes 11 (2d10) acid damage. Any creature grappled by Olhydra takes 22 (4d10) acid damage at the start of its turn.

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
spellcasting.header: Olhydra's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 20, +12 to hit with spell attacks). She can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

traits.name: Divine Strike
traits.description: Once on each of his turns when he hits a creature with a weapon attack, Omin can cause the attack to deal an extra 4 (1d8) damage of the same type dealt by the weapon.

traits.name: Fey Ancestry
traits.description: Omin has advantage on saving throws against being charmed, and magic can't put him to sleep.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Omin makes two attacks with his maul.

actions.name: Maul
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 10 (2d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage.

reactions.name: War God's Blessing (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
reactions.description: When a creature within 30 feet of Omin makes an attack roll, but before learning whether it hits or misses, Omin can grant the creature a +10 bonus to that roll.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.header: Omin is a 9th-level spellcaster. His spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 15, +7 to hit with spell attacks). He has the following cleric spells prepared:

traits.name: Chilling Mist
traits.description: While it is alive, the one-eyed shiver projects an aura of cold mist within 10 feet of itself. If the one-eyed shiver deals damage to a creature in this area, the creature also takes 5 (1d10) cold damage.

actions.name: Dagger
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.

actions.name: Eye of Frost
actions.description: The one-eyed shiver casts ray of frost from its missing eye. If it hits, the target is also restrained. A target restrained in this way can end the condition by using an action, succeeding on a DC 13 Strength check.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.header: The one-eyed shiver is a 5th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 13, +5 to hit with spell attacks). It knows the following sorcerer spells:

actions.name: Stomp
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 16 (2d12 + 3) force damage.

actions.name: Realize Nightmares {@recharge 4}
actions.description: The oneirovore manipulates the perception of nearby creatures, sending them into a panic. Creatures of the oneirovore's choice that it can see within 60 feet must make a DC 19 Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, the creature has the charmed condition, their vision distorted such that they view their allies as creatures of pure fear and hatred. While charmed, a creature will use their actions to attack their allies with intent to kill. A charmed creature may repeat the saving throw at the end of each turn, ending the effect on a success.

actions.name: Warning Cry (1/Day)
actions.description: The oneirovore lets out an earsplitting shriek, calling for infernal reinforcements. Creatures that are not Fiends that are within 120 feet of the oneirovore must make a DC 19 Constitution saving throw, taking 55 (10d10) thunder damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Any lesser devils within a 1-mile-radius, centered on the oneirovore, are required by contract to come to its aid upon hearing its Warning Cry. Higher ranking devils may investigate if they desire, but the call holds no magical sway over them.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.description: The oni regains 10 Hit Points at the start of each of its turns if it has at least 1 Hit Point.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The oni makes two Claw or Nightmare Ray attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Spellcasting.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: m +7, reach 10 ft. 10 (1d12 + 4) Slashing damage plus 9 (2d8) Necrotic damage.

actions.name: Nightmare Ray
actions.description: r +5, range 60 ft. 9 (2d6 + 2) Psychic damage, and the target has the Frightened condition until the start of the oni's next turn.

actions.name: Shape-Shift
actions.description: The oni shape-shifts into a Small or Medium Humanoid or a Large Giant, or it returns to its true form. Other than its size, its game statistics are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.header: The oni casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 13):

spellcasting.name: Invisibility
spellcasting.header: The oni casts Invisibility on itself, requiring no spell components and using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

actions.name: Claws
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +7 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. 11 (2d10) slashing damage.

traits.name: Corrosive Form
traits.description: A creature that touches the Ooze Master or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 9 (2d8) acid damage. Any nonmagical weapon that hits the Ooze Master corrodes. After dealing damage, the weapon takes a permanent and cumulative −1 penalty to damage rolls. If its penalty drops to −5, the weapon is destroyed. Nonmagical ammunition that hits the Ooze Master is destroyed after dealing damage. The Ooze Master can eat through 2-inch-thick, nonmagical wood or metal in 1 round.

traits.name: Instinctive Attack
traits.description: When the Ooze Master casts a spell with a casting time of 1 action, it can make one pseudopod attack as a bonus action.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.description: The Ooze Master can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

actions.name: Pseudopod
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 13 (3d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage plus 10 (3d6) acid damage.

reactions.name: Instinctive Charm
reactions.description: If a creature the Ooze Master can see makes an attack roll against it while within 30 feet of it, the Ooze Master can use a reaction to divert the attack if another creature is within the attack's range. The attacker must make a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the attacker targets the creature that is closest to it, not including itself or the Ooze Master. If multiple creatures are closest, the attacker chooses which one to target. On a successful save, the attacker is immune to this Instinctive Charm for 24 hours. Creatures that can't be charmed are immune to this effect.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.header: The Ooze Master is a 9th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save DC 15, +7 to hit with spell attacks). It has the following wizard spells prepared:

traits.name: Transparent
traits.description: Even when an ooze-folk is in plain sight, it takes a DC 12 Wisdom (Perception) check to spot an ooze-folk that has neither moved nor attacked. A creature that tries to enter the ooze-folk's space while unaware of the ooze-folk is surprised by the ooze-folk.

traits.name: Fragile Bones
traits.description: For each 5 damage it takes, the ooze-folk's walking speed is reduced by 5 feet.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The ooze folk makes one glass longsword attack and one pseudopod attack.

actions.name: Glass Longsword
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. 6 (1d8 + 2) slashing damage. If a 1 is rolled on an attack roll with a glass longsword, it shatters and can no longer be used.

actions.name: Pseudopod
