traits.name: Shapechanger
traits.description: Ras Nsi can use his action to polymorph into a Medium snake or back into his yuan-ti form. His statistics are the same in each form. Any equipment he is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. He doesn't change form if he dies.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: Ras Nsi has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Ras Nsi makes three melee attacks, but can use Constrict only once.

actions.name: Bite (Snake Form Only)
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) poison damage.

actions.name: Constrict
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. 10 (2d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 14). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, and Ras Nsi can't constrict another target.

actions.name: Flame Tongue Longsword (Yuan-ti Form Only)
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 7 (1d8 + 3) slashing damage, or 8 (1d10 + 3) slashing damage when used with two hands, plus 7 (2d6) fire damage.

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
spellcasting.header: Ras Nsi's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 16). He can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.header: Ras Nsi is an 11th-level spellcaster. His spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save DC 15, +7 to hit with spell attacks). Ras Nsi has the following wizard spells prepared:

traits.name: Agile
traits.description: The rat doesn't provoke Opportunity Attacks when it moves out of an enemy's reach.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: m +2, reach 5 ft. 1 Piercing damage.

traits.name: Special Equipment
traits.description: Rath has a staff of fire, and scrolls of dimension door, feather fall, and fireball.

actions.name: Quarterstaff
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 4 (1d8) bludgeoning damage.

reactions.name: Illusory Self (Recharges on a Short or Long Rest)
reactions.description: When a creature Rath can see makes an attack roll against him, he can interpose an illusory duplicate between the attacker and him. The attack automatically misses Rath, then the illusion dissipates.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.header: Rath is an 11th-level spellcaster who uses Intelligence as his spellcasting ability (spell save DC 15, +7 to hit with spell attacks). Rath has the following spells prepared from the wizard spell list:

traits.name: Mimicry
traits.description: The raven can mimic simple sounds it has heard, such as a whisper or chitter. A hearer can discern the sounds are imitations with a successful DC 10 Wisdom (Insight) check.

actions.name: Beak
actions.description: m +4, reach 5 ft. 1 Piercing damage.

traits.name: Searing Armor
traits.description: The razerblast's armor is hot. Any creature grappling the razerblast or grappled by it takes 5 (1d10) fire damage at the end of that creature's turn.

traits.name: Shrapnel Explosion
traits.description: When the razerblast drops to 0 hit points, a flaming orb in its chest explodes, destroying the razerblast's body and scattering its armor as shrapnel. Creatures within 10 feet of the razerblast when it explodes must succeed on a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw, taking 21 (6d6) piercing damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The razerblast makes three melee attacks.

actions.name: Spear
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage, or 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack, plus 3 (1d6) fire damage.

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.description: If the blight is motionless at the start of combat, it has advantage on its initiative roll. If a creature hasn't observed the blight move or act, that creature must succeed on a DC 18 Intelligence (Investigation) check to discern that the blight is animate.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.description: The blight can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The blight makes two Claw attacks.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +4 to hit (with advantage if the target is missing any of its hit points), reach 10 ft., one target. 5 (1d6 + 2) slashing damage.

actions.name: Life-Draining Vines {@recharge}
actions.description: Snaking vines erupt from the blight. Each creature within 10 feet of it must make a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw, taking 9 (2d8) slashing damage on failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. If at least one of the creatures that failed this save isn't a Construct or an Undead, the blight regains 9 hit points.

armor_class.special: 11 + the level of the spell (natural armor)

traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
traits.description: The spirit can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. If it ends its turn inside an object, it is shunted to the nearest unoccupied space and takes 1d10 force damage for every 5 feet shunted.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The spirit makes a number of Reaping Scythe attacks equal to half the level of the spell (rounded down).

actions.name: Reaping Scythe
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack your spell attack modifier to hit (with advantage), reach 5 ft., the creature haunted by Haunt Creature. 1d8 + 3 + summonSpellLevel necrotic damage.

bonus_actions.name: Haunt Creature
bonus_actions.description: The spirit targets a creature it can see within 10 feet of itself and begins haunting it. While the target is haunted, you and the spirit sense the direction and distance to the target if it is on the same plane of existence as you. Additionally, if the target starts its turn within 10 feet of the spirit, the target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw against your spell save DC or have the frightened condition until the start of the target's next turn. The target remains haunted until it dies, the spirit disappears, or the spirit uses this action again.

traits.name: Aura of Murder
traits.description: As long as the reaper is not incapacitated, hostile creatures within 5 feet of it gain vulnerability to piercing damage unless they have resistance or immunity to such damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The reaper makes two dagger attacks and uses Shroud Self.

actions.name: Dagger
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. 7 (1d4 + 5) piercing damage.

actions.name: Shroud Self
actions.description: The reaper magically turns invisible until the start of its next turn. This invisibility ends if the reaper makes an attack roll, makes a damage roll, or casts a spell.

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
spellcasting.header: The reaper's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 13). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

traits.name: First Strike
traits.description: The reckoner has advantage on initiative rolls.

actions.name: Longsword
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 7 (1d8 + 3) slashing damage, or 8 (1d10 + 3) slashing damage if used with two hands.

reactions.name: Lightning Backlash {@recharge 5}
reactions.description: When a creature hits the reckoner with an attack, the attacker takes lightning damage equal to half the damage dealt by the attack.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.header: The reckoner is a 5th-level Boros spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save DC 12, +4 to hit with spell attacks). The reckoner has the following wizard spells prepared:

traits.name: Devil's Sight
traits.description: Magical darkness doesn't impede the abishai's darkvision.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The abishai has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The abishai makes one Bite attack and one Claw attack, and it can use Frightful Presence or Incite Fanaticism.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 22 (3d10 + 6) piercing damage plus 38 (7d10) fire damage.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 17 (2d10 + 6) force damage plus 11 (2d10) fire damage.

actions.name: Frightful Presence
actions.description: Each creature of the abishai's choice that is within 120 feet and aware of the abishai must succeed on a DC 18 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened of it for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to the abishai's Frightful Presence for the next 24 hours.

actions.name: Incite Fanaticism
actions.description: The abishai chooses up to four other creatures within 60 feet of it that can see it. Until the start of the abishai's next turn, each of those creatures makes attack rolls with advantage and can't be frightened.

actions.name: Power of the Dragon Queen
actions.description: The abishai targets one Dragon it can see within 120 feet of it. The Dragon must make a DC 18 Charisma saving throw. A chromatic dragon makes this save with disadvantage. On a successful save, the target is immune to the abishai's Power of the Dragon Queen for 1 hour. On a failed save, the target is charmed by the abishai for 1 hour. While charmed in this way, the target regards the abishai as a trusted friend to be heeded and protected. This effect ends if the abishai or its companions deal damage to the target.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The dragon makes two Rend attacks.

actions.name: Rend
actions.description: m +6, reach 5 ft. 9 (1d10 + 4) Slashing damage plus 3 (1d6) Fire damage.

actions.name: Fire Breath {@recharge 5}
actions.description: dex DC 13, each creature in a 15-foot Cone [Area of Effect]. 24 (7d6) Fire damage. Half damage.

traits.name: Chromatic Awakening (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
traits.description: If the greatwyrm would be reduced to 0 hit points, its current hit point total instead resets to 425 hit points, it recharges its Breath Weapon, and it regains any expended uses of Legendary Resistance. Additionally, the greatwyrm can now use the options in the "Mythic Actions" section for 1 hour. Award a party an additional 105,000 XP (210,000 XP total) for defeating the greatwyrm after its Chromatic Awakening activates.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (4/Day)
traits.description: If the greatwyrm fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Unusual Nature
traits.description: The greatwyrm doesn't require food or drink.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The greatwyrm makes one Bite attack and two Claw attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +18 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. 21 (2d10 + 10) piercing damage plus 13 (2d12) force damage.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +18 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 19 (2d8 + 10) slashing damage. If the target is a Huge or smaller creature, it is grappled (escape DC 20) and is restrained until this grapple ends. The greatwyrm can have only one creature grappled this way at a time.

actions.name: Tail
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +18 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. 19 (2d8 + 10) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 26 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

actions.name: Breath Weapon {@recharge 5}
actions.description: The greatwyrm exhales a blast of energy in a 300-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 26 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 78 (12d12) fire damage. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage.

legendary_actions.name: Attack
legendary_actions.description: The greatwyrm makes one Claw or Tail attack.

legendary_actions.name: Wing Attack (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.description: The greatwyrm beats its wings. Each creature within 30 feet of it must succeed on a DC 26 Dexterity saving throw or take 17 (2d6 + 10) bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone. The greatwyrm can then fly up to half its flying speed.

legendary_actions.name: Arcane Spear (Costs 3 Actions)
legendary_actions.description: The greatwyrm creates four spears of magical force. Each spear hits a creature of the greatwyrm's choice it can see within 120 feet of it, dealing 12 (1d8 + 8) force damage to its target, then disappears.

name: Red Guard Drake
languages: understands Draconic but can't speak it

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The drake attacks twice, once with its bite and once with its tail.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Tail
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 6 (1d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage.

traits.name: Draconic Devotion
traits.description: While Red Ruin can see a Dragon that isn't hostile to her, she has advantage on attack rolls.

traits.name: Mounted Combat Master
traits.description: When Red Ruin is mounted and a creature targets her mount with an attack, Red Ruin can cause the attack to target her instead.

traits.name: Mounted Evasion
traits.description: When Red Ruin or her mount makes a Dexterity saving throw to take half damage from an effect, they take no damage on a success and half damage on a failure.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Red Ruin makes three Ember Lance attacks.

actions.name: Ember Lance
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 10 (1d12 + 4) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) fire damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it must succeed on a DC 16 Strength saving throw or fall prone.

actions.name: Explosive Hand Crossbow {@recharge 5}
actions.description: Red Ruin fires an explosive crossbow bolt at a point she can see within 120 feet of herself. When the bolt reaches that point, or if it hits an object early, it detonates in a 20-foot-radius sphere. Each creature in that area must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw, taking 35 (10d6) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The slaad has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.description: The slaad regains 10 Hit Points at the start of each of its turns if it has at least 1 Hit Point.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The slaad makes three Injecting Claw attacks.

actions.name: Injecting Claw
actions.description: m +6, reach 10 ft. 10 (2d6 + 3) Piercing damage. If the target is a Humanoid not cursed by a slaad, it is subjected to the following effect. con DC 14. The target is cursed unawares, and a minuscule slaad egg is implanted in it. Removing the curse destroys the egg. Over 2d4 × 10 days, the egg gestates. In the final 24 hours, the cursed target feels unwell; its Speed is halved, and it has Disadvantage on D20 Tests. At the end of this time, the egg turns into a Slaad Tadpole, which chews out of the host and kills it.

actions.name: Shortsword
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.

traits.name: Iron Boots
traits.description: The redcap has disadvantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks.

traits.name: Outsize Strength
traits.description: While grappling, the redcap is considered to be Medium. Also, wielding a heavy weapon doesn't impose disadvantage on its attack rolls.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The redcap makes three Wicked Sickle attacks.

actions.name: Wicked Sickle
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 9 (2d4 + 4) slashing damage.

actions.name: Ironbound Pursuit
actions.description: The redcap moves up to its speed to a creature it can see and kicks with its iron boots. The target must succeed on a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw or take 20 (3d10 + 4) bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The werefox makes two Bite attacks, two Lance attacks, or one Bite attack and one Lance attack.

actions.name: Bite (Fox or Hybrid Form Only)
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 8 (1d10 + 3) piercing damage. If the werefox moved at least 20 feet straight toward the target immediately before the hit and the target is a Medium or smaller creature, the target must succeed on a DC 13 Strength saving throw or have the prone condition.

actions.name: Lance (Elf or Hybrid Form Only)
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +5 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 9 (1d12 + 3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Entangling Arrow (Elf or Hybrid Form Only)
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack +5 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. 10 (2d6 + 3) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 11 Dexterity saving throw or have the restrained condition until the start of the werefox's next turn.

bonus_actions.name: Change Shape
bonus_actions.description: The werefox polymorphs into a fox-elf hybrid, into a fox, or back into its elf form. Its game statistics, other than its speed, are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. It reverts to its elf form if it dies.

bonus_actions.name: Vulpine Nimbleness (Fox or Hybrid Form Only)
bonus_actions.description: The werefox takes the Dash or Disengage action.

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.description: The shark has Advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the shark's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally doesn't have the Incapacitated condition.

traits.name: Water Breathing
traits.description: The shark can breathe only underwater.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: m +4, reach 5 ft. 7 (2d4 + 2) Piercing damage.

traits.name: Creature Sense
traits.description: The refraction is aware of creatures within 100 miles of it that have an Intelligence score of 4 or higher. It knows the distance and direction to each creature, as well as each one's Intelligence score, but can't sense anything else about it. A creature protected by a mind blank spell, a nondetection spell, or similar magic can't be perceived in this manner.

traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
traits.description: The refraction can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (5/Day)
traits.description: If the refraction fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The refraction has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The refraction makes two Dissonant Claw attacks.

actions.name: Dissonant Claw
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +11 to hit, reach 10 ft. or range 120 ft., one creature. 25 (3d12 + 6) psychic damage. If the target is a creature concentrating on a spell, its concentration is broken.

actions.name: Mind Blast {@recharge 5}
actions.description: Creatures of the refraction's choice within 60 feet of it must succeed on a DC 19 Intelligence saving throw or take 33 (5d10 + 6) psychic damage and have the stunned condition for 1 minute. A stunned creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

actions.name: Teleport
actions.description: The refraction teleports, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, up to 120 feet to an unoccupied place that it can see.

legendary_actions.name: Mindbreaker
legendary_actions.description: The refraction targets a creature within 120 feet of itself and disrupts its mental processes, causing the target to have disadvantage on all ability checks, attack rolls, and saving throws until the end of the target's next turn.

legendary_actions.name: Projected Claw (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.description: The refraction makes one Dissonant Claw attack.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting (Psionics)
spellcasting.header: The refraction casts one of the following spells, requiring no spell components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 19):

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The regisaur has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The regisaur makes one Bite attack and one Tail attack. The regisaur can't target the same creature with both attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +13 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 47 (6d12 + 8) piercing damage, and the target has the grappled condition (escape DC 18). Until this grapple ends, the target has the restrained condition, and the regisaur can't Bite another target.

actions.name: Tail
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +13 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. 26 (4d8 + 8) bludgeoning damage.

bonus_actions.name: Swallow
bonus_actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +13 to hit, reach 5 ft., one Huge or smaller creature grappled by the regisaur. The regisaur swallows the target, and the grapple ends. A swallowed creature has the blinded and restrained conditions, it has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the regisaur, and it takes 7 (2d6) acid damage at the start of each of its turns. The regisaur can have up to two creatures swallowed at a time. If the regisaur takes 25 damage or more on a single turn from a swallowed creature, the regisaur must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate the creature, which falls in a space within 5 feet of the regisaur and has the prone condition; the creature no longer has the blinded and restrained conditions.

traits.name: Glory
traits.description: The reigar's Armor Class includes its Charisma modifier.

traits.name: Hold Breath
traits.description: The reigar can hold its breath for 1 hour.

traits.name: Special Equipment
traits.description: The reigar wears a talarith.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The reigar makes two Trident attacks.

actions.name: Trident
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage, or 8 (1d8 + 4) piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack, plus 3 (1d6) force damage if the reigar is wearing its talarith.

actions.name: Chromatic Bolt
actions.description: Ranged Spell Attack +10 to hit, range 90 ft., one target. 22 (5d8) damage of a type chosen by the reigar from the following list: cold, fire, lightning, or radiant.

actions.name: Summon Duplicate (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
actions.description: Using its talarith, the reigar summons a duplicate of itself. The duplicate obeys the reigar's commands and uses the reigar's statistics, except it is an unaligned Construct that doesn't have a talarith of its own. The duplicate takes its turn immediately after the reigar. It vanishes after 1 hour or when it is reduced to 0 hit points.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting (Psionics)
spellcasting.header: The reigar casts one of the following spells, requiring no spell components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 18):

name: Relentless Impaler
languages: understands all languages but can't speak

traits.name: Bloodheart Stake
traits.description: The impaler is magically bound to the ceremonial stake and the sacrificed corpse the ritual caster used to create it. If the impaler is reduced to 0 hit points, it disappears, then re-forms 1d8 hours later in the nearest unoccupied space to the stake and regains all its hit points. The impaler dies only if it is reduced to 0 hit points while either the ceremonial stake is removed from the sacrifice's corpse or the impaler is on a different plane of existence from that corpse.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.description: If the impaler fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The impaler makes one Spike attack and two Wicked Spear attacks.

actions.name: Spike
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 15 (2d8 + 6) piercing damage, and the target's speed is halved until the start of the impaler's next turn.

actions.name: Wicked Spear
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack +11 to hit, reach 10 ft. or range 20/40 ft., one target. 13 (2d6 + 6) piercing damage plus 13 (3d8) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Spike Burst {@recharge 5}
actions.description: Twisted, spectral spikes shoot out from the impaler's body. Each creature within 30 feet of the impaler must make a DC 19 Dexterity saving throw, taking 40 (9d8) force damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

legendary_actions.name: Speed Spike
legendary_actions.description: The impaler teleports up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space it can see. It can then make a Spike attack.

legendary_actions.name: Deepen Wounds (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.description: Each creature whose speed is currently reduced by the impaler's Spike attack takes 18 (4d8) necrotic damage.

name: Relentless Juggernaut
languages: understands all languages but can't speak

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.description: If the juggernaut fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.description: The juggernaut regains 20 hit points at the start of its turn. If the juggernaut takes radiant damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of its next turn. The juggernaut dies only if it starts its turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate.

traits.name: Unusual Nature
traits.description: The juggernaut doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The juggernaut makes two attacks. It can replace one attack with Deadly Shaping if it is ready.

actions.name: Executioner's Pick
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 17 (2d10 + 6) piercing damage, and if the target is a creature, its speed is reduced by 10 feet until the start of the juggernaut's next turn.

actions.name: Fist
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 11 (1d10 + 6) bludgeoning damage, and if the target is a Large or smaller creature, it must succeed on a DC 18 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

actions.name: Deadly Shaping {@recharge 5}
actions.description: The juggernaut magically shapes a feature of its surroundings into a deadly implement. A creature the juggernaut can see within 60 feet of it must make a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw. If the saving throw fails, the targeted creature is struck by one of the following (juggernaut's choice):

actions.name: Flying Stone
actions.description: The target takes 22 (5d8) bludgeoning damage and is incapacitated until the start of the juggernaut's next turn, and the implement vanishes.

actions.name: Scything Shrapnel
actions.description: The target takes 14 (4d6) slashing damage, and the implement vanishes. At the start of each of its turns, the target takes 10 (3d6) necrotic damage from the wound left by the shrapnel. The wound ends if the target regains any hit points or if a creature uses an action to stanch the wound, which requires a successful DC 15 Wisdom (Medicine) check.

legendary_actions.name: Implacable Advance
legendary_actions.description: The juggernaut moves up to its speed, ignoring 3. Any object in its path takes 55 (10d10) bludgeoning damage if it isn't being worn or carried.

legendary_actions.name: Rapid Shaping (Costs 3 Actions)
legendary_actions.description: The juggernaut recharges Deadly Shaping and uses it.

name: Relentless Slasher
languages: understands all languages but can't speak

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (1/Day)
traits.description: If the slasher fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Shrouded Presence
traits.description: The slasher is immune to any effect that would sense its emotions or read its thoughts, and it can't be detected by abilities that sense Fiends.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The slasher makes two Slasher's Knife attacks.

actions.name: Slasher's Knife
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/60 ft., one target. 6 (1d4 + 4) slashing damage plus 21 (6d6) necrotic damage. If the target is a creature, it suffers a lingering wound that causes it to take 7 (2d6) necrotic damage at the start of each of its turns. Each time the slasher hits the wounded target with this attack, the damage dealt by the wound increases by 3 (1d6). The wound ends if the target regains hit points or if a creature uses an action to stanch the wound, which requires a successful DC 15 Wisdom (Medicine) check.

legendary_actions.name: Slice
legendary_actions.description: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/60 ft., one target. 7 (1d6 + 4) slashing damage.

legendary_actions.name: Vanishing Strike (Costs 3 Actions)
legendary_actions.description: The slasher makes one Slasher's Knife attack. After the attack hits or misses, the slasher can teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

actions.name: Claws

traits.description: If the scion fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The scion has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Siege Monster
traits.description: The scion deals double damage to objects and structures.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The scion makes one Great Tree Club attack and two Slam attacks, or it makes three Boulder attacks.

actions.name: Great Tree Club
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +15 to hit, reach 30 ft., one target. 30 (4d10 + 8) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 23 Strength saving throw or be pushed horizontally up to 100 feet straight away from the scion and have the prone condition.

actions.name: Slam
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +15 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. 26 (4d8 + 8) force damage.

actions.name: Boulder
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack +15 to hit, range 120/480 ft., one target. 27 (3d12 + 8) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Inhale {@recharge 5}
actions.description: The scion inhales a vortex of air in a 120-foot line that is 15 feet wide. Each creature in that area that is Huge or smaller must succeed on a DC 23 Strength saving throw or be pulled up to 120 feet straight toward the scion and be swallowed. A swallowed creature has the restrained condition, has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the scion, and takes 24 (7d6) force damage at the start of each of the scion's turns. The scion's stomach can hold up to two creatures at a time. If the scion takes 60 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, the scion must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, each of which falls in a space within 10 feet of the scion and has the prone condition. If the scion dies, any swallowed creature no longer has the restrained condition and can escape from the corpse using 15 feet of movement, exiting with the prone condition.

bonus_actions.name: Earth-Shaking Movement
bonus_actions.description: The scion moves up to its speed and then sends a shock wave through the ground in a 60-foot-radius circle centered on itself. Each creature on the ground in that area that is concentrating must succeed on a DC 23 Constitution saving throw or lose concentration.

reactions.name: Feed
reactions.description: Immediately after taking damage, if it has at least one creature swallowed, the scion deals 10 (3d6) force damage to each swallowed creature and regains 10 hit points.

traits.name: Flyby
traits.description: The scion doesn't provoke opportunity attacks when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (6/Day)
traits.description: If the scion fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The scion has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Siege Monster
traits.description: The scion deals double damage to objects and structures.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The scion makes one attack using Cloud Morningstar or Wind Javelin, as well as two Slam attacks.

actions.name: Cloud Morningstar
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +18 to hit, reach 30 ft., one target. 32 (4d10 + 10) force damage plus 22 (4d10) thunder damage.

actions.name: Wind Javelin
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack +18 to hit, range 120/480 ft., one target. 42 (5d12 + 10) thunder damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 26 Strength saving throw or have the prone condition.

actions.name: Slam
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +18 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. 28 (4d8 + 10) force damage.

actions.name: Thunderous Vortex {@recharge 5}
actions.description: The scion magically creates a vortex of wind in a 60-foot-radius sphere centered on a point it can see within 120 feet of itself. Each creature in the sphere must succeed on a DC 24 Strength saving throw or be pulled straight toward the sphere's center, ending in an unoccupied space as close as possible to the center. Then a burst of thunder erupts in a 30-foot-radius sphere centered on the same point. Each creature in that area takes 52 (8d12) thunder damage and must succeed on a DC 24 Constitution saving throw or have the stunned condition until the end of its next turn.

bonus_actions.name: Fog of Deception
bonus_actions.description: The scion conjures a magical cloud that fills a 30-foot-radius sphere centered on a point it can see within 90 feet of itself. Each creature in that area must make a DC 24 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, a creature has the charmed condition until the end of its next turn. While it has the charmed condition, the creature must use its action to make a melee attack against a creature other than itself of the scion's choice. If no creature is within its reach, the affected creature makes a ranged attack against a creature of the scion's choice, throwing its weapon if necessary. On a successful save, a creature is immune to the scion's Fog of Deception for the next 24 hours.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (6/Day)
traits.description: If the scion fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The scion has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Siege Monster
traits.description: The scion deals double damage to objects and structures.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The scion makes one Crystal Club attack and two Slam attacks, then uses Entombing Grasp if available. Alternatively, the scion makes two Runic Boulder attacks.

actions.name: Crystal Club
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +16 to hit, reach 30 ft., one target. 35 (4d12 + 9) bludgeoning damage. The scion can cause the club to flare with bright light, and the target must succeed on a DC 22 Constitution saving throw or take 18 (4d8) radiant damage and have the blinded condition until the start of the scion's next turn.

actions.name: Slam
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +16 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. 31 (4d10 + 9) force damage.

actions.name: Runic Boulder
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack +16 to hit, range 120/480 ft., one target. 27 (4d8 + 9) bludgeoning damage. The boulder explodes. The target and each creature within 30 feet of it must make a DC 22 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 19 (3d12) force damage and has the prone condition. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage only.

actions.name: Entombing Grasp {@recharge}
actions.description: The scion wreathes its hand in petrifying magic and touches one Huge or smaller creature it can see within 20 feet of itself. The target must succeed on a DC 24 Dexterity saving throw or take 28 (8d6) force damage and have the grappled condition (escape DC 19). At the start of the scion's next turn, if the target is still grappled, the target has the petrified condition.

bonus_actions.name: Earth-Shaking Movement

actions.name: Hailstone
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack +18 to hit, range 120/480 ft., one target. 32 (4d10 + 10) bludgeoning damage plus 18 (4d8) cold damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 26 Strength saving throw or have the prone condition.

actions.name: Slam
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +18 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. 36 (4d12 + 10) force damage.

bonus_actions.name: Vengeful Storm {@recharge}
bonus_actions.description: The scion conjures a churning storm cloud in a 30-foot-radius, 10-foot-tall cylinder centered on a point within 120 feet of itself. The cloud's area is heavily obscured. The cloud lasts for 1 minute, until the scion dies, or when the scion uses this bonus action again. When the cloud appears, and as a bonus action on later turns, the scion can move the cloud up to 30 feet and cause one of the following effects in a 30-foot-radius, 120-foot-high cylinder directly below it; the scion can't choose the same effect two rounds in a row:

bonus_actions.name: Acid Rain
bonus_actions.description: The cloud rains acid. Each creature in the cylinder must succeed on a DC 25 Constitution saving throw or be covered in acid for 1 minute or until a creature uses its action to remove the acid from itself or another creature. A creature covered in the acid takes 26 (4d12) acid damage at the start of each of its turns.

bonus_actions.name: Freezing Storm
bonus_actions.description: Shards of ice pelt down, and freezing wind fills the area. Each creature in the cylinder must succeed on a DC 25 Dexterity saving throw or take 28 (8d6) cold damage and be hindered by ice formations for 1 minute or until it or another creature within reach of it uses an action to break away the ice. A creature hindered by ice has its speed reduced to 0.

bonus_actions.name: Lightning Bolts
bonus_actions.description: Bolts of lightning strike down. Each creature in the cylinder must succeed on DC 25 Dexterity saving throw or take 18 (4d8) lightning damage and have the stunned condition until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Lava Blade

actions.name: Lava Ball
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack +18 to hit, range 120/480 ft., one target. 29 (3d12 + 10) bludgeoning damage plus 10 (3d6) fire damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 26 Strength saving throw or have the prone condition.

actions.name: Slam
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +18 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. 28 (4d8 + 10) force damage.

actions.name: Lava Wave {@recharge 5}
actions.description: The scion emits a wave of lava from its blade, hands, or mouth in a 90-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 25 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 60 (11d10) fire damage and has the restrained condition from being embedded in hardening rock. A creature can make a DC 25 Strength (Athletics) check as an action, freeing itself or a creature within reach from the rock on a success. The rock has AC 17 and 40 hit points, and it is immune to fire, poison, and psychic damage. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage only.

bonus_actions.name: Earth-Shaking Movement
bonus_actions.description: The scion moves up to its speed and then sends a shock wave through the ground in a 60-foot-radius circle centered on itself. Each creature on the ground in that area that is concentrating must succeed on a DC 26 Constitution saving throw or lose concentration.

bonus_actions.name: Incendiary Smoke
bonus_actions.description: The scion causes smoke and white-hot embers to billow from its skin, filling a 30-foot-radius sphere centered on itself that moves with it. While the scion's skin billows smoke, ranged attacks against the scion are made with disadvantage. A creature that moves into the smoke for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there must succeed on a DC 25 Constitution saving throw or take 14 (4d6) fire damage. The scion's skin stops billowing smoke after 1 minute, when the scion dies, or when the scion uses this bonus action to stop the smoke.

actions.name: Glacier Throw

actions.name: Glacial Upheaval {@recharge 5}
actions.description: The scion digs its hands into the ground at a point it can see within 30 feet of itself and launches a magically conjured mass of ice into the air. Each creature other than the scion in a 30-foot-radius, 100-foot-high cylinder centered on that point must make a DC 25 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 36 (8d8) bludgeoning damage plus 19 (3d12) cold damage and is pushed vertically to the top of the cylinder, at which point the creature falls. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and is pushed to the nearest unoccupied space outside the cylinder with no additional effects. At the start of the scion's next turn, a mass of ice plummets to the ground on a point the scion can see within 60 feet of the point the scion dug its hands into. Each creature in a 30-foot-radius, 100-foot-high cylinder centered on that point must succeed on a DC 25 Dexterity saving throw or take 18 (4d8) bludgeoning damage plus 18 (4d8) cold damage.

bonus_actions.name: Earth-Shaking Movement
bonus_actions.description: The scion moves up to its speed and sends a shock wave through the ground in a 60-foot-radius circle centered on itself. Each creature on the ground in that area that is concentrating must succeed on a DC 25 Constitution saving throw or lose concentration.

traits.name: Explosive Tank
traits.description: When the guard dies, or if it rolls a 1 when checking whether its Scorchbringer action recharges, the tank on its back explodes in a 10-foot radius sphere. Each creature in that area must make a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw, taking 7 (2d6) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The explosion ignites flammable objects that aren't being worn or carried, and it destroys the scorchbringer.

actions.name: Light Hammer
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. 4 (1d4 + 2) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Scorchbringer {@recharge 4}
actions.description: The guard's scorchbringer spouts a stream of flame in a line that is 30 feet long and 5 feet wide. Each creature in the line must make a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw, taking 7 (2d6) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

actions.name: Sting
actions.description: m +2, reach 5 ft. 1 Piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) Poison damage.

actions.name: Shortsword
actions.description: m +4, reach 5 ft. 5 (1d6 + 2) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Longbow
actions.description: r +5, range 150/600 ft. 7 (1d8 + 3) Piercing damage, plus 10 (3d6) Piercing damage if the attack was made with Advantage.

bonus_actions.description: The scout has Advantage on the next attack roll it makes during the current turn.

reactions.name: Uncanny Dodge
reactions.description: The scout is hit by an attack roll. The scout halves the damage (round down) it takes from that attack.

name: Scrapper
languages: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

traits.name: Electrified Chassis
traits.description: A creature that hits the scrapper with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 19 (3d12) lightning damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The scrapper makes two Spike Punch attacks. It can replace one of those with a Wires attack.

actions.name: Spike Punch
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 14 (2d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage plus 5 (1d10) piercing damage.

actions.name: Wires
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +8 to hit, reach 20 ft., one Large or smaller creature. The target has the grappled condition (escape DC 16) and must succeed on a DC 16 Strength saving throw or be pulled into an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the scrapper and take 19 (3d12) lightning damage. The scrapper can have only one creature grappled in this way at a time.

actions.name: Eye Beam {@recharge 5}
actions.description: The scrapper shoots a magical beam from its extended eye at one creature it can see within 120 feet of itself. The target must make a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw, taking 44 (8d10) force damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

traits.name: Agile Flier
traits.description: Opportunity attacks against the screaming devilkin have disadvantage while it is flying.

traits.name: Ceaseless Screaming
traits.description: Any creature other than a screaming devilkin that starts its turn within 30 feet of one or more screaming devilkins and can hear it must make a DC 10 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure the creature is incapacitated until the start of its next turn. On a success, the creature suffers no effect.

traits.name: Stunted Legs
traits.description: The screaming devilkin has disadvantage on attack rolls and all attack rolls made against it gain advantage while the devilkin isn't flying.

actions.name: Barbed Tail
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage.

actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 3 (1d3 + 2) bludgeoning damage.

actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +5 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. 10 (2d6 + 3) piercing damage, or 17 (4d6 + 3) piercing damage if the serpentmaw had advantage on the attack roll.

actions.name: Claw

traits.name: Magic Resistance

actions.name: Claws
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 13 (2d8 + 4) slashing damage.

actions.name: Death Glare
actions.description: The sea fury targets one frightened creature it can see within 30 feet of it. The target must succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw or drop to 0 hit points.

legendary_actions.name: As Water
legendary_actions.description: The sea fury transforms into a wave of foaming seawater, along with whatever it is wearing or carrying, and moves up to its speed without provoking opportunity attacks. While in this form, it can't be grappled or restrained. It reverts to its true form at the end of this movement.

legendary_actions.name: Fearsome Apparition (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.description: The sea fury conjures an apparition of one of its dead sisters, which appears in an unoccupied space the sea fury can see within 30 feet of it. Enemies of the sea fury that can see the apparition must succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened of it until it vanishes at the end of the sea fury's next turn.

legendary_actions.name: Conjure Snakes (Costs 3 Actions)
legendary_actions.description: The sea fury disgorges a swarm of poisonous snakes, which occupies the same space as the sea fury, acts on its own initiative count, and attacks as directed by the sea fury. The sea fury can control up to three of these swarms at a time.

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
spellcasting.header: The sea fury's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 16, +8 to hit with spell attacks). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.description: The hag can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Vile Appearance
traits.description: wis DC 11, any Beast or Humanoid that starts its turn within 30 feet of the hag and can see the hag's true form. The target has the Frightened condition until the start of its next turn. The target is immune to this hag's Vile Appearance for 24 hours.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: m +5, reach 5 ft. 10 (2d6 + 3) Slashing damage.

actions.name: Death Glare {@recharge 5}
actions.description: wis DC 11, one Frightened creature the hag can see within 30 feet. If the target has 20 Hit Points or fewer, it drops to 0 Hit Points. Otherwise, the target takes 13 (3d8) Psychic damage.

spellcasting.name: Coven Magic
spellcasting.header: While within 30 feet of at least two hag allies, the hag can cast one of the following spells, requiring no Material components, using the spell's normal casting time, and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 11): Augury, Find Familiar, Identify, Locate Object, Scrying, or Unseen Servant. The hag must finish a Long Rest before using this trait to cast that spell again.

spellcasting.name: Illusory Appearance
spellcasting.header: The hag casts Disguise Self, using Constitution as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 13). The spell's duration is 24 hours.

traits.name: Water Breathing

traits.name: Pack Tactics

traits.name: Swimming Leap
traits.description: With a 10-foot swimming start, the sea lion can long jump out of or across the water up to 25 feet.

actions.name: Multiattack

actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 12 (2d8 + 3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 12 (2d8 + 3) piercing damage.

name: Sea Spawn
languages: understands Aquan and Common but can't speak

traits.name: Limited Amphibiousness
traits.description: The sea spawn can breathe air and water, but it needs to be submerged in the sea at least once a day for 1 minute to avoid suffocating.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The sea spawn makes two Unarmed Strike attacks and one Piscine Anatomy attack.

actions.name: Unarmed Strike
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 4 (1d4 + 2) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Piscine Anatomy
actions.description: The sea spawn uses one of the following options (choose one or roll a d6): 1–2: Bite. Melee Weapon Attack +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage. 3–4: Poison Quills. Melee Weapon Attack +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. 3 (1d6) poison damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 1 minute. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. 5–6: Tentacle. Melee Weapon Attack +4 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 5 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 12) if it is a Medium or smaller creature. Until this grapple ends, the sea spawn can't use this tentacle on another target.

traits.name: Water Breathing
traits.description: The seahorse can breathe only underwater.

actions.name: Bubble Dash
actions.description: While underwater, the seahorse moves up to its Swim Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

traits.name: Hold Breath
traits.description: The seal can hold its breath for 15 minutes.

traits.name: Keen Smell
traits.description: The seal has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 1 piercing damage.

traits.name: Fey Ancestry
traits.description: The Selenelion twins, Gleam and Glister, have advantage on saving throws against being charmed, and magic can't put them to sleep.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.description: A Selenelion twin regains 5 hit points at the start of her turn as long as both twins are alive and within 60 feet of each other. A twin dies only if she starts her turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate.

traits.name: Twin Bond
traits.description: While both Selenelion twins are alive and on the same plane of existence, each is aware of the other's emotions.

actions.name: Dagger
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. 6 (1d4 + 4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Moon Ray (Gleam Only; 3/Day)
actions.description: Ranged Spell Attack +5 to hit, range 60 ft., one creature. 12 (2d8 + 3) radiant damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or be transformed into a bat for 1 minute, as though affected by a polymorph spell. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

actions.name: Sun Ray (Glister Only; 3/Day)
actions.description: Ranged Spell Attack +5 to hit, range 60 ft., one creature. 12 (2d8 + 3) radiant damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or be blinded for 1 minute. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

actions.name: Twin Sight (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
actions.description: In her mind's eye, a Selenelion twin can see what the other twin sees for up to 1 minute, provided both twins are alive and on the same plane of existence. Maintaining this effect requires concentration (as if concentrating on a spell).

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The marshal makes three attacks, using Longsword or Pistol in any combination.

actions.name: Longsword
actions.description: m +7, reach 5 ft. 13 (2d8 + 4) Slashing damage, and the target has Disadvantage on the next attack roll it makes before the start of the marshal's next turn.

actions.name: Pistol
actions.description: r +7, range 30/90 ft. 15 (2d10 + 4) Piercing damage.

spellcasting.name: Shield (3/Day)
spellcasting.header: The marshal casts Shield in response to the spell's trigger, using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability.

traits.name: Cold Regeneration

His current quarry is a dwarf brigand, Worvil "the Weevil" Forkbeard, who is rumored to be hiding in Icewind Dale. In addition to his gear, Sir Baric has an unarmored warhorse, Henry. Ideal: "Evil must not be allowed to thrive in this world." Bond: "Tyr is my lord; the order, my family. Through my actions, I shall honor both." Flaw: "I'm not afraid to die. When Tyr finally calls me, I'll go to him happily."

actions.name: Longsword

The misbegotten son of Artus Cimber, a renowned human adventurer, Sirac hasn't seen his father since he was a baby. Ideal: "Without duty or loyalty, a man is nothing." Bond: "Icewind Dale is where i belong for the rest of my life." Flaw: "I am honest to a fault."

bonus_actions.description: The spiderdragon spins a 30-foot cube of strong, sticky webbing in an area adjacent to itself. The webbing lasts for 1 minute, is difficult terrain, and lightly obscures its area. A creature that starts its turn in the webbing or enters the webbing for the first time on its turn must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or have the restrained condition while in the web. As an action, a creature can free itself or another creature from the web by succeeding on a DC 15 Strength check. A 5-foot cube of the web is destroyed if it takes at least 10 acid, fire, or slashing damage on a single turn.

name: Spiked Tomb Guardian
languages: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

traits.name: Berserk
traits.description: Whenever the tomb guardian starts its turn with 40 hit points or fewer, roll a d6. On a 6, the tomb guardian goes berserk. On each of its turns while berserk, the tomb guardian attacks the nearest creature it can see. If no creature is near enough to move to and attack, the tomb guardian attacks an object, with preference for an object smaller than itself. Once the tomb guardian goes berserk, it continues to do so until it is destroyed or regains all its hit points. The golem's creator, if within 60 feet of the berserk tomb guardian, can try to calm it by speaking firmly and persuasively. The tomb guardian must be able to hear its creator, who must take an action to make a DC 15 Charisma (Persuasion) check. If the check succeeds, the tomb guardian ceases being berserk. If it takes damage while still at 40 hit points or fewer, the tomb guardian might go berserk again.

traits.name: Aversion of Fire
traits.description: If the tomb guardian takes fire damage, it has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks until the end of its next turn.

traits.name: Immutable Form
traits.description: The tomb guardian is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

traits.name: Lightning Absorption
traits.description: Whenever the tomb guardian is subjected to lightning damage, it takes no damage and instead regains a number of hit points equal to the lightning damage dealt.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The tomb guardian has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Magic Weapons
traits.description: The golem's weapon attacks are magical.

traits.name: Chained
traits.description: This trait applies when two guardians are chained together. A magical spiked chain that binds a pair of guardians together prevents them from moving more than 15 feet apart. Additionally, as long as the chain is intact, damage dealt to either guardian is divided evenly between them. The spiked chain can be attacked separately and has AC 18, a damage threshold of 10, 5 hit points, and immunity to poison and psychic damage. If the chain breaks, both tomb guardians instantly go berserk.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The tomb guardian makes two spiked gauntlet attacks.

actions.name: Spiked Gauntlet
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus 9 (2d6) piercing damage.

traits.name: Flyby
traits.description: The devil doesn't provoke an Opportunity Attack when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The devil has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The devil makes two attacks, using Infernal Fork and Tail Spine in any combination.

actions.name: Infernal Fork
actions.description: m +4, reach 5 ft. 5 (1d6 + 2) Piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) Fire damage.

actions.name: Tail Spine
actions.description: r +4, range 20/80 ft. 4 (1d4 + 2) Piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) Fire damage.

actions.name: Rend
actions.description: m +4, reach 5 ft. 9 (2d6 + 2) Slashing damage plus 3 (1d6) Necrotic damage.

actions.name: Ruinous Breath {@recharge 5}
actions.description: con DC 12, each creature in a 15-foot Cone [Area of Effect]. 13 (3d8) Necrotic damage. Half damage.

actions.name: Time-Warping Breath
actions.description: wis DC 12, each creature that isn't currently affected by this breath in a 15-foot Cone [Area of Effect]. The target's Speed is halved, it can't take Reactions, and it can take either an action or a Bonus Action on its turn, not both. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. After 1 minute, it succeeds automatically.

traits.name: Fiendish Restoration
traits.description: If it dies, the naga returns to life in 1d6 days and regains all its Hit Points. Only a Wish spell can prevent this trait from functioning.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The naga makes three attacks, using Bite or Necrotic Ray in any combination.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: m +7, reach 10 ft. 7 (1d6 + 4) Piercing damage plus 14 (4d6) Poison damage.

actions.name: Necrotic Ray
actions.description: r +6, range 60 ft. 21 (6d6) Necrotic damage.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.header: The naga casts one of the following spells, requiring no Somatic or Material components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 14):

name: Spirit Statue Mascot
languages: any languages it knew in life

traits.name: Death Burst
traits.description: When the spirit statue is reduced to 0 hit points, the statue crumbles, and the spirit returns to the afterlife in a burst of ghostly white flame. Each creature within 5 feet of it must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or take 3 (1d6) radiant damage.

actions.name: Slam
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 5 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Counsel of the Past (2/Day)
actions.description: The spirit statue touches one creature. Once within the next 10 minutes, that creature can roll a d4 and add the number rolled to one ability check of its choice, immediately after rolling the d20.

traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
traits.description: The troll can move through other creatures and objects as if they were 3. It takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.description: The troll regains 10 hit points at the start of each of its turns. If the troll takes psychic or force damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of the troll's next turn. The troll dies only if it starts its turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The troll makes one Bite attack and two Claw attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. 19 (3d10 + 3) psychic damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or be stunned for 1 minute. The stunned target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

actions.name: Claws
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. 19 (3d10 + 3) psychic damage.

traits.name: Shapechanger
traits.description: The mimic can use its action to polymorph into an object or back into its true, amorphous form. Its statistics are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

traits.name: Adhesive (Object Form Only)
traits.description: The mimic adheres to anything that touches it. A Huge or smaller creature adhered to the mimic is also grappled by it (escape DC 16). Ability checks made to escape this grapple have disadvantage.

traits.name: False Appearance (Object Form Only)
traits.description: While the mimic remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from an ordinary object.

traits.name: Grappler
traits.description: The mimic has advantage on attack rolls against any creature grappled by it.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The mimic has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The mimic attacks three times: twice with its pseudopods and once with its bite.

actions.name: Pseudopods
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 10 (1d10 + 5) bludgeoning damage. If the mimic is in object form, the target is subjected to its Adhesive trait.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. 10 (1d10 + 5) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) acid damage.

actions.name: Spit Acid {@recharge 5}
actions.description: The mimic spits acid at one creature it can see within 30 feet of it. The target must make a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw, taking 32 (9d6 + 1) acid damage on failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

traits.name: Defensive Advantage
traits.description: As long as two or more of Splugoth's allies are within 5 feet of him and are not incapacitated, attack rolls against him are made with disadvantage.

traits.name: Nimble Escape
traits.description: Splugoth can take the Disengage or Hide action as a bonus action on each of his turns.

traits.name: Touch of Madness
traits.description: Splugoth has advantage on saving throws against being charmed or frightened.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Splugoth makes two attacks with his dagger.

actions.name: Dagger
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 4 (1d4 + 2) slashing damage.

actions.name: Word From Beyond (1/Day)
actions.description: Splugoth remembers and repeats aloud a few words from a place he entered while walking back from the next world to this one. Each creature of his choice within 30 feet of him that can hear him must succeed on a DC 12 Wisdom saving throw or be stunned until the end of its next turn.

reactions.name: Absorb Attack
reactions.description: When a creature Splugoth can see hits him with a melee weapon attack, the weapon snags on a pocket of residual resurrectional energy and is caught fast. The attack is negated and the weapon cannot be used until the creature succeeds on a DC 12 Strength (Athletics) check as an action to pull it out of Splugoth. Natural weapons can have their attacks negated by this feature, but can then be retracted automatically at the end of the attacking creature's turn.

traits.name: Hold Breath
traits.description: While out of water, the octopus can hold its breath for 1 hour.

traits.name: Water Breathing
traits.description: The octopus can breathe only underwater.

actions.name: Tentacles
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +5 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target 7 (1d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage.

traits.name: Explosive Core
traits.description: When the spore is subjected to Fire damage, each creature in a 5-foot Emanation [Area of Effect] originating from the spore takes 7 (2d6) Fire damage.

traits.name: Rolling Mass
traits.description: The spore doesn't need to expend extra movement to move through Difficult Terrain.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The spore makes four Tendril attacks. Alternatively, it makes two Tendril attacks and uses Consume once.

actions.name: Tendril
actions.description: m +10, reach 20 ft. 11 (1d10 + 6) Piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) Acid damage. If the target is Large or smaller, the spore pulls the target 5 feet straight toward itself.

actions.name: Consume
actions.description: str DC 18, one Large or smaller creature within 5 feet. The target is pulled into the spore's space and has the Grappled condition (escape DC 16). Until the grapple ends, the target has the Blinded and Restrained conditions, and it takes 17 (5d6) Acid damage at the start of each of the spore's turns. When the spore moves, the Grappled target moves with it, costing it no extra movement. The spore can have one Large creature or up to nine Medium or smaller creatures Grappled at a time.

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.description: The lion has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the lion's allies is within 5 feet of the target and the ally doesn't have the incapacitated condition.

actions.name: Rend
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 15 (2d8 + 6) piercing damage. If the lion moved at least 20 feet straight toward the target immediately before the hit, the target must succeed on a DC 16 Strength saving throw or have the prone condition. If the target has the prone condition, the lion can make another Rend attack against it as a bonus action.

traits.name: Joyful Presence
traits.description: Any non-eladrin creature that starts its turn within 60 feet of the eladrin must make a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the creature becomes charmed by the eladrin for 1 minute. On a successful save, the creature becomes immune to any eladrin's Joyful Presence for 24 hours. Whenever the eladrin deals damage to the charmed creature, the charmed creature can repeat the saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The eladrin has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The eladrin makes two Longsword or Longbow attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Spellcasting.

actions.name: Longsword
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 6 (1d8 + 2) slashing damage, or 7 (1d10 + 2) slashing damage if used with two hands, plus 22 (5d8) psychic damage.

actions.name: Longbow
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack +7 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage plus 22 (5d8) psychic damage.

bonus_actions.name: Fey Step {@recharge 4}
bonus_actions.description: The eladrin teleports, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.header: The eladrin casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 16):

actions.name: Needle Sword
actions.description: m +6, reach 5 ft. 6 (1d4 + 4) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Enchanting Bow
actions.description: r +6, range 40/160 ft. 1 Piercing damage, and the target has the Charmed condition until the start of the sprite's next turn.

actions.name: Heart Sight
actions.description: cha DC 10, one creature within 5 feet the sprite can see (Celestials, Fiends, and Undead automatically fail the save). The sprite knows the target's emotions and alignment.

spellcasting.name: Invisibility
spellcasting.header: The sprite casts Invisibility on itself, requiring no spell components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability.

actions.name: Needle Sword
actions.description: m +6, reach 5 ft. 6 (1d4 + 4) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Enchanting Bow
actions.description: r +6, range 40/160 ft. 1 Piercing damage, and the target has the Charmed condition until the start of the sprite's next turn.

actions.name: Heart Sight
actions.description: cha DC 10, one creature within 5 feet the sprite can see (Celestials, Fiends, Undead automatically fail the save). The sprite knows the target's emotions.

actions.name: Invisibility
actions.description: The sprite has the Invisible condition for 1 minute. This effect ends early immediately after the sprite makes an attack roll or deals damage, or if the sprite has the Incapacitated condition.

actions.name: Shortsword
actions.description: m +4, reach 5 ft. 5 (1d6 + 2) Piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) Poison damage.

actions.name: Hand Crossbow
actions.description: r +4, range 30/120 ft. 5 (1d6 + 2) Piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) Poison damage.

bonus_actions.name: Cunning Action
bonus_actions.description: The spy takes the Dash, Disengage, or Hide action.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The spy makes three attacks, using Rapier or Hand Crossbow in any combination.

actions.name: Rapier
actions.description: m +9, reach 5 ft. 14 (2d8 + 5) Piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) Poison damage.

actions.name: Hand Crossbow
actions.description: r +9, range 30/120 ft. 12 (2d6 + 5) Piercing damage plus 9 (2d8) Poison damage.

actions.name: Smoke Bomb (1/Day)
actions.description: The spy throws a bomb to a point it can see within 30 feet of itself. con DC 16, each creature in a 20-foot-radius Sphere [Area of Effect] centered on that point. 28 (8d6) Poison damage, and the target has the Blinded condition until the end of the spy's next turn. Half damage only.

bonus_actions.name: Cunning Action
bonus_actions.description: The spy takes the Dash, Disengage, or Hide action.

actions.name: Longsword
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 5 (1d8 + 1) slashing damage, or 6 (1d10 + 1) slashing damage if used with two hands.

bonus_actions.name: Shove
bonus_actions.description: While wielding a shield, you try to shove one creature within 5 feet of you.

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.description: If Squirt is motionless at the start of combat, it has advantage on its initiative roll. Moreover, if a creature hasn't observed Squirt move or act, that creature must succeed on a DC 18 Intelligence (Investigation) check to discern that Squirt is animate.

traits.name: Unusual Nature
traits.description: Squirt doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

actions.name: Slam
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 4 (1d4 + 2) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Boggle Oil (3 Applications)
actions.description: Squirt expends 1 application of boggle oil to create a 10-foot-square puddle of slippery, non-flammable oil on the ground within 5 feet of it. The puddle is 3 and lasts for 1 hour. Each creature that enters the puddle's area or starts its turn there must succeed on a DC 11 Dexterity saving throw or fall prone. Boggles are unaffected by the oil. After it expends all 3 applications, Squirt can't use this action again until its supply of boggle oil is replenished.

traits.name: Aura of Madness
traits.description: Any creature (other than Undead or Constructs) that ends its turn within 10 feet of Ssendam must succeed on a DC 20 Charisma saving throw or be inflicted with a random short-term madness. If a creature succeeds against any madness ability of Ssendam's, they are immune to Ssendam's madness for 1 hour.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.description: If Ssendam fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: Ssendam has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Magic Weapons
traits.description: Ssendam's weapon attacks are magical.

traits.name: Regeneration (Golden Amoeba Form Only)
traits.description: Ssendam regains 40 hit points at the start of her turn if she has at least 1 hit point.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Ssendam makes three attacks: one with her Touch of Madness and two with her Chaos Staff.

actions.name: Touch of Madness
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 10 (1d10 + 5) slashing damage plus 11 (2d10) necrotic damage. A target that fails a DC 20 Charisma saving throw is inflicted with a random short-term madness. If it is already mad, the existing madness is replaced with a random long-term madness.

actions.name: Chaos Staff
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 12 (2d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage plus 11 (2d10) necrotic damage. The target must succeed on a DC 19 Constitution saving throw or have the stunned condition for 1 minute. The target may repeat the saving throw at the end of each of their turns, ending the effect on a success.

actions.name: Summon Slaadi (1/Day)
actions.description: Ssendam summons 1d4 + 1 death slaadi. A summoned slaad appears in an unoccupied space within 60 feet of Ssendam, acts as an ally of Ssendam, and can't summon other slaadi. It remains for 1 minute, until it or Ssendam dies, or until Ssendam dismisses it as an action.

actions.name: Teleport
actions.description: Ssendam magically teleports, along with any equipment she is wearing or carrying, up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space she can see.

bonus_actions.name: Change Shape
bonus_actions.description: Ssendam polymorphs into a Small or Medium-sized Humanoid, into a Small Aberration that looks like a golden amoeba, or back into this, her golden slaad form. Any equipment she is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. She reverts to her true form if she dies. Her statistics in the Humanoid forms, other than her size, are the same. While in her amoeba form, Ssendam also has the same statistics with the following changes. She can't take any actions (except her Change Shape action), speak, or manipulate objects. She has a movement speed of 40 feet and can enter a hostile creature's space and stop there. In addition, Ssendam can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing. She has advantage on Strength and Dexterity saving throws, and has resistance to all damage except psychic and radiant.

reactions.name: Amoeba
reactions.description: When damaged, Ssendam uses her reaction to activate Change Shape to transform into her golden amoeba form. Doing this reduces the damage to 0.

legendary_actions.name: Chaos Staff
legendary_actions.description: Ssendam makes one Chaos Staff attack.

legendary_actions.name: Teleport
legendary_actions.description: Ssendam uses her Teleport action.

legendary_actions.name: Subversion (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.description: Ssendam forces every creature suffering from madness within 60 feet of her to use their reaction to attack another creature within 5 feet of them.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.header: Ssendam casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 23):

traits.name: Hold Breath
traits.description: The ssurran can hold its breath for 15 minutes.

traits.name: Intellect Fortress
traits.description: The ssurran's AC includes its Intelligence modifier.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The ssurran makes two Claw attacks and uses Defile (if available).

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 4 (1d6 + 1) slashing damage plus 4 (1d8) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Defile {@recharge}
actions.description: Ordinary vegetation within 10 feet of the ssurran withers and dies. In addition, each creature within 10 feet of the ssurran must make a DC 11 Constitution saving throw, taking 22 (4d10) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The ssurran regains 5 (1d10) hit points for each creature that fails the saving throw.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting (Psionics)
spellcasting.header: The ssurran casts one of the following spells, requiring no spell components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability:

traits.name: Hold Breath
traits.description: The ssurran can hold its breath for 15 minutes.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The ssurran makes two Claw attacks.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 4 (1d6 + 1) slashing damage.

actions.name: Javelin
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack +3 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft., one target. 4 (1d6 + 1) piercing damage plus 4 (1d8) poison damage.

actions.name: Poison Bomb
actions.description: The ssurran throws a tangerine-sized bomb at a point up to 60 feet away, where it explodes, releasing a 10-foot-radius sphere of poisonous gas that disperses quickly. Each creature in the sphere must make a DC 11 Constitution saving throw, taking 10 (3d6) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. After the ssurran throws a bomb, roll a d6; on a roll of 4 or lower, the ssurran has no more bombs to throw.

traits.name: Labyrinthine Recall
traits.description: The stalker can perfectly recall any path it has traveled.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The stalker has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The stalker makes two Glaive attacks or two Rock attacks.

actions.name: Glaive
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +11 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. 18 (2d10 + 7) slashing damage plus 9 (2d8) force damage.
