actions.name: Sting
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage plus 14 (4d6) poison damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 1 minute. If it fails the saving throw by 5 or more, the target is also paralyzed while poisoned. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

name: Tloques-Popolocas
languages: the languages it knew in life

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.description: The vampire regains 10 hit points at the start of its turn if it has at least 1 hit point and isn't in sunlight or running water. If the vampire takes radiant damage or damage from holy water, this trait doesn't function at the start of the vampire's next turn.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.description: The vampire can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

traits.name: Vampire Weaknesses
traits.description: The vampire has the following flaws: Forbiddance. The vampire can't enter a residence without an invitation from one of the occupants. Harmed by Running Water. The vampire takes 20 acid damage when it ends its turn in running water. Stake to the Heart. The vampire is destroyed if a piercing weapon made of wood is driven into its heart while it is incapacitated in its resting place. Sunlight Hypersensitivity. The vampire takes 20 radiant damage when it starts its turn in sunlight. While in sunlight, it has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks.

traits.name: Shapechanger
traits.description: If the vampire isn't in sunlight or running water, it can use its action to Polymorph into a Tiny bat, or back into its true form. While in bat form, the vampire can't speak, its walking speed is 5 feet, and it has a flying speed of 30 feet. Its Statistics, other than its size and speed, are unchanged. Anything it is wearing transforms with it, but nothing it is carrying does. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The vampire makes two attacks.

actions.name: Claws
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. 8 (2d4 + 3) slashing damage. Instead of dealing damage, the vampire can grapple the target, escape DC 13.

actions.name: Children of the Night (1/Day)
actions.description: The vampire magically calls 2d4 swarms of bats, provided that the sun isn't up. The called creatures arrive in 1d4 rounds, acting as allies of the vampire and obeying its spoken commands. The beasts remain for 1 hour, until the vampire dies, or until the vampire dismisses them as a bonus action.

actions.name: Tloques' Berserker Axe +2
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 9 (1d8 + 5) slashing damage.

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
spellcasting.header: Tloques can cast hold person (DC 14) at will, requiring no components, but his target must be able to see him.

name: Tomb Dwarf
languages: the languages it knew in life

traits.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
traits.description: While in sunlight, the tomb dwarf has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The tomb dwarf makes two longsword attacks or two crossbow attacks. It can use its Life Drain in place of one longsword attack.

actions.name: Life Drain
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. 5 (1d6 + 2) necrotic damage. The target must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or its hit point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the damage taken. This reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest. The target dies if this effect reduces its hit point maximum to 0.A humanoid slain by this attack rises 24 hours later as a zombie under the tomb dwarf's control, unless the humanoid is restored to life or its body is destroyed. The tomb dwarf can have no more than twelve zombies under its control at one time.

actions.name: Battleaxe
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 6 (1d8 + 2) slashing damage, or 7 (1d10 + 2) slashing damage if used with two hands.

actions.name: Light Crossbow
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack +4 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage.

name: Tomb Guardian
languages: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

traits.name: Berserk
traits.description: Whenever the tomb guardian starts its turn with 40 hit points or fewer, roll a d6. On a 6, the tomb guardian goes berserk. On each of its turns while berserk, the tomb guardian attacks the nearest creature it can see. If no creature is near enough to move to and attack, the tomb guardian attacks an object, with preference for an object smaller than itself. Once the tomb guardian goes berserk, it continues to do so until it is destroyed or regains all its hit points. The golem's creator, if within 60 feet of the berserk tomb guardian, can try to calm it by speaking firmly and persuasively. The tomb guardian must be able to hear its creator, who must take an action to make a DC 15 Charisma (Persuasion) check. If the check succeeds, the tomb guardian ceases being berserk. If it takes damage while still at 40 hit points or fewer, the tomb guardian might go berserk again.

traits.name: Aversion of Fire
traits.description: If the tomb guardian takes fire damage, it has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks until the end of its next turn.

traits.name: Immutable Form
traits.description: The tomb guardian is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

traits.name: Lightning Absorption
traits.description: Whenever the tomb guardian is subjected to lightning damage, it takes no damage and instead regains a number of hit points equal to the lightning damage dealt.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The tomb guardian has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Magic Weapons
traits.description: The golem's weapon attacks are magical.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The tomb guardian makes two slam attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

name: Tomb Tapper
languages: understands Common and Undercommon but doesn't speak

traits.name: Petrified Death
traits.description: A tomb tapper reduced to 0 hit points turns into a lifeless stone statue. Anything it's wearing or carrying is not transformed.

traits.name: Sense Magic
traits.description: The tomb tapper senses magic within 30 feet of it and can use an action to pinpoint the location of any creature, object, or area in that range that bears magic. This sense penetrates barriers but is blocked by a thin sheet of lead.

traits.name: Tunneler
traits.description: The tomb tapper can burrow through solid rock at half its burrowing speed and leaves a 10-foot-wide, 20-foot-tall tunnel in its wake.

traits.name: Unusual Nature
traits.description: The tomb tapper doesn't require air or sleep.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The tomb tapper makes two melee attacks with its sledgehammer or with its claws. If it hits the same creature with both claws, it can pull that creature within 5 feet of its mouth and make a bite attack against it.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 22 (3d10 + 6) slashing damage.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 16 (3d6 + 6) slashing damage.

actions.name: Sledgehammer
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack +10 to hit, reach 15 ft. or range 30/120 ft., one target. 27 (6d6 + 6) bludgeoning or force damage (tomb tapper's choice). If thrown, the hammer returns to the tomb tapper at the end of its turn, landing at the tomb tapper's feet if it doesn't have a hand free to catch the weapon.

name: Tooth-N-Claw
languages: understands Infernal but can't speak it

traits.name: Keen Hearing and Smell
traits.description: Tooth-N-Claw has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or smell.

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.description: Tooth-N-Claw has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of its allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) cold damage.

actions.name: Freezing Breath {@recharge 5}
actions.description: Tooth-N-Claw exhales an icy blast in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw, taking 21 (6d6) cold damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.description: The dragon can breathe both air and water.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 7 (1d10 + 2) piercing damage plus 2 (1d4) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Desiccating Breath {@recharge 5}
actions.description: The dragon exhales yellowish necrotic energy in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 11 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 21 (6d6) necrotic damage and is weakened until the end of its next turn. A weakened creature has disadvantage on Strength-based ability checks and Strength saving throws, and the creature's weapon attacks that rely on Strength deal half damage. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage and isn't weakened.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting (Psionics)
spellcasting.header: The dragon casts one of the following spells, requiring no spell components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 12):

traits.name: Gem Awakening (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
traits.description: If the greatwyrm would be reduced to 0 hit points, its current hit point total instead resets to 400 hit points, it recharges its Breath Weapon, and it regains any expended uses of Legendary Resistance. Additionally, the greatwyrm can now use its Mass Telekinesis action during the next hour. Award a party an additional 90,000 XP (180,000 XP total) for defeating the greatwyrm after its Gem Awakening activates.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (4/Day)
traits.description: If the greatwyrm fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Unusual Nature
traits.description: The greatwyrm doesn't require food or drink.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The greatwyrm makes one Bite attack and two Claw attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +17 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. 20 (2d10 + 9) piercing damage plus 16 (3d10) force damage.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +17 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 18 (2d8 + 9) slashing damage. If the target is a Huge or smaller creature, it is grappled (escape DC 19) and is restrained until this grapple ends. The greatwyrm can have only one creature grappled in this way at a time.

actions.name: Breath Weapon {@recharge 5}
actions.description: The greatwyrm exhales crushing force in a 300-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 25 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 71 (11d12) force damage and is knocked prone. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage and isn't knocked prone. On a success or failure, the creature's speed becomes 0 until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Mass Telekinesis (Gem Awakening Only; Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
actions.description: The greatwyrm targets any number of creatures and objects it can see within 120 feet of it. No one target can weigh more than 4,000 pounds, and objects can't be targeted if they're being worn or carried. Each targeted creature must succeed on a DC 26 Strength saving throw or be restrained in the greatwyrm's telekinetic grip. At the end of a creature's turn, it can repeat the saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success. At the end of the greatwyrm's turn, it can move each creature or object it has in its telekinetic grip up to 60 feet in any direction, but not beyond 120 feet of itself. In addition, it can choose any number of creatures restrained in this way and deal 45 (7d12) force damage to each of them.

bonus_actions.name: Change Shape
bonus_actions.description: The greatwyrm magically transforms into any creature that is Medium or Small, while retaining its game statistics (other than its size). This transformation ends if the greatwyrm is reduced to 0 hit points or uses a bonus action to end it.

bonus_actions.name: Psychic Step
bonus_actions.description: The greatwyrm magically teleports to an unoccupied space it can see within 60 feet of it.

legendary_actions.name: Claw
legendary_actions.description: The greatwyrm makes one Claw attack.

legendary_actions.name: Psionics (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.description: The greatwyrm uses Psychic Step or Spellcasting.

legendary_actions.name: Psychic Beam (Costs 3 Actions)
legendary_actions.description: The greatwyrm emits a beam of psychic energy in a 90-foot line that is 10 feet wide. Each creature in that area must make a DC 26 Intelligence saving throw, taking 27 (5d10) psychic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting (Psionics)
spellcasting.header: The greatwyrm casts one of the following spells, requiring no spell components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 26, +18 to hit with spell attack):

name: Topi
languages: understands the languages it knew in life but can't speak

traits.name: Turn Resistance
traits.description: The topi has advantage on saving throws against any effect that turns undead.

traits.name: Undead Fortitude
traits.description: If damage reduces the topi to 0 hit points, it must make a Constitution saving throw with a DC of 5+the damage taken, unless the damage is radiant or from a critical hit. On a success, the topi drops to 1 hit point instead.

actions.name: Venomous Claws
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 4 (1d4 + 2) slashing damage plus 2 (1d4) poison damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 11 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned until the end of the target's next turn.

traits.name: Goring Rush
traits.description: Immediately after using the Dash action, Torogar can make one melee attack with his horns.

traits.name: Labyrinthine Recall
traits.description: Torogar can perfectly recall any path he has traveled.

traits.name: Rage (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
traits.description: As a bonus action, Torogar can enter a rage that lasts for 1 minute. The rage ends early if Torogar is knocked unconscious or if his turn ends and he hasn't attacked a hostile creature or taken damage since his last turn. While raging, Torogar gains the following benefits: He has advantage on Strength checks and Strength saving throws. He deals an extra 3 damage when he hits a target with a melee weapon attack. He has resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage.

traits.name: Special Equipment
traits.description: Torogar wears gauntlets of flaming fury and a belt of fire giant strength. Without the belt, his Strength is 21. He also carries a soul coin.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Torogar makes three attacks: two with his scimitars and one with his horns.

actions.name: Scimitar
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 14 (2d6 + 7) slashing damage, or 17 (2d6 + 10) slashing damage while raging, plus 3 (1d6) fire damage from the gauntlets of flaming fury.

actions.name: Horns
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 16 (2d8 + 7) piercing damage, or 19 (2d8 + 10) piercing damage while raging.

traits.name: Hold Breath
traits.description: The tortle can hold its breath for 1 hour.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 4 (1d4 + 2) slashing damage.

actions.name: Spear
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage, or 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage if used with two hands in melee.

actions.name: Light Crossbow
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack +2 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. 4 (1d8) piercing damage.

actions.name: Shell Defense
actions.description: The tortle withdraws into its shell. Until it emerges, it gains a +4 bonus to AC and has advantage on Strength and Constitution saving throws. While in its shell, the tortle is prone, its speed is 0 and can't increase, it has disadvantage on Dexterity saving throws, it can't take reactions, and the only action it can take is a bonus action to emerge.

traits.name: Hold Breath
traits.description: The tortle can hold its breath for 1 hour.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The tortle makes four Claw attacks or two Nature's Wrath attacks.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 4 (1d4 + 2) slashing damage.

actions.name: Nature's Wrath
actions.description: Ranged Spell Attack +4 to hit, range 90 ft., one target. 9 (2d6 + 2) damage of a type chosen by the tortle: cold, fire, lightning, or thunder.

actions.name: Shell Defense
actions.description: The tortle withdraws into its shell. Until it emerges, it gains a +4 bonus to AC and has advantage on Strength and Constitution saving throws. While in its shell, the tortle is prone, its speed is 0 and can't increase, it has disadvantage on Dexterity saving throws, it can't take reactions, and the only action it can take is a bonus action to emerge.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.header: The tortle casts one of the following spells, using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 12):

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.description: The tough has Advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the tough's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally doesn't have the Incapacitated condition.

actions.name: Mace
actions.description: m +4, reach 5 ft. 5 (1d6 + 2) Bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Heavy Crossbow
actions.description: r +3, range 100/400 ft. 6 (1d10 + 1) Piercing damage.

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.description: The tough has Advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the tough's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally doesn't have the Incapacitated condition.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The tough makes two attacks, using Warhammer or Heavy Crossbow in any combination.

actions.name: Warhammer
actions.description: m +5, reach 5 ft. 12 (2d8 + 3) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, the tough pushes the target up to 10 feet straight away from itself.

actions.name: Heavy Crossbow
actions.description: r +4, range 100/400 ft. 13 (2d10 + 2) Piercing damage.

traits.name: Unarmored Defense
traits.description: While the tower hand is wearing no armor and wielding no shield, its AC includes its Wisdom modifier.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The tower hand makes two Unarmed Strike attacks, two Dart attacks, or one of each.

actions.name: Unarmed Strike
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 5 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Dart
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack +4 to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.

reactions.name: Deflect Missile
reactions.description: In response to being hit by a ranged weapon attack, the tower hand deflects the missile. The damage it takes from the attack is reduced by 7 (1d10 + 2).

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The tower sage makes two Arcane Burst attacks and can use Starry Radiance if available.

actions.name: Arcane Burst
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Spell Attack +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft., one target. 8 (1d10 + 3) radiant damage.

actions.name: Starry Radiance {@recharge 5}
actions.description: Dazzling light bursts from the tower sage's fingertips in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that area must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or have the blinded condition until the end of the tower sage's next turn.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.header: The tower sage casts one of the following spells, using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 13):

traits.name: Blood Frenzy
traits.description: The draconian has advantage on melee attack rolls against any creature that doesn't have all its hit points.

traits.name: Controlled Fall
traits.description: If the draconian falls and isn't incapacitated, it subtracts up to 50 feet from the fall when calculating the fall's damage.

traits.name: Death Throes
traits.description: If the draconian is reduced to 0 hit points, its body erupts into sludge that fills a 10-foot-radius sphere. Each creature within that area must succeed on a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw or be covered in the sludge for 1 minute. While covered in the sludge, a creature's speed is halved. A creature can use its action to scrape the sludge off itself or another creature within 5 feet of itself.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The draconian makes two Claw attacks.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 14 (2d8 + 5) slashing damage.

actions.name: Flaming Carnage {@recharge 5}
actions.description: The draconian indulges its rage, wreathing itself in fire and moving up to its speed. The draconian can enter creatures' spaces during this move. During this movement, when the draconian enters a creature's space, the creature must make a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 22 (4d10) fire damage and is knocked prone. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage and is pushed to the nearest space out of the draconian's path. A creature can be affected by this draconian's Flaming Carnage only once during a turn.

reactions.name: Violent Retaliation
reactions.description: If a creature within 10 feet of the draconian hits it with an attack, the draconian can make one Claw attack against that creature. If the Claw attack hits, it deals an additional 4 (1d8) slashing damage.

traits.name: Instinctive Reflexes
traits.description: The conduit has advantage on initiative rolls, and it can't have disadvantage on attack rolls.

traits.name: Unarmored Defense
traits.description: While the conduit is wearing no armor and wielding no shield, its AC includes its Wisdom modifier.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The conduit makes three Unarmed Strike attacks.

actions.name: Unarmed Strike
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, the conduit can choose one of the following additional effects (up to once per turn each): Incapacitate. The target must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or have the incapacitated condition until the end of the conduit's next turn. Push. The target is pushed up to 10 feet horizontally away from the conduit.

reactions.name: Deflect Attack
reactions.description: In response to being hit by an attack roll, the conduit partially deflects the blow. The damage the conduit takes from the attack is reduced by 1d10.

reactions.name: Don't Be There
reactions.description: When the conduit must make a saving throw, it can move up to half its speed without provoking opportunity attacks. If its new position moves it out of range or otherwise makes it impossible to be targeted by the effect, the conduit avoids the effect entirely.

traits.name: Unarmored Defense
traits.description: While the instinct is wearing no armor and wielding no shield, its AC includes its Wisdom modifier.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The instinct makes three Unarmed Strike attacks.

actions.name: Unarmed Strike
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 7 (1d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage.

reactions.name: Deflect Blow
reactions.description: In response to being hit by a melee attack roll, the instinct partially deflects the blow. The damage the instinct takes from the attack is reduced by 1d6.

traits.name: Transmuter's Stone
traits.description: The transmuter carries a magic stone it crafted that grants its bearer one of the following effects: Darkvision out to a range of 60 feet An extra 10 feet of speed while the bearer is unencumbered Proficiency with Constitution saving throws Resistance to acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder damage (transmuter's choice whenever the transmuter chooses this benefit) If the transmuter has the stone and casts a transmutation spell of 1st level or higher, it can change the effect of the stone.

actions.name: Quarterstaff
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 2 (1d6 - 1) bludgeoning damage, or 3 (1d8 - 1) bludgeoning damage if used with two hands.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.header: The transmuter is a 9th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save DC 14, +6 to hit with spell attacks). The transmuter has the following wizard spells prepared:

traits.name: Transmuter's Stone
traits.description: The transmuter carries a magic stone it crafted. The stone grants it one of the following benefits while bearing the stone; the transmuter chooses the benefit at the end of each long rest: Darkvision. The transmuter has darkvision out to a range of 60 feet. Resilience. The transmuter has proficiency in Constitution saving throws. Resistance. The transmuter has resistance to acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder damage (transmuter's choice whenever choosing this benefit). Speed. The transmuter's walking speed is increased by 10 feet.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The transmuter makes three Arcane Burst attacks.

actions.name: Arcane Burst
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Spell Attack +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft., one target. 19 (3d10 + 3) acid damage.

bonus_actions.name: Transmute {@recharge 4}
bonus_actions.description: The transmuter casts alter self or changes the benefit of Transmuter's Stone if bearing the stone.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.header: The transmuter casts one of the following spells, using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 14):

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.description: If the trapper is motionless on a floor, wall, or ceiling at the start of combat, it has advantage on its initiative roll. Moreover, if a creature hasn't observed the trapper move or act, that creature must succeed on a DC 18 Intelligence (Investigation) check to discern that the trapper isn't part of the floor, wall, or ceiling.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.description: The trapper can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

actions.name: Smother
actions.description: One Large or smaller creature within 10 feet of the trapper must succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw or be grappled (escape DC 14). Until the grapple ends, the target takes 13 (3d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage plus 3 (1d6) acid damage at the start of each of its turns. While grappled in this way, the target is restrained, blinded, and deprived of air. The trapper can smother only one creature at a time.

traits.name: Siege Monster
traits.description: The treant deals double damage to objects and structures.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The treant makes two Slam attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.description: m +10, reach 5 ft. 16 (3d6 + 6) Bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Hail of Bark
actions.description: r +10, range 180 ft. 28 (4d10 + 6) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Animate Trees (1/Day)
actions.description: The treant magically animates up to two trees it can see within 60 feet of itself. Each tree uses the Treant stat block, except it has Intelligence and Charisma scores of 1, it can't speak, and it lacks this action. The tree takes its turn immediately after the treant on the same Initiative count, and it obeys the treant. A tree remains animate for 1 day or until it dies, the treant dies, or it is more than 120 feet from the treant. The tree then takes root if possible.

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.description: If the treant is motionless at the start of combat, it has advantage on its initiative roll. Moreover, if a creature hasn't observed the treant move or act, that creature must succeed on a DC 18 Intelligence (Investigation) check to discern that the treant is animate.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The treant makes two Slam attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 8 (1d10 + 3) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Rock
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack +5 to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. 14 (2d10 + 3) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Animate Trees (1/Day)
actions.description: The treant magically animates one or two trees it can see within 60 feet of it. These trees have the same statistics as an awakened tree (see the Monster Manual), except they can't speak. An animated tree acts as an ally of the treant. The tree remains animate for 1 day or until it dies, until the treant dies or is more than 120 feet from the tree, or until the treant takes a bonus action to turn it back into an inanimate tree. The tree then takes root if possible.

name: Tree Blight
languages: understands Common and Druidic but can't speak

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The blight makes two Branch attacks and uses Grasping Root.

actions.name: Branch
actions.description: m +9, reach 15 ft. 16 (3d6 + 6) Bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Grasping Root
actions.description: str DC 17, one Large or smaller creature the blight can see within 15 feet. The target is pulled up to 10 feet straight toward the blight and has the Grappled condition (escape DC 16) from one of six roots. Until the grapple ends, the target takes 13 (2d6 + 6) Bludgeoning damage at the start of each of its turns.

bonus_actions.name: Gnash

actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +12 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 35 (8d6 + 7) piercing damage.

actions.name: Constrict
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +12 to hit, reach 15 ft., one Large or smaller creature. 17 (3d6 + 7) bludgeoning damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 19). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained and takes 17 (3d6 + 7) bludgeoning damage at the start of each of its turns. The typhon can have up to two creatures constricted.

actions.name: Maw
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +12 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 26 (3d12 + 7) piercing damage plus 19 (3d12) acid damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The tyrannosaurus makes one Bite attack and one Tail attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: m +10, reach 10 ft. 33 (4d12 + 7) Piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 17). While Grappled, the target has the Restrained condition and can't be targeted by the tyrannosaurus's Tail.

actions.name: Tail
actions.description: m +10, reach 15 ft. 25 (4d8 + 7) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Huge or smaller creature, it has the Prone condition.

traits.name: Disgorge Zombie
traits.description: As a bonus action, the tyrannosaurus zombie can disgorge a normal zombie, which appears in an unoccupied space within 10 feet of it. The disgorged zombie acts on its own initiative count. After a zombie is disgorged, roll a d6. On a roll of 1, the tyrannosaurus zombie runs out of zombies to disgorge and loses this trait. If the tyrannosaurus zombie still has this trait when it dies, 1d4 normal zombies erupt from its corpse at the start of its next turn. These zombies act on their own initiative count.

traits.name: Undead Fortitude
traits.description: If damage reduces the tyrannosaurus zombie to 0 hit points, it must make a Constitution saving throw with a DC of 5+the damage taken, unless the damage is radiant or from a critical hit. On a success, the zombie drops to 1 hit point instead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The tyrannosaurus zombie makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its tail. It can't make both attacks against the same target.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 33 (4d12 + 7) piercing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it is grappled (escape DC 17). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained and the tyrannosaurus zombie can't bite another target or disgorge zombies.

actions.name: Tail
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 20 (3d8 + 7) bludgeoning damage.

traits.name: Empath
traits.description: The shadow uses telepathy to sense nearby creatures. The shadow can see a creature if that creature has thoughts and is within the range of the shadow's telepathy. The shadow can't see creatures immune to telepathy.

traits.name: Undying Connection
traits.description: The shadow was originally spawned from a specific devil and, if the shadow is slain, it returns to life in 10 (1d20) days within 1 mile of that devil. The shadow is killed permanently only if its progenitor devil is slain first.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The shadow makes three Claw attacks. It can replace one of the attacks with Shadows of Death (if available).

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 16 (3d6 + 6) necrotic damage, plus 7 (2d6) psychic damage.

actions.name: Cloak of Shadows
actions.description: The shadow bends darkness around itself, and now has the invisible condition for 1 minute. The invisibility ends if the shadow is subjected to a Daylight spell or similar.

actions.name: Empathic Link
actions.description: The shadow attempts to form a link between itself and a creature it can see. The target must make a DC 19 Intelligence saving throw, taking 13 (2d12) psychic damage on a success. On a failed save, the creature and the shadow are linked. While linked, every time the shadow is damaged, the creature takes half of that damage as psychic damage. The creature may repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, taking 13 (2d12) psychic damage on a failed save, or ending the effect on a successful one.

actions.name: Shadows of Death {@recharge}
actions.description: The shadow discharges inky-black shadows in a 90-foot-radius sphere around itself. Creatures in the shadows must succeed on a DC 19 Wisdom saving throw or take 27 (6d8) necrotic damage and have the frightened condition for 1 minute. A frightened creature may repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a successful save, but taking the damage again on a failed save.

bonus_actions.name: Change Shape
bonus_actions.description: The shadow transforms into a Beast, Humanoid or Fiend that it has an Empathic Link with, or back into its true form. In a new form, the shadow retains its alignment, hit points, hit dice, telepathy, and Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores, as well as this action. Its statistics and capabilities are otherwise replaced by those of the new form, except any class features, lair actions, or legendary actions of that form.

legendary_actions.name: Shadow Blink
legendary_actions.description: The shadow surrounds itself in black mist, then teleports up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space that it can see.

legendary_actions.name: Shapeshift
legendary_actions.description: The shadow uses its Change Shape ability.

legendary_actions.name: Mind Spike (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.description: Ranged Spell Attack +11 to hit, range 300 ft., one target. 16 (2d10 + 5) psychic damage.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.description: If Tyreus fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Illusory Reality
traits.description: When Tyreus casts an illusion spell of 1st level or higher, he can choose one inanimate, nonmagical object that is part of the illusion and make that object real. He can do this on his turn as a bonus action while the spell is ongoing. The object remains real for 1 minute. The object can't deal damage or otherwise directly harm anyone.

traits.name: Displacement (Recharges after Tyreus Casts an Illusion Spell of 1st Level or Higher)
traits.description: As a bonus action, Tyreus projects an illusion that makes him appear to be standing a few inches from his actual location, causing any creature to have disadvantage on attack rolls against Tyreus. The effect ends if Tyreus takes damage, he is incapacitated, or his speed becomes 0.

actions.name: Dagger
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack +8 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Modify Illusion
actions.description: When Tyreus casts an illusion spell that has a duration of 1 minute or longer, he can use his action to change the nature of that illusion (using the spell's normal parameters for the illusion), provided that he can see the illusion.

legendary_actions.name: Scrutinize
legendary_actions.description: Tyreus makes an Intelligence (Investigation) or Wisdom (Perception) check.

legendary_actions.name: Cast Cantrip
legendary_actions.description: Tyreus casts a cantrip from his spell list.

legendary_actions.name: Cast Spell (Costs 1-3 Actions)
legendary_actions.description: Tyreus uses a spell slot to cast a 1st-, 2nd-, or 3rd-level spell that he has prepared. Doing so costs 1 legendary action per level of the spell.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.header: Tyreus is a 16th-level spellcaster. His spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save DC 18, +10 to hit with spell attacks). He has the following wizard spells prepared.

traits.name: Charge
traits.description: If the udaak moves at least 20 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a slam attack on the same turn, the target takes an extra 27 (6d8) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 21 Strength saving throw or be pushed up to 20 feet away from the udaak and knocked prone.

traits.name: Siege Monster
traits.description: The udaak deals double damage to objects and structures.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The udaak makes three attacks: one with its bite and two with its slam.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +13 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. 21 (2d12 + 8) piercing damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 21). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, and the udaak can't bite another target.

actions.name: Slam
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +13 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 21 (3d8 + 8) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Swallow
actions.description: The udaak makes one bite attack against a Large or smaller target it is grappling. If the attack hits, the target is also swallowed, and the grapple ends. A swallowed creature is blinded and restrained, it has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the udaak, and it takes 21 (6d6) acid damage at the start of each of the udaak's turns. If the udaak takes 30 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, the udaak must succeed on a DC 21 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, which fall prone in a space within 10 feet of the udaak. If the udaak dies, a swallowed creature is no longer restrained by it and can escape from the corpse by using 20 feet of movement, exiting prone.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Ulder makes three melee attacks, only one of which can be with his shield.

actions.name: +1 Longsword
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 8 (1d8 + 4) slashing damage, or 9 (1d10 + 4) slashing damage when used with two hands.

actions.name: Shield
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. 6 (1d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage, and Ulder pushes the target 5 feet away from him. Ulder then enters the space vacated by the target. If the target is pushed to within 5 feet of a creature friendly to Ulder, the target provokes an opportunity attack from that creature.

reactions.name: Guardian Strike
reactions.description: If an enemy within 5 feet of Ulder attacks a target other than him, Ulder can make a melee attack against that enemy.

traits.name: Creature Sense
traits.description: The ulitharid is aware of the presence of creatures within 2 miles of it that have an Intelligence score of 4 or higher. It knows the distance and direction to each creature, as well as each creature's intelligence score, but can't sense anything else about it. A creature protected by a mind blank spell, a nondetection spell, or similar magic can't be perceived in this manner.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The ulitharid has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Psionic Hub
traits.description: If an elder brain establishes a psychic link with the ulitharid, the elder brain can form a psychic link with any other creature the ulitharid can detect using its Creature Sense. Any such link ends if the creature falls outside the telepathy ranges of both the ulitharid and the elder brain. The ulitharid can maintain its psychic link with the elder brain regardless of the distance between them, so long as they are both on the same plane of existence. If the ulitharid is more than 5 miles away from the elder brain, it can end the psychic link at any time (no action required).

actions.name: Tentacles
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. 27 (4d10 + 5) psychic damage. If the target is Large or smaller, it is grappled (escape DC 14) and must succeed on a DC 17 Intelligence saving throw or be stunned until this grapple ends.

actions.name: Extract Brain
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one incapacitated Humanoid grappled by the ulitharid. 55 (10d10) piercing damage. If this damage reduces the target to 0 hit points, the ulitharid kills the target by extracting and devouring its brain.

actions.name: Mind Blast {@recharge 5}
actions.description: The ulitharid magically emits psychic energy in a 60-foot cone. Each creature in that area must succeed on a DC 17 Intelligence saving throw or take 31 (4d12 + 5) psychic damage and be stunned for 1 minute. A target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting (Psionics)
spellcasting.header: The ulitharid casts one of the following spells, requiring no spell components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 17):

traits.name: Fiendish Restoration
traits.description: If the ultroloth dies outside Gehenna, its body dissolves into ichor, and it gains a new body instantly, reviving with all its Hit Points somewhere in Gehenna.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The ultroloth has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The ultroloth uses Hypnotic Gaze and makes two Mercurial Whip attacks.

actions.name: Mercurial Whip
actions.description: m +9, reach 15 ft. 25 (6d6 + 4) Force damage, and the ultroloth can teleport the target up to 10 feet to an unoccupied space the ultroloth can see that isn't in the air.

actions.name: Hypnotic Gaze
actions.description: wis DC 17, each creature in a 30-foot Cone [Area of Effect]. 10 (3d6) Psychic damage, and the target has the Stunned condition until the start of the ultroloth's next turn. The target is immune to this ultroloth's Hypnotic Gaze for 24 hours.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.header: The ultroloth casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 17):

spellcasting.name: Fiendish Guile {@recharge 4}
spellcasting.header: The ultroloth casts Dispel Magic, Invisibility (self only), Misty Step, or Suggestion, requiring no Material components and using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

traits.name: Tunneler
traits.description: The umber hulk can burrow through solid rock at half its Burrow Speed and leaves a 10-foot-diameter tunnel in its wake.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The umber hulk makes three Rend attacks.

actions.name: Rend
actions.description: m +8, reach 10 ft. 12 (2d6 + 5) Slashing damage.

bonus_actions.name: Confusing Gaze {@recharge 5}
bonus_actions.description: wis DC 14, each creature in a 30-foot Cone [Area of Effect]. The target can't take Reactions until the start of the umber hulk's next turn, and the target rolls 1d8 to determine what it does on its next turn: 1-4. The target does nothing. 5-6. The target takes no action or Bonus Action and uses all its movement to move in a random direction. 7-8. The target makes a melee attack against a random creature within its reach or does nothing if it can't make such an attack.

traits.name: Fey Ancestry
traits.description: Magic can't put the shadow walker to sleep.

traits.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
traits.description: While in sunlight, the shadow walker has Disadvantage on ability checks and attack rolls.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The shadow walker makes three Gloom Burst attacks and uses Shadow Cowl.

actions.name: Gloom Burst
actions.description: m,r +9, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft. 14 (2d8 + 5) Psychic damage.

actions.name: Shadow Cowl
actions.description: wis DC 17, one creature the shadow walker can see within 120 feet. 14 (4d6) Necrotic damage, and the target has the Blinded condition until the start of the shadow walker's next turn.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.header: The shadow walker casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 17):

traits.name: Necrotic Absorption
traits.description: Whenever the shambling mound is subjected to necrotic damage, it takes no damage and regains a number of hit points equal to the necrotic damage dealt.

traits.name: Festering Aura (Putrid Only)
traits.description: con DC equals your spell save DC, any creature (other than you) that starts its turn within a 5-foot Emanation originating from the spirit. The creature has the Poisoned condition until the start of its next turn.

traits.name: Incorporeal Passage (Ghostly Only)
traits.description: The spirit can move through other creatures and objects as if they were Difficult Terrain. If it ends its turn inside an object, it is shunted to the nearest unoccupied space and takes 1d10 Force damage for every 5 feet traveled.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The spirit makes a number of attacks equal to half this spell's level (round down).

actions.name: Deathly Touch (Ghostly Only)
actions.description: m Bonus equals your spell attack modifier, reach 5 ft. 1d8 + 3 + summonSpellLevel Necrotic damage, and the target has the Frightened condition until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Grave Bolt (Skeletal Only)
actions.description: r Bonus equals your spell attack modifier, range 150 ft. 2d4 + 3 + summonSpellLevel Necrotic damage.

actions.name: Rotting Claw (Putrid Only)
actions.description: m Bonus equals your spell attack modifier, reach 5 ft. 1d6 + 3 + summonSpellLevel Slashing damage. If the target has the Poisoned condition, it has the Paralyzed condition until the end of its next turn.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The medusa has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Surprise Attack
traits.description: During the first round of combat, the medusa has advantage on attack rolls against any creature that is surprised, and it deals an extra 10 (3d6) damage each time it hits such a creature with an attack.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The medusa makes two claw attacks. It can also use Petrifying Gaze before or after making these attacks.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 13 (2d8 + 4) slashing damage.

actions.name: Petrifying Gaze
actions.description: The medusa fixes its gaze on one creature within 60 feet of it that it can see and that can see its eyes. The target must make a DC 14 Constitution saving throw. If the saving throw fails by 5 or more, the creature is instantly petrified. Otherwise, a creature that fails the save begins to turn to stone and is restrained. The restrained creature must repeat the saving throw at the end of its next turn, becoming petrified on a failure or ending the effect on a success. The petrification lasts until the creature is freed by a greater restoration spell or similar magic.

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
spellcasting.header: The medusa's innate spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save DC 14). The medusa can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

name: Underworld Cerberus
languages: understands all languages but can't speak

traits.name: Aggressive
traits.description: As a bonus action, the cerberus can move up to its speed toward a hostile creature that it can see.

traits.name: Multiheaded
traits.description: The cerberus can't be surprised, and it has advantage on saving throws against being knocked unconscious.

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.description: The cerberus has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the cerberus's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The cerberus makes three bite attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) fire damage.

actions.name: Breath Weapon {@recharge 5}
actions.description: The cerberus exhales a 30-foot cone of molten rock. Each creature in the cone must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw, taking 21 (6d6) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. On a failed save, a creature is also restrained by the hardening rock. A creature can make a DC 15 Strength (Athletics) check as an action, freeing itself or a creature within reach from the rock on a success. The rock has AC 17 and 20 hit points, and it is immune to fire, poison, and psychic damage.

traits.name: Aura of Radiance
traits.description: The councilor magically sheds bright light in a 15-foot radius and dim light for an additional 15 feet. The councilor can extinguish or restore this light as a bonus action. If the bright light overlaps with an area of darkness created by a spell of 3rd level or lower, the spell that created that darkness is dispelled.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The councilor has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The councilor makes two Radiant Touch attacks.

actions.name: Radiant Touch
actions.description: Melee Spell Attack +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 15 (3d6 + 5) radiant damage.

actions.name: Healing Touch (3/Day)
actions.description: The councilor touches another creature. The target magically regains 18 (3d8 + 5) hit points and is freed from one curse afflicting it (councilor's choice).

actions.name: Flame Strike (5th-Level Spell; Requires a Spell Slot)
actions.description: The councilor chooses a point it can see within 60 feet of it. Each creature in a 10-foot-radius, 40-foot-high cylinder centered on that point must make a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw. A creature takes 14 (4d6) fire damage and 14 (4d6) radiant damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. If the councilor casts this spell using a spell slot of 6th level or higher, the fire damage or the radiant damage (its choice) increases by 1d6 for each slot level above 5th.

legendary_actions.name: Touch
legendary_actions.description: The councilor makes one attack with its Radiant Touch.

legendary_actions.name: Shimmering Aura (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.description: The councilor channels positive energy into its Aura of Radiance. Until the end of the councilor's next turn, it sheds bright light in a 30-foot radius and dim light for an additional 30 feet. Any creature that starts its turn in the bright light must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or be blinded until the end of the councilor's next turn.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.header: The councilor is a 13th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 17, +9 to hit with spell attacks). It has the following cleric spells prepared:

traits.name: Illumination
traits.description: The soldier magically sheds bright light in a 10-foot radius and dim light for an additional 10 feet. The soldier can extinguish or restore this light as a bonus action.

traits.name: Turn Resistance
traits.description: The soldier has advantage on saving throws against any effect that turns undead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The soldier makes two spear attacks.

actions.name: Spear
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage or 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack, plus 9 (2d8) radiant damage if the target is a fiend or undead.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.description: If the unicorn fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The unicorn has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The unicorn makes one Hooves attack and one Radiant Horn attack.

actions.name: Hooves
actions.description: m +7, reach 5 ft. 11 (2d6 + 4) Bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Radiant Horn
actions.description: m +7, reach 5 ft. 9 (1d10 + 4) Radiant damage.

legendary_actions.name: Charging Horn
legendary_actions.description: The unicorn moves up to half its Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks, and it makes one Radiant Horn attack.

legendary_actions.name: Shimmering Shield
legendary_actions.description: The unicorn targets itself or one creature it can see within 60 feet of itself. The target gains 10 (3d6) Temporary Hit Points, and its AC increases by 2 until the end of the unicorn's next turn. The unicorn can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.header: The unicorn casts one of the following spells, requiring no spell components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 14):

spellcasting.name: Unicorn's Blessing (3/Day)
spellcasting.header: The unicorn touches another creature with its horn and casts Cure Wounds or Lesser Restoration on that creature, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

traits.name: Formed by the Mists
traits.description: When created, the horror's body composition takes one of four forms: Aberrant Armor, Loathsome Limbs, Malleable Mass, or Oozing Organs. This form determines certain traits in this stat block.

traits.name: Amorphous (Malleable Mass Only)
traits.description: The horror can move through any opening at least 1 inch wide without squeezing.

traits.name: Bile Body (Oozing Organs Only)
traits.description: Any creature that touches the horror or hits it with a melee attack takes 5 (1d10) acid damage.

traits.name: Relentless Stride (Loathsome Limbs Only)
traits.description: The horror can move through the space of another creature. The first time on a turn that the horror enters a creature's space during this move, the creature must succeed on a DC 16 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The horror makes two Limbs attacks.

actions.name: Limbs
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 21 (3d10 + 5) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Hex Blast {@recharge 5}
actions.description: The horror expels necrotic energy in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw, taking 45 (7d12) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

traits.name: Giant Slayer
traits.description: Any weapon attack that Urgala makes against a giant deals an extra 7 (2d6) damage on a hit.

traits.name: Roleplaying Information
traits.description: A retired adventurer, Urgala owns a respectable inn, the North shield House, and she doesn't want to see it or her neighbors' homes destroyed. She has no tolerance for monsters or bullies. Ideal: "We live in a violent world, and sometimes violence is necessary for survival." Bond: "My home is my life. Threaten it, and I'll hurt you." Flaw: "I know how treacherous and greedy adventurers can be. I don't trust them—any of them."

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Urgala makes two attacks with her morningstar or her shortbow.

actions.name: Morningstar
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Shortbow
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack +3 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. 5 (1d6 + 1) piercing damage. Urgala carries a quiver of twenty arrows.

traits.name: Invisibility
traits.description: The usagt's true form is invisible.

traits.name: Shapechanger
traits.description: The usagt can use its action to polymorph into a Small, Medium, or Large humanoid it has seen in person or telepathically, or back into its true form. Its statistics, other than its size, are the same in each form. While polymorphed, the usagt is not invisible. Its new form appears to wear clothes, carry equipment, and even wield weapons, but these are all parts of the usagt itself; they vanish if dropped or removed from the creature. It can't activate, use, wield, or otherwise benefit from any of its apparent equipment. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The usagt makes two attacks with its claws.

actions.name: Claws
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 7 (2d4 + 2) slashing damage plus 11 (2d6 + 4) psychic damage.

actions.name: Personal Insight
actions.description: The usagt targets one creature it can see within 30 feet of it. The target must contest its Charisma (Deception) check against the usagt's Wisdom (Insight) check. The target has advantage on the roll if it is immune to being charmed. A target can choose to fail this check. If the usagt wins, it magically learns the identity of a creature from the target's past, someone the target wishes it could speak to again or with whom the target has left something unsaid. If somehow no such creature exists in the target's past, the usagt learns that instead.

reactions.name: Invisibility Response (Recharges When the Usagt Uses Its Shapechanger Ability)
reactions.description: When the usagt takes damage, it can choose to revert to its default, invisible form and move up to 15 feet without provoking opportunity attacks.

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
spellcasting.header: The usagt's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 15). It can cast the following spells, requiring no spell components:

actions.name: Spear
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage, or 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage if wielded with two hands.

actions.name: Shortbow
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack +3 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. 4 (1d6 + 1) piercing damage.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting (Requires a Sacred Bundle)
spellcasting.header: The shaman casts one of the following spells, using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 12; +4 to hit with spell attacks):

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.header: The giant casts one of the following spells, requiring no material spell components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 17):

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.description: The heir has Advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the heir's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally doesn't have the Incapacitated condition.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The heir makes four attacks, using Scimitar or Lunar Wisp in any combination.

actions.name: Scimitar

traits.name: Vengeful Tracker
traits.description: Vladimir knows the distance to and direction of Strahd, even if Strahd and Vladimir are on different planes of existence. If Strahd is destroyed, Vladimir knows.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Vladimir makes two fist attacks or two attacks with his +2 Greatsword.

actions.name: Fist
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage. Strahd, the target of Vladimir's sworn vengeance, takes an extra 14 (4d6) bludgeoning damage. Instead of dealing damage, Vladimir can grapple the target (escape DC 14) provided the target is Large or smaller.

actions.name: Greatsword +2
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 20 (4d6 + 6) slashing damage. Against Strahd, Vladimir deals an extra 14 (4d6) slashing damage with this weapon.

actions.name: Vengeful Glare
actions.description: Vladimir can target Strahd within 30 feet provided he can see Strahd. Strahd must make a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, Strahd is paralyzed until Vladimir deals damage to him, or until the end of Vladimir's next turn. When the paralysis ends, Strahd is frightened of Vladimir for 1 minute. Strahd can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of his turns, with disadvantage if he can see Vladimir, ending the frightened condition on itself on a success.

traits.name: All-Around Vision
traits.description: The vlazok can't be surprised.

traits.name: Blood Frenzy
traits.description: The vlazok has advantage on melee attack rolls against any creature that doesn't have all its hit points.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The vlazok has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.description: The vlazok can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The vlazok makes two Gore attacks.

actions.name: Gore
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 23 (4d8 + 5) piercing damage, and if the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the prone condition.

bonus_actions.name: Stomp
bonus_actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one prone creature. 27 (4d10 + 5) bludgeoning damage.

traits.name: Unusual Nature
traits.description: The scavver doesn't require air.

actions.name: Swallowing Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 45 (6d12 + 6) piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it must succeed on a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw or be swallowed by the scavver. The scavver can have one creature swallowed at a time. A swallowed creature is blinded and restrained, has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the scavver, and takes 11 (2d10) acid damage at the start of each of the scavver's turns from the digestive juices in the scavver's gullet. If the scavver takes 25 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, the scavver must succeed on a DC 20 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate the swallowed creature, which falls prone in a space within 10 feet of the scavver. If the scavver dies, a swallowed creature is no longer restrained by it and can escape from the corpse by using 10 feet of movement, exiting prone.

bonus_actions.name: Ray of Fear {@recharge 4}
bonus_actions.description: The scavver's eye emits an invisible, magical ray that targets one creature the scavver can see within 60 feet of itself. The target must succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened of the scavver until the start of the scavver's next turn.

actions.name: Dagger
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack +3 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. 3 (1d4 + 1) piercing damage.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.header: Volo is a 1st-level spellcaster. His spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save DC 12, +4 to hit with spell attacks). He has the following wizard spells prepared:

name: Vorvolaka
languages: the languages it knew in life

traits.name: Fear Aura
traits.description: Any hostile creature that starts its turn within 20 feet of the vorvolaka must succeed on a DC 18 Wisdom saving throw or have frightened condition until the start of the creature's next turn. If a creature's saving throw is successful, they're immune to the vorvolaka's Fear Aura for the next 24 hours. This ability does not function if the vorvolaka is unconscious.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The vorvolaka has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.description: The vorvolaka regains 15 hit points at the start of its turn if it has at least 1 hit point. If the vorvolaka takes radiant damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of the vorvolaka's next turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The vorvolaka makes two Talon attacks. It can replace one of the attacks with Rend Armor (if available).

actions.name: Talon
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 22 (4d8 + 4) piercing damage plus 14 (4d6) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Rend Armor {@recharge 4}
actions.description: The vorvolaka makes a Talon attack against a creature. On a hit, the creature's AC is reduced by 2 for 1 minute. Creatures not wearing armor are immune to this effect, and the total reduction can't bring a creature below an AC of 10.

traits.name: Voice Lock
traits.description: The vox seeker must move toward and attack the source of the nearest voice within 60 feet of it, to the exclusion of all other targets, for as long as it remains operational.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.description: The vox seeker can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

actions.name: Pincer
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 2 (1d4) piercing damage plus 3 lightning damage.

traits.name: Demonic Restoration
traits.description: If the vrock dies outside the Abyss, its body dissolves into ichor, and it gains a new body instantly, reviving with all its Hit Points somewhere in the Abyss.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The vrock has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The vrock makes two Shred attacks.

actions.name: Shred
actions.description: m +6, reach 5 ft. 10 (2d6 + 3) Piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) Poison damage.

actions.name: Spores {@recharge}
actions.description: con DC 15, each creature in a 20-foot Emanation [Area of Effect] originating from the vrock. The target has the Poisoned condition and repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. While Poisoned, the target takes 5 (1d10) Poison damage at the start of each of its turns. Emptying a flask of Holy Water on the target ends the effect early.

actions.name: Stunning Screech (1/Day)
actions.description: con DC 15, each creature in a 20-foot Emanation [Area of Effect] originating from the vrock (demons succeed automatically). 10 (3d6) Thunder damage, and the target has the Stunned condition until the end of the vrock's next turn.

traits.name: Fey Ancestry
traits.description: Magic can't put the stingblade to sleep.

actions.description: m +4, reach 5 ft. 5 (1d6 + 2) Piercing damage plus 2 (1d4) Poison damage.

actions.name: Boomerang
actions.description: r +4, reach 30/120 ft. 7 (2d4 + 2) Bludgeoning damage.

traits.name: Fey Ancestry
traits.description: Magic can't put the priest to sleep.

actions.name: Venom Staff
actions.description: m +4, reach 5 ft. 9 (2d6 + 2) Bludgeoning damage, and the target has the Poisoned condition until the end of the priest's next turn.

bonus_actions.name: Intensify Poison
bonus_actions.description: Each creature with the Poisoned condition within a 30-foot Emanation [Area of Effect] originating from the priest takes 3 (1d6) Poison damage.

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.description: The vulture has Advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the vulture's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally doesn't have the Incapacitated condition.

actions.name: Beak
actions.description: m +2, reach 5 ft. 2 (1d4) Piercing damage.

traits.name: Magic Resistance

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.description: If Waeloquay fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Water Form
traits.description: Waeloquay can enter a hostile creature's space and stop there. It can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Waeloquay makes three Slam attacks.

actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +14 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. 26 (4d8 + 8) bludgeoning damage.

If the save is successful, the target is pushed out of Waeloquay's space. Waeloquay can grapple one Large creature or up to four Medium or smaller creatures at one time. At the start of each of Waeloquay's turns, each target grappled by it takes 21 (3d8 + 8) bludgeoning damage. A creature within 5 feet of Waeloquay can pull a creature or object out of it by taking an action to make a DC 22 Strength check and succeeding.

legendary_actions.name: Flow

legendary_actions.name: Crush (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.description: One creature that Waeloquay is grappling takes 44 (8d8 + 8) bludgeoning damage.

legendary_actions.name: Pummel (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.description: Waeloquay makes a Slam attack with advantage.

traits.name: Crumbling Colossus
traits.description: When the statue drops to 0 hit points, it crumbles and is destroyed. Any creature on the ground within 30 feet of the crumbling statue must make a DC 22 Dexterity saving throw, taking 22 (4d10) bludgeoning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

traits.name: Mask of the Wild
traits.description: Walnut can attempt to hide even when she is only lightly obscured by foliage, heavy rain, falling snow, mist, and other natural phenomena.

traits.name: Wild Shape (Recharges after a Short or Long rest)

She automatically reverts if she falls unconscious, drops to 0 hit points, or dies. While transformed, Walnut's game statistics are replaced by the statistics of the dire wolf, except she retains her alignment, personality, and Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores. Her attacks in beast form are magical. While in beast form, Walnut can use a bonus action to expend one spell slot and regain 1d8 hit points per level of the spell slot expended.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Walnut makes two attacks with Foremother or her longbow.

actions.name: Foremother (+1 Scimitar)
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 7 (1d6 + 4) slashing damage.

actions.name: Longbow
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack +5 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Tusks

actions.name: Claws
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 20 (3d8 + 7) slashing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the grappled condition (escape DC 20). While a creature is grappled, the war devil can't make Claws attacks.

actions.name: Multiattack

actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 10 (2d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage plus 10 (3d6) radiant damage.

On a successful save, the target takes half as much damage and isn't blinded.

bonus_actions.name: Healing Light {@recharge 4}
bonus_actions.description: The war priest or one creature of its choice within 60 feet of it regains 12 (2d8 + 3) hit points.

traits.description: As long as the archon doesn't have the incapacitated condition, each creature of the archon's choice that starts its turn within 20 feet of the archon must make a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the creature has the frightened condition until the start of its next turn. On a successful save, the creature is immune to all archons' Aura of Menace for 24 hours.

traits.name: Eternal Vigil
traits.description: The archon can't be surprised. Moreover, it knows when any creature uses a portal it is assigned to guard.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The archon makes two Claw attacks and one Tracker's Bite attack.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 12 (2d6 + 5) slashing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, the target has the grappled condition (escape DC 18). The archon can have only one creature grappled in this way at a time.

actions.name: Tracker's Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 15 (3d6 + 5) piercing damage. If the target is a creature, for the next 24 hours, the archon knows the distance and direction to the target while they are both on the same plane of existence.

actions.name: Teleport
actions.description: The archon teleports, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, to an unoccupied space it can see within 120 feet of itself.

spellcasting.header: The archon casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 15):

traits.name: Special Equipment
traits.description: Warduke wears a dread helm (see appendix A) and wields a flame tongue longsword.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Warduke makes three Flame Tongue or Dagger attacks.

actions.name: Flame Tongue
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 7 (1d8 + 3) slashing damage, or 8 (1d10 + 3) slashing damage when used with two hands, plus 7 (2d6) fire damage if the weapon is aflame.

traits.name: Magic Resistance

traits.description: Any enemy outside the colossus that starts its turn within 30 feet of it must succeed on a DC 26 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened until the start of the enemy's next turn. If the enemy's saving throw is successful, it is immune to this colossus's Towering Terror for the next 24 hours.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The colossus makes three attacks—one with its slam and two with its eldritch turrets—and then uses Stomp.

actions.name: Slam
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +18 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. 29 (3d12 + 10) bludgeoning damage, and the colossus can push the target up to 20 feet away from it.

actions.name: Eldritch Turret
actions.description: Ranged Spell Attack +18 to hit, range 300 ft., one target. 18 (4d8) force damage, and if the target is a creature, it is knocked prone.

actions.name: Stomp
actions.description: The colossus stomps one of its feet at a point on the ground within 20 feet of it. Any creature in a 20-foot-radius, 20-foot-high cylinder centered on this point must succeed on a DC 26 Dexterity saving throw or take 33 (6d10) bludgeoning damage and fall prone. Until the colossus uses its Stomp again or moves, the creature is restrained. While restrained in this way, the creature (or another creature within 5 feet of it) can use its action to make a DC 26 Strength check. On a success, the creature relocates to an unoccupied space of its choice within 5 feet of the colossus and is no longer restrained. Structures, as well as nonmagical objects that are neither being worn nor carried, take the same amount of damage if they are in the cylinder (no save).

actions.name: Incinerating Beam {@recharge 5}
actions.description: The colossus fires a beam of light in a 150-foot line that is 10 feet wide. Each creature in the line must make a DC 26 Dexterity saving throw, taking 60 (11d10) radiant damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature reduced to 0 hit points by this beam is disintegrated, leaving behind anything it was wearing or carrying.

actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 6 (1d6 + 3) slashing damage.

reactions.description: The warrior imposes disadvantage on the attack roll of a creature within 5 feet of it whose target isn't the warrior. The warrior must be able to see the attacker.

actions.description: m +9, reach 5 ft. 19 (4d6 + 5) Slashing damage. The warrior also creates one of the following effects: Sap. The target has Disadvantage on its next attack roll before the start of the warrior's next turn. Maneuver. One ally who can see or hear the warrior can take a Reaction to move up to half the ally's Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

actions.name: Longbow
actions.description: r +9, range 150/600 ft. 18 (3d8 + 5) Piercing damage, and the target's Speed decreases by 10 feet until the end of the target's next turn.

bonus_actions.description: The warrior moves up to half its Speed straight toward an enemy it can see without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

reactions.name: Counterattack
reactions.description: The warrior is hit by an attack roll. The warrior adds 4 to its AC against that attack, possibly causing it to miss. On a miss, the warrior can make one Greatsword or Longbow attack against the attacker.

name: Wasteland Dragonnel
languages: understands Common and Draconic but can't speak

traits.name: Flyby
traits.description: The dragonnel doesn't provoke opportunity attacks when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

actions.name: Multiattack

actions.name: Rend
